_about: Ballroom Quest syllabus v4 (complete syllabus, five styles). Steps are written for the LEADER: [foot, direction, beats, turn_degrees(+ = right), count_label, weight(optional, default true)]. Directions: fwd, back, side_l, side_r, diag_fwd_l/r, diag_back_l/r, cross_fwd, cross_back, cross_behind, close, replace, in_place, slip_back (the moving foot slides back about half a stride from where it is) and slip_fwd. The follower's part is the mirror image (other foot; fwd<->back, side_l<->side_r, diag_fwd_r<->diag_back_l, diag_fwd_l<->diag_back_r, slip_back<->slip_fwd; cross, close, replace and in_place unchanged) except where a figure has follow_steps: {leader step index: [foot, direction] or [foot, direction, weight]} gives the follower's own step on that count (beats and counts always come from the leader's step; the optional third value says whether she takes weight when that differs from him). Positions: closed, promenade, open, fan (slot dances such as West Coast Swing are danced in open position only: every West Coast figure starts and ends in open, in the slot). A routine starts in its first figure's hold (closed when that figure is danced from closed, else the first hold it accepts). hold_at: {leader step index: position} says where the hold changes part-way through a figure, from that step on (a Swing Out closes as she walks in on 2 and opens again on 6); the figure still ends in its ends position. A figure can follow another only if the free foot and the position match; Quickstep figures also carry end_travel (fwd/back), and the next figure must start moving the same way; only_after / only_before list the only figures that may come straight before / after it. Each dance has rise: 'waltz' (3-beat rise and fall), 'swing' (rise over each slow or quick-quick) or 'none', and floor: 'lod' (travels counter-clockwise around the room along the line of dance), 'slot' (travels up and down a narrow lane) or 'spot' (stays in one place). A style lists its dances; the Social & Nightclub style also lists East Coast Swing (dance key swing), which belongs to American Rhythm and shares its figures. source: 'moore' = International Standard facts from Alex Moore, Ballroom Dancing (cues are our own words); 'v1' = original syllabus; 'general' = common Bronze syllabus knowledge, to be checked by a coach. Where the book overlaps a figure's last step with the next figure's first step, each step is listed only once here. follow_turns: {leader step index: degrees} is the follower's own body turn on that step (+ = right / clockwise, like the leader's turn): on a listed step her body turns exactly that much, whatever he does and whatever the hold would suggest (only a floor-steering curve, which turns the whole couple, comes on top); steps that are not listed follow the default (she turns with him, or the opposite way in side-by-side figures such as the New Yorker). Figures where her turn differs from his carry it: underarm turns and spins, spot turns and side-by-side checks, the Fan, Hockey Stick and Alemana, cross body leads, and the West Coast passes and whip. Syllabus v4: every dance follows the complete BallroomDancers.com syllabus (levels as the site names them: Beginning/Intermediate/Full Bronze, Silver, Gold for International; Bronze levels, Beginning/Intermediate/Full Silver and Open Gold Variations for American; numbered levels for the Social dances; Newcomer = the game's own starter pieces). source 'bdc' = converted from that site's man's and lady's step charts (ref = its figure id; cues and tips are our own words). leads_to / comes_from list the recommended next / previous figures from the site's Followed By / Preceded By lists, kept only where the game's rules accept the link. data/syllabus.json holds the full syllabus, including figures the game cannot dance yet.

std_waltz.name: Slow Waltz
std_waltz.feel: Swing and sway, 1-2-3 with rise at the end of 1 and lowering at the end of 3. Closed hold throughout.

std_foxtrot.name: Slow Foxtrot
std_foxtrot.feel: Long, gliding, lazy steps: slow-quick-quick. The smoothest and most continuous of the dances.

std_tango.name: Tango
std_tango.feel: Staccato and level with no rise and fall. Feet placed, not swung; walks curve slightly left. (Slow = 2 game beats, quick = 1.)

quickstep.name: Quickstep
quickstep.feel: Fast and light with chasses and locks: slow = 2 beats, quick = 1. Stay up on the toes through the quicks.

std_viennese.name: Viennese Waltz
std_viennese.feel: Fast rotating turns, 60 bars a minute. Changes switch between Natural and Reverse Turns.

waltz.name: Waltz
waltz.feel: Rise and fall, 1-2-3 with the strongest step on 1. Swing and sway.

tango.name: Tango
tango.feel: Staccato, no rise and fall. Walks curve slightly left. Slow = 2 beats, quick = 1 beat.

foxtrot.name: Foxtrot
foxtrot.feel: Smooth, gliding Slow-Slow-Quick-Quick. Long walking slows, soft quicks.

viennese.name: Viennese Waltz
viennese.feel: Fast, sweeping 1-2-3 turns. American style may open out of hold for underarm turns.

chacha.name: Cha Cha
chacha.feel: Counted 2, 3, 4-and-1. Break steps on 2-3, a quick chasse on 4-and-1. Straight legs, Cuban motion.

rumba.name: Rumba
rumba.feel: Slow and sensual. Counted 2, 3, 4-1: the side step on 4 is held through 1.

jive.name: Jive
jive.feel: Bouncy and fast. Rock step on 1-2, chasse 3-a-4, chasse 5-a-6.

samba.name: Samba
samba.feel: Carnival bounce through the knees, counted 1-a-2. The 'a' is a very quick step.

paso.name: Paso Doble
paso.feel: A proud Spanish march, one step per beat. Tall posture, sharp appels (stamps).

am_chacha.name: Cha Cha
am_chacha.feel: Counted 2, 3, 4-and-1, like the Latin cha cha, with more open and side-by-side figures.

am_rumba.name: Rumba
am_rumba.feel: Slow, quick, quick box rhythm with Cuban motion: the hips settle as each step takes weight.

swing.name: East Coast Swing
swing.feel: Six-count swing: triple step, triple step, rock step. Relaxed, bouncy and playful.

bolero.name: Bolero
bolero.feel: Slow, romantic rumba-like dance with rise and fall: a long rising slow, then two quicks.

mambo.name: Mambo
mambo.feel: Fast and punchy: break on 2, hold on 1. Strong Cuban hip action.

wcs.name: West Coast Swing
wcs.feel: Smooth, stretchy swing danced in a narrow slot: she travels up and down the lane while he steps aside to let her pass. Six- and eight-count patterns, each finishing with an anchor step, a small triple that settles back at the end of the slot.

lindy.name: Lindy Hop
lindy.feel: The original Savoy swing: grounded and bouncy, with the knees pulsing down on every beat. Mixes six-count patterns with eight-count ones (1, 2, 3&4, 5, 6, 7&8); the eight-count swing out is its signature.

salsa.name: Salsa
salsa.feel: LA style, on 1: quick, compact steps on 1-2-3 and 5-6-7 with a pause on 4 and 8. Breaks forward and back, turns under the arm, and Latin hip motion from soft knees.

figures.name: Natural Spin Turn (+ Reverse 4-6)
figures.lead_cue: First half of a Natural Turn, then pivot half a turn on the left foot, step forward and around; finish with the back half of a Reverse Turn.
figures.follow_cue: First half of a Natural Turn, then forward on the right and spin with him, back on the left and a small step diagonally forward on the right; finish forward-side-close turning left.
figures.mistake: Opening the knees on the pivot; keep the right foot in front and the thighs together.
figures.rise_fall: Normal rise on 1-3, rise end of 5 up on 6; normal rise on the reverse half
figures.sway: Right on 2-3, none on the spin
figures.notes_for_beginners: The book's usual follow-up (4-6 of a Reverse Turn) is built in so it ends facing diagonal wall.

figures.name: RF Closed Change
figures.lead_cue: Right forward, side, close. The bridge from a Natural Turn into a Reverse Turn.
figures.follow_cue: Left back, side, close.
figures.mistake: Skipping it and trying to start a Reverse Turn straight after a Natural Turn.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: LF Closed Change
figures.lead_cue: Left forward, side, close. It takes you from a Reverse Turn into a Natural Turn.
figures.follow_cue: Right back, side, close. Let him carry you straight down the room.
figures.mistake: Letting the side step drift forward; keep it to the side so the next turn starts square.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3
figures.notes_for_beginners: Use it to switch your free foot from left to right without turning.

figures.name: Natural Turn
figures.lead_cue: Right foot forward and turn right: forward-side-close, then back-side-close. Three-eighths per half.
figures.follow_cue: Left back and turn right, then forward-side-close on the outside of the turn.
figures.mistake: Making the second step short when going forward; the outside partner needs the long step.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise end of 4 (no foot rise), up 5-6, lower end of 6

figures.name: Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Left foot forward and turn left: forward-side-close, back-side-close. Three-eighths per half.
figures.follow_cue: Right back and turn left; on 4-6 go forward-side-close around him.
figures.mistake: Starting it right after a Natural Turn; dance a RF Closed Change in between.
figures.rise_fall: Same pattern as the Natural Turn

figures.name: Natural Spin Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance the first half of a Natural Turn, then pivot a half turn to the right on the left foot and drive forward on the right between her feet, finishing with the left foot to the side and slightly back.
figures.follow_cue: Begin like a Natural Turn; on the second bar step forward on the right and turn with him, then go back on the left, brush the right foot past it and place it diagonally forward.
figures.mistake: Letting the knees open on the pivot; keep the thighs together and the right foot in front so the couple turns as one.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3; no rise on 4, rise at end of 5, lower at end of 6

figures.name: Natural Spin Turn (Underturned)
figures.lead_cue: Same action as the Spin Turn but with less rotation: three-eighths on the pivot and a quarter over the last two steps, so you finish backing diagonal centre against the line of dance.
figures.follow_cue: Follow the first half of a Natural Turn, then go forward on the right and turn a little less than usual, finishing with the right foot diagonally forward.
figures.mistake: Over-rotating out of habit; stop the pivot at three-eighths so the next figure starts on the right alignment.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3; no rise on 4, rise at end of 5, lower at end of 6

figures.name: Whisk
figures.lead_cue: Forward, side, cross the left foot behind and open her into promenade. You do not turn.
figures.follow_cue: Back, diagonally back, then cross your right foot behind as you turn your head to the right.
figures.mistake: Trying to close back into closed hold; the Whisk ends in promenade, so a Chasse from Promenade comes next.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Whisk (at Corner)
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the left, turning gently left, take the right foot diagonally forward with the right side leading and hook the left behind to open into promenade facing the new diagonal wall.
figures.follow_cue: Go back on the right and then back on the left with the left side leading, crossing the right foot behind as you open your head to the right.
figures.mistake: Turning too early on step 1 and running into the corner; let the turn happen between 1 and 3.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Whisk (to Diagonal Centre)
figures.lead_cue: A Whisk with an eighth of a turn to the left on 1-2, so the promenade that follows travels toward diagonal centre.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, diagonally back on the left as you turn slightly left, then cross the right foot behind and open to promenade.
figures.mistake: Forgetting the small left turn, which sends the next promenade figure toward the wall instead of the centre.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Chasse from Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Right foot through in promenade, then side-close-side as she comes back to face you.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot through, then turn to face him on side-close-side.
figures.mistake: Rushing the 'and': steps 2 and the close share one beat.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up 2-&-3, lower end of 3
figures.notes_for_beginners: In the book the next step (right foot outside her) is the first step of a Natural Turn.

figures.name: Closed Impetus
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the left, draw the right foot beside it and turn on the left heel three-eighths to the right, then finish with the left foot to the side and slightly back.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward on the right, travel round him with the left foot to the side and brush the right foot in, then step diagonally forward on the right.
figures.mistake: Rising too soon on the heel turn; stay down until the feet are together and rise only at the end of 2.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise at end of 2, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Hesitation Change
figures.lead_cue: Dance the first half of a Natural Turn, then step back on the left, pull the right heel back to a small side step while turning, and let the left foot come in without weight for the held count.
figures.follow_cue: First half of a Natural Turn, then forward on the right, left foot to the side as you come round him, and draw the right foot in without putting weight on it.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the last step; the left foot must stay free for the Reverse Turn.
figures.rise_fall: Normal rise on 1-3, no rise on 4-6

figures.name: Outside Change
figures.lead_cue: Two steps back, left then right, starting a gentle left turn on the second, then the left foot to the side and slightly forward so you are ready to step outside her on the right.
figures.follow_cue: Two steps forward, right then left, then the right foot to the side and slightly back as you turn a little left, ready for him to step outside you.
figures.mistake: Taking the second back step too long; keep it under the body so the side step can turn the couple.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1 (no foot rise), up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Outside Change (to Promenade)
figures.lead_cue: Back on the left and the right as in the Outside Change, but open her on the last step so your left foot goes to the side in promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Forward right, forward left, then the right foot to the side in promenade as he opens the hold.
figures.mistake: Turning her into promenade with the arms; open the hold by turning your own body less on step 3.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1 (no foot rise), up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Reverse Corte
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the right and turn left on it, drawing the left foot in with no weight; hold for 3 with the body still turning so she can come round you.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the left, right foot to the side as you travel round him, and close the left foot to it.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the closing left foot; it must stay free for the backward step that follows.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise at end of 2, lower at end of 3
figures.notes_for_beginners: It begins backing the line of dance, so dance it straight after a Natural Spin Turn or a Closed Impetus.

figures.name: Back Whisk
figures.lead_cue: With her outside on your right, step back on the left, take the right foot diagonally back and cross the left behind it as you open her into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward outside him on the right, turn a little right as the left foot goes to the side, then cross the right foot behind into promenade.
figures.mistake: Pulling her open with the left arm; let your body turn guide her into promenade on 3.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1 (no foot rise), up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Basic Weave
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right, forward on the left and side on the right as you turn left, then back on the left with her outside, back on the right and side on the left, ready to step outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the left, back on the right, side on the left; then forward outside him on the right, forward on the left and side on the right.
figures.mistake: Rising on the first step; it stays down, with the rise coming at the end of step 2.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise at end of 2, lower at end of 3; rise at end of 4 (no foot rise), up on 5-6, lower at end of 6

figures.name: Basic Weave (to Promenade)
figures.lead_cue: The Basic Weave with the last step opened: your left foot goes to the side in promenade so a promenade figure can follow.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the weave as usual, but on the last step take the right foot to the side as he opens you into promenade.
figures.mistake: Closing the hold on the last step out of habit; keep her open so the next step can go through.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise at end of 2, lower at end of 3; rise at end of 4 (no foot rise), up on 5-6, lower at end of 6

figures.name: Forward Lock
figures.lead_cue: Step forward outside her on the right, then left, cross the right foot behind the left on the 'and' and step on with the left, keeping the body turned a little to the right.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left with him outside, back on the right, cross the left foot over in front of it and continue back on the right.
figures.mistake: Letting the locked foot drift away from the other; keep the cross tight and the hips moving forward.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-&-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Back Lock
figures.lead_cue: With her outside on your right, step back on the left, back on the right, lock the left foot across on the 'and' and continue back on the right.
figures.follow_cue: Forward outside him on the right, forward on the left, cross the right foot behind it and step on with the left.
figures.mistake: Dropping the heels during the lock; stay on the balls of the feet until the last step.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1 (no foot rise), up on 2-&-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Progressive Chasse to Right
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left turning left, then side-close-side to your right on 2-and-3, ending backing diagonal wall with her ready to step outside you.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, then side-close-side to your left on 2-and-3, finishing ready to step forward outside him.
figures.mistake: Squaring off the last step; keep it slightly back and the body turned a little right so she can step outside.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-&-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Weave from Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Step through on the right in promenade, forward on the left as you bring her square, side on the right, then back on the left with her outside, back on the right and side on the left.
figures.follow_cue: Step through on the left, turn left to face him as the right foot goes to the side, side on the left, then forward outside him on the right, forward on the left and side on the right.
figures.mistake: Rushing her turn on 2; give her the whole beat to come square before you start backing.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3; rise at end of 4 (no foot rise), up on 5-6, lower at end of 6

figures.name: Weave from Promenade (ended in Promenade)
figures.lead_cue: The Weave from Promenade with the last step opened again, so your left foot goes to the side in promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the weave and open to promenade on the last step, taking the right foot to the side.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to reopen the hold on the last step, which blocks the promenade figure that follows.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3; rise at end of 4 (no foot rise), up on 5-6, lower at end of 6

figures.name: Open Telemark
figures.lead_cue: Like the Closed Telemark, but turn your body less on 3 so your left foot lands to the side in promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, heel turn on the right as the left closes, then the right foot diagonally forward in promenade with the right side leading.
figures.mistake: Letting her keep turning after the heel turn; stop her square in promenade with your body.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Open Impetus
figures.lead_cue: Back on the left, close the right and turn on the left heel three-eighths to the right, then step the left foot diagonally forward in promenade with the left side leading.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the right, left foot to the side as you go round him with a brush, then the right foot to the side in promenade.
figures.mistake: Opening before the heel turn is complete; finish the turn on 2, then open on 3.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise at end of 2, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Cross Hesitation
figures.lead_cue: Step through on the right in promenade, then close the left foot without weight and hold, turning your body a little left so she crosses in front of you.
figures.follow_cue: Step through on the left, turn left with the right foot to the side and close the left to it, ending in front of him ready to step outside.
figures.mistake: Taking weight on the closing left foot; it must stay free to step back with her outside.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Wing
figures.lead_cue: Step through on the right in promenade, then slowly draw the left foot in without weight while turning your upper body to the left, so she walks round to your left side.
figures.follow_cue: Walk three steps round his left side, left, right, left, turning to the left and finishing outside him on his left.
figures.mistake: Pulling her round with the arms; stay on your right foot and let the body turn draw her.

figures.name: Outside Spin
figures.lead_cue: Take a small step back on the left with the toe turned in and turn sharply right as she steps outside, go forward on the right round her, and finish with the left foot to the side, turning a full turn in all.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward outside him on the right, close the left foot as you turn strongly right with him, then step forward on the right to finish the rotation.
figures.mistake: Taking a big first step; a small step with the toe turned in keeps the couple over a common axis.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise at end of 2, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Outside Spin (Underturned)
figures.lead_cue: The Outside Spin with three-quarters of a turn instead of a whole one, finishing backing diagonal centre with the right foot free to go back.
figures.follow_cue: Forward outside him on the right, close the left as you turn right, then the right foot diagonally forward.
figures.mistake: Turning the full amount; stop at three-quarters so a Reverse Corte or Hover Corte can follow.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise at end of 2, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Turning Lock to Left
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right with the right side leading, lock the left foot across on the 'and', back on the right as you start turning left, then the left foot to the side to point diagonal wall.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the left, cross the right behind it, forward on the left again and then the right foot to the side and slightly back.
figures.mistake: Losing the right-side lead on the lock; keep the right side back so the cross happens easily.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Turning Lock to Left (to Promenade)
figures.lead_cue: The Turning Lock to Left with the last step opened: the left foot goes to the side in promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, lock behind, forward, then the right foot to the side in promenade.
figures.mistake: Ending square out of habit; open her into promenade on the last step.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Drag Hesitation
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left starting a left turn, right foot to the side, then drag the left foot slowly in without weight as you turn a little more.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, left to the side as you turn left, and drag the right foot in without weight.
figures.mistake: Snapping the feet together; the drag should take the whole of beat 3.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise at end of 2, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Left Whisk
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right turning left, left foot to the side and slightly forward, then cross the right foot behind it and twist the upper body further left.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the left turning left, right to the side and slightly back, then step back on the left across your body.
figures.mistake: Lowering through the crossed position; stay up and let the twist carry you into the next figure.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1

figures.name: Left Whisk (from Promenade)
figures.lead_cue: Step through on the right in promenade, left foot to the side and slightly forward, then cross the right foot behind and turn the body left.
figures.follow_cue: Step through on the left, turn left as the right foot goes to the side and slightly back, then step back on the left across your body.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to bring her square on 2; she needs to face you before the left whisk position.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1

figures.name: Closed Wing
figures.lead_cue: Step forward outside her on the right, then slowly bring the left foot in to close without weight while your body turns slightly left.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left, a small right step to the side and slightly back, then forward on the left outside him on his left side.
figures.mistake: Transferring weight onto the closing left foot; keep it free for the Reverse Turn or Whisk that follows.

figures.name: Turning Lock to Right
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right, cross the left loosely as you turn a quarter right, a small right step between her feet, then the left foot diagonally forward in promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the left, cross the right loosely behind as you turn right, left to the side with a brush, then the right foot to the side in promenade.
figures.mistake: Locking the feet too tightly; a loose cross lets the turn flow on the 'and'.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Fallaway Reverse and Slip Pivot
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left turning left, back on the right into fallaway, back on the left across your body, then slip the right foot back and pivot left to close the hold again.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, back on the left in fallaway, a small step back on the right with a strong left pivot, then forward on the left as you pivot again.
figures.mistake: Making the fallaway steps too long; keep them small so the slip pivot stays compact.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3, no rise on 4

figures.name: Hover Corte
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right turning left, left foot to the side and slightly forward as you hover on the toes, then settle your weight back onto the right foot.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the left, right foot to the side with a brush as you turn left, then step diagonally forward on the left.
figures.mistake: Lowering on the hover; stay on your toes through 2 and settle only as the weight goes back to the right.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1 (no foot rise), up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Fallaway Whisk
figures.lead_cue: Back on the left turning right, right foot to the side and slightly back, then cross the left foot loosely behind into fallaway.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the right, left foot to the side as you turn right, then cross the right foot loosely behind into fallaway.
figures.mistake: Crossing too tightly; a loose cross keeps the fallaway shape open and balanced.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1 (no foot rise), up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Preparation Step
figures.lead_cue: One slow step forward on the left to set up the Feather with the right foot free.
figures.follow_cue: One slow step back on the right.
figures.mistake: Starting the Feather from standing still; the prep step gives you the swing.

figures.name: Feather Finish
figures.lead_cue: Straight after a Closed Impetus: back on the right turning left, side, then forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, side, back; he passes on your right side.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to turn: about a quarter turn to the left brings you to the diagonal.

figures.name: Closed Impetus
figures.lead_cue: Natural Turn start, then back on the left and close the right with a heel turn, step side; follow with a Feather Finish.
figures.follow_cue: Natural Turn start with a heel turn, then forward around him, side, and a small step forward on the right, ready to go forward into the Feather Finish.
figures.mistake: Not closing the feet on the heel turn; the leader turns on the left heel with feet together.
figures.rise_fall: Normal rise on 1-3, rise end of 5 (heel turn), lower end of 6

figures.name: Feather Step
figures.lead_cue: Slow, quick, quick: right forward, left forward, then right forward stepping outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back, back; let him pass on your right side on the last quick.
figures.mistake: Turning the hips to get outside; lead with the left side of the body instead.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower end of 3
figures.notes_for_beginners: In the book the next left-foot step also opens whichever figure comes after the Feather.

figures.name: Three Step
figures.lead_cue: Three straight walks forward, slow quick quick, with a rise on the quicks.
figures.follow_cue: Three walks back; reach long from the hip.
figures.mistake: Letting the quicks become short and choppy; they stay long and smooth.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of the first quick, up on the second quick, lower at end of the second quick

figures.name: Natural Turn (Heel Pull)
figures.lead_cue: Right forward and turn right, side, back; then back, pull the right foot beside the left on the heel, and forward on the left.
figures.follow_cue: Back and heel turn, forward; then forward, side, and brush back.
figures.mistake: Stepping the heel-pull foot behind; it lands beside the left foot, parallel and slightly apart.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; no rise on 4-6

figures.name: Reverse Turn (with Feather Finish)
figures.lead_cue: Left forward turning left, side, back; then back, side, and forward outside her (the Feather Finish).
figures.follow_cue: Back with a heel turn (close the left beside the right and turn on the heel), forward; then forward, side, back.
figures.mistake: Swinging the leader's second step too far forward; it goes to the side across the line of dance.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise end of 4, up 5-6

figures.name: Closed Impetus and Feather Finish
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the left turning right, close the right foot and turn on the left heel, step side; then back on the right turning left, side, and forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward round him while he turns on his heel, side with a brush, then diagonally forward; then forward, side, and back as he steps outside you.
figures.mistake: Leaving the feet apart on the heel turn; close the right foot fully so the turn happens on the left heel.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise end of 2, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise end of 4, up 5-6, lower end of 6

figures.name: Natural Weave
figures.lead_cue: Natural turn start, then keep travelling back on the left as she steps outside, back, side, and forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Natural turn start with a heel turn, forward outside him, then forward, side, and back as he steps outside you.
figures.mistake: Stopping on the fourth step; the six quicks flow without a check.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, stay up through the quicks, lower end of the last quick
figures.sway: Right on 2, left on 4, right on 6-7

figures.name: Change of Direction
figures.lead_cue: Three slows: left forward turning left, right slightly forward with the right side leading, then left forward across the body.
figures.follow_cue: Three slows back, turning with him; keep the feet low.
figures.mistake: Rising; this figure stays level with no rise at all.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Basic Weave
figures.lead_cue: Six quicks: forward on the left turning left, side, back as she passes outside, back, side and forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, forward outside him on the right, forward, side, and back as he steps outside you.
figures.mistake: Letting the quicks get short and choppy; stay up on the toes and keep all six the same length.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-6, lower end of 6

figures.name: Basic Weave (Reverse Turn, Check & Weave)
figures.lead_cue: Begin a Reverse Turn, check backward on the right foot on the slow, then carry on into six weaving quicks that end outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Heel turn on the reverse turn, check forward on your left, then weave: back, side, forward outside him, forward, side, back.
figures.mistake: Rising on the check; stay down on that slow so the weave can start with a clean rise.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; no rise on 4; rise end of 5, up 6-10, lower end of 10
figures.sway: Left on 2-3, left on 6-7, right on 9-10

figures.name: Closed Telemark
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left starting to turn left, side on the right, then side and a little forward on the left, three quarters round in all.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, close the left beside it for a heel turn, then side and slightly back on the right.
figures.mistake: Swinging the man's second step wide; keep it close under the body so she can turn on her heel.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Open Telemark and Feather Ending
figures.lead_cue: Turn left on left, right and left into promenade, then cross the right forward in promenade, left to the diagonal, and right forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Heel turn on the second step, step forward into promenade on the right, cross the left forward, then come back to face him with side and back steps.
figures.mistake: Opening to promenade too early; she finishes her heel turn first and the couple opens on the third step.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise end of 4, up 5-6, lower end of 6

figures.name: Top Spin
figures.lead_cue: From outside partner, turn left and step back on the left, back on the right, side on the left and forward outside her on the right, all quicks.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the right outside him, forward on the left, side on the right and back on the left as he steps outside you.
figures.mistake: Leaning back as the man moves backward; keep the body over the feet so the rotation stays balanced.
figures.rise_fall: Up 1-4, lower end of 4

figures.name: Hover Feather
figures.lead_cue: Back on the left starting to turn right, heel pull with the right, then left diagonally forward and right forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the right, side on the left brushing the right foot in, then back on the right and back on the left as he passes outside.
figures.mistake: Placing the heel pull foot behind the left; it lands beside it, a little apart, so the rise can follow.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise end of 2, up 3-4, lower end of 4

figures.name: Hover Telemark
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left, rise as the right goes side and the left brushes in, then left side and a little forward, a quarter turn left in all.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, side on the left brushing the right foot in as you rise, then side and slightly back on the right.
figures.mistake: Rushing the hover; stay up through the brush for the whole quick before lowering on the third step.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Hover Telemark (to PP)
figures.lead_cue: As the Hover Telemark, but the third step goes diagonally forward with the left side leading, opening the couple into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side with a brush and a rise, then step side on the right into promenade, opening to your right.
figures.mistake: Pulling her into promenade with the arms; open with the body on the third step.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Natural Telemark
figures.lead_cue: Right forward turning right, left to the side, a small right side step finishing the turn, then left diagonally forward and right forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left, heel turn closing the right, side on the left with a brush, then back on the right and back on the left.
figures.mistake: Overstretching the man's side steps; a wide step pulls the lady off her heel turn.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-5, lower end of 5

figures.name: Hover Cross
figures.lead_cue: Turn right with right forward, left side, right side; step the left forward outside her on your left, rock back onto the right, then left side and right forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Heel turn, side on the left, back on the right with him outside, rock forward onto the left, then side on the right and back on the left.
figures.mistake: Dropping the rise on the rock; stay up on the toes from the second step to the last.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-7, lower end of 7
figures.sway: Right on 2, left on 4, right on 6-7

figures.name: Open Telemark, Natural Turn & Outside Swivel
figures.lead_cue: Open telemark to promenade, cross the right, turn right with left side and right back, then left back as she swivels to promenade, cross the right again, left diagonal and right outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Heel turn into promenade, cross the left, walk forward round him on the right and left, swivel to your right on the right foot into promenade, cross the left and finish side and back.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the crossed foot during the swivel; keep it light so the next step can go forward in promenade.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise end of 4, up 5-6, lower end of 6; no rise on 7; rise end of 8, up 9-10, lower end of 10

figures.name: Open Impetus
figures.lead_cue: Back on the left turning right, close the right for a heel turn, then left diagonally forward as you open to promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the right round him, side on the left with a brush, then side on the right into promenade.
figures.mistake: Opening the lady before the heel turn is complete; turn together first and open on the last step.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise end of 2, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Weave from PP
figures.lead_cue: Cross the right forward in promenade, left forward as she closes to you, then weave: right side, left back, right back, left side and right forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Cross the left forward in promenade, come round to face him on the right, then side, forward outside him, forward, side and back.
figures.mistake: Leaving her in promenade on the second step; close the hold as she comes round so the weave can begin.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-7, lower end of 7

figures.name: Reverse Wave
figures.lead_cue: Reverse turn start (left forward, right side, left back), then curve backward on right, left, right, back on the left again and heel pull to finish forward on the left.
figures.follow_cue: Heel turn at the start, then walk forward round him for five steps, side on the left and brush back on the right.
figures.mistake: Stepping straight back on the curving quicks; let each back step rotate slightly left so the wave curves.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; no rise on 4; rise end of 5, lower end of 6; no rise on 7-9
figures.sway: Left on 2-3, right on 5-6, left on 8

figures.name: Natural Twist Turn
figures.lead_cue: Right forward turning right, left side, cross the right behind on the and, twist round on both feet, settle onto the right, then left diagonally forward and right forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Heel turn on the second step, walk forward round him left and right, step side on the left with a brush, then back on the right and back on the left.
figures.mistake: Uncrossing the feet too early; let the twist unwind them while the weight stays between both feet.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1-4; rise end of 5, up 6-7, lower end of 7

figures.name: Natural Twist Turn (with Weave Ending)
figures.lead_cue: Natural twist turn up to the twist, settle on the right still turning, left side and slightly back, then the last five steps of the Natural Weave.
figures.follow_cue: Heel turn and walk round him, side and slightly back on the left, right diagonally forward, then the weave: forward, outside him, forward, side, back.
figures.mistake: Running out of rotation before the weave; keep turning through the settle so you are backing diagonal center.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1-4; rise end of 5, up 6-11, lower end of 11
figures.sway: Right on 2-3, left on 8, right on 10-11

figures.name: Natural Twist Turn (with Closed Impetus Ending)
figures.lead_cue: Natural twist turn through the settle, left side and slightly back, then back on the right turning left, left side and right forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Heel turn and walk round him, side with a brush, right diagonally forward, then forward, side and back.
figures.mistake: Losing the rise and fall at the end; lower on the sixth step, then rise again through the feather finish.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1-4; rise end of 5; lower end of 6; rise end of 7, up 8-9, lower end of 9
figures.sway: Right on 2-3, left on 5, right on 8-9

figures.name: Natural Twist Turn (with Open Impetus Ending)
figures.lead_cue: Natural twist turn through the settle, then left diagonally forward with the left side leading into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Heel turn, walk round him, side with a brush, then side on the right opening to promenade.
figures.mistake: Opening into promenade by pulling with the left arm; let the body rotation open the lady.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1-4; rise end of 5, up 6, lower end of 6

figures.name: Curved Feather to Back Feather
figures.lead_cue: Right, left, right forward curving to the right and outside her, then left back with her outside, right back and left back, still curving gently right.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back and back curving with him, then forward outside him, forward, and forward outside him again.
figures.mistake: Turning the back feather too sharply; it only curves a little more as you travel backward.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise end of 4, up 5-6, lower end of 6
figures.notes_for_beginners: On the chart the next figure begins with the man's right foot stepping back, so the Impetus figures that the site lists after it are reached through that linking step.

figures.name: Fallaway Reverse and Slip Pivot
figures.lead_cue: Left forward turning left, right back in fallaway, left back in fallaway, then slip the right foot back and pivot left to face diagonal wall.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, back on the left in fallaway, then a small right step back as you pivot strongly to your left to face him, finishing forward on the left.
figures.mistake: Letting the pivot travel; keep the slip step small and under the body so both can rotate on the spot.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; no rise on 4

figures.name: Natural Hover Telemark
figures.lead_cue: Right forward turning right, left side, heel pull with the right, hold the hover for a slow with the left knee turned in, then left diagonally forward and right forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Back with a heel turn, side on the left, brush the right foot in and hold, then back on the right and back on the left.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the left foot during the hover; it only touches the floor until the next step.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1; lower end of 2; rise end of 3; up 4-6; lower end of 6

figures.name: Bounce Fallaway with Weave Ending
figures.lead_cue: Left forward turning left, right and left back in fallaway with a small lowering and rising, right side, left back with her outside, then right back, left side and right forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, then left and right back in fallaway, come out of promenade with left side and right forward outside him, and finish forward, side and back.
figures.mistake: Making the bounce a hop; it is a soft lowering and rising through the knees with the feet on the floor.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, lower end of 2; rise end of 3; lower end of 4; rise end of 5, up 6-8, lower end of 8

figures.name: Walks (LF, RF)
figures.lead_cue: Two slow walks, heel first, curving very slightly left.
figures.follow_cue: Two slow walks back on the ball of the foot, then the heel.
figures.mistake: Rising onto the toes; tango walks stay level and grounded.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Basic Walks (Walk on Right Foot to Promenade)
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward on the right foot, then stop the body and set the left foot to the side without weight as you open her into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back on the left foot, then let your head and body open toward his right and rest the right foot to the side without weight.
figures.mistake: Shifting weight onto the left foot at the end: it only touches the floor, so the promenade figure that follows can start with it.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Progressive Side Step
figures.lead_cue: Quick, quick, slow: left forward across the body, right to the side, left forward again.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, back; stay compact in the hold.
figures.mistake: Taking the side step too wide; it is short and slightly back.

figures.name: Progressive Link
figures.lead_cue: Quick, quick: left forward, then right to the side and slightly back as you turn her into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Right back, then a short step side and back as your head snaps right.
figures.mistake: Opening into promenade with the arms; it is the body that turns her.

figures.name: Closed Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Slow side in promenade, quick through, quick side, slow close back into closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Side, through, turn to face him, close.
figures.mistake: Starting it from closed position; it needs promenade first (Progressive Link).

figures.name: Rock Turn (from the LF walk)
figures.lead_cue: Walk on the left, then forward on the right turning to the right, rock back onto the left and forward onto the right, take a short step back on the left, and finish back, side, close turning left.
figures.follow_cue: Two walks back, rock forward on the right and back on the left, a short step forward on the right, then forward, side, close.
figures.mistake: Turning the rock into a lunge: keep steps 3 and 4 small and let the knees, not the shoulders, make the rocking action.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Open Reverse Turn, Lady Outside
figures.lead_cue: Start toward diagonal centre and turn left over quick, quick, slow, stepping back on the left while she passes outside your right side; then back, side, close to face diagonal wall.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, then walk forward outside his right side on the slow; then forward, side, close as he finishes the turn.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet on step 3: he steps back past his left foot so that she can pass outside him.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Reverse Endings (Open Finish)
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right, swing round to the left onto a side step, then walk the right foot forward outside her right side on the slow.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the left, side on the right as the couple turns, then back on the left with him stepping outside you.
figures.mistake: Turning a full three-eighths on the side step: stop just short of it so the forward step can travel outside her.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Reverse Endings (Closed Finish to Promenade)
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right, turn left onto a short side step, close the right foot quickly on the and, then open her into promenade as the left foot rests to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, side and a quick close, then let your body open into promenade with the right foot resting to the side.
figures.mistake: Taking weight on the last step: the left foot must stay light to begin the promenade figure that follows.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Reverse Endings (Open Finish to Promenade)
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right, turn left onto the side step, step forward outside her on the right, then open into promenade with the left foot resting to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, side, back with him outside you, then open to promenade as the right foot touches to the side without weight.
figures.mistake: Rushing the last quick: let the step outside her land before opening her, or the promenade feels yanked.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Back Corte
figures.lead_cue: Slow back on the left, quick back turning left, quick side, slow close.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, forward, side, close.
figures.mistake: Looking down while going back; keep the frame and head steady.

figures.name: Open Reverse Turn, Lady In-Line
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left turning left, side on the right, then back on the left with her kept square in front of you; finish back, side, close to face diagonal wall.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, then close the left heel to the right heel and swivel on both heels, step forward on the right, then forward, side, close.
figures.mistake: Stepping back on the second step instead of closing the heels: her heel turn is what keeps her in line with him.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Progressive Side Step Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance a Progressive Side Step with a strong left turn, then add a checked right foot walk so you finish facing against the line of dance.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, back, then a short held step back on the left as he brings the couple round.
figures.mistake: Under-turning: the man needs three-eighths over the four steps, with the body turning a little more than the feet.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Open Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Slow side in promenade, quick through on the right, then square her up on the side step and walk the right foot forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Side, through, then come round to face him on the side step and step back as he passes outside your right side.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet as in the Closed Promenade: here the last step travels forward, outside her.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Back Rocks (Back Rock on Left Foot)
figures.lead_cue: Rock back onto the left with the left side leading, rock forward onto the right, then a short step back on the left, all without turning.
figures.follow_cue: Rock forward on the right, back on the left, then a short step forward on the right.
figures.mistake: Bending forward on the rock: keep the body upright and let the knees absorb the action.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Back Rocks (Back Rock on Right Foot)
figures.lead_cue: Rock back onto the right with the foot placed across the body line, rock forward onto the left, then a short step back on the right.
figures.follow_cue: Rock forward on the left, back on the right, then a short step forward on the left.
figures.mistake: Letting the rock drift sideways: the right foot goes straight back under the body, and the next step is usually a Back Corte.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Natural Twist Turn
figures.lead_cue: From promenade go side and through, turn right onto the left foot, cross the right behind with part weight, then twist round to the right on both feet as she walks around you, ending in promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Side and through, then walk forward round him (right, left, right) while he twists, and finish with a small side step back into promenade.
figures.mistake: Unwinding too early: keep the right foot crossed behind until she has passed outside you, then let the feet uncross with her last step.
footwork: B of RF, H of LF
R flat, IE of B of LF
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Natural Twist Turn (Overturned Twist)
figures.lead_cue: As the Natural Twist Turn, but keep turning on the untwist until you face the wall with her square in front of you, ready to step back on the left.
figures.follow_cue: Side and through, walk round him on right, left, right, and finish with a small side step facing him rather than opening into promenade.
figures.mistake: Opening into promenade by habit: the extra turn ends in closed hold, so the next figure starts backward for him.
footwork: B of RF, H of LF
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Natural Promenade Turn
figures.lead_cue: Side and through in promenade, then pivot strongly to the right on the left foot and walk the right foot forward, settling back into promenade with the left foot to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Side and through, step forward between his feet with the right as he brings you round, then a side step on the left into promenade.
figures.mistake: Letting her fall behind on the pivot: keep her in front of you so the couple rotates round a shared centre.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Natural Promenade Turn (Natural Promenade to Rock Turn)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Natural Promenade Turn without opening to promenade at the end, go straight into the rock (left back, right forward, left back) and finish back, side, close.
figures.follow_cue: Side, through, forward between his feet, then side and stay facing him for the rock forward and back, ending forward, side, close.
figures.mistake: Opening to promenade on step 4 by habit: stay in closed hold so the rock can start at once.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Promenade Link
figures.lead_cue: Slow side in promenade, quick through, then turn a little to the right and touch the left foot to the side as you bring her square to you.
figures.follow_cue: Side, through, then swivel to face him and touch the right foot to the side without weight.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the last step: the touch leaves the left foot free for the walk or side step that comes next.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Promenade Link (Lady Turning)
figures.lead_cue: Side and through in promenade, then keep your feet facing diagonal wall and turn only your body slightly left to draw her round in front of you as the left foot touches to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Side and through, then come a quarter round to face him, touching the right foot to the side without weight.
figures.mistake: Turning your own feet with her: only your body moves a little, while she does the quarter turn to come in front of you.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Promenade Link (Reverse Promenade Link)
figures.lead_cue: From a promenade aimed down the line of dance, step side, then through curving left toward diagonal centre, and touch the left foot to the side as she closes up in front of you.
figures.follow_cue: Side, then through, and come round to face him as the right foot touches to the side.
figures.mistake: Starting it from the usual diagonal-wall promenade: it needs a promenade aimed down the line of dance so the left curve ends toward diagonal centre.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Four Step
figures.lead_cue: Four quicks: forward on the left turning left, side on the right, back on the left with her outside you, then close the right foot as you open her sharply into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, forward outside him, then close the left foot as your head and body snap into promenade.
figures.mistake: Letting the close drift: it is slightly back, so the promenade opens without him moving away from her.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Four Step (Reverse Four Step)
figures.lead_cue: A Four Step that rotates strongly left: forward, side, back with her outside you, then a quarter more on the close into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, forward outside him as the couple rotates left, then close the left foot into promenade.
figures.mistake: Under-turning before the close: he needs half a turn over the first three steps or the promenade opens toward the wrong wall.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Back Open Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Side and through in promenade, turn right onto a side step, then step back on the right with her coming forward toward you, the body easing to the left.
figures.follow_cue: Side and through, a side step as you square up to him, then walk forward on the left.
figures.mistake: Stepping back too far on the slow: it is a controlled step that keeps her close, so the next figure can start at once.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Outside Swivel (method 1)
figures.lead_cue: With her outside you, step back on the left and let her swivel into promenade on the slow, your right foot crossing in front without weight; then through on the right and touch the left foot to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward outside him on the right and swivel into promenade, drawing the left foot in without weight; then through on the left and come back to face him.
figures.mistake: Rushing the swivel: it comes from her supporting foot, so give her the whole slow before going through.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Outside Swivel (method 2)
figures.lead_cue: Turn an eighth to the left as you step back on the left with her outside, sweep the right foot across in front without weight while she swivels into promenade, then go through and touch the left to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward outside him on the right and swivel into promenade, the left foot closing without weight; then through on the left and come back to face him.
figures.mistake: Taking weight on the sweeping right foot: it stays light until the step through.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Outside Swivel (Reverse Outside Swivel, method 3)
figures.lead_cue: Start a reverse turn with forward and side, then step back on the left with her outside and let her swivel into promenade; go through on the right and touch the left foot to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, then walk forward outside him and swivel into promenade on the slow, through on the left, and come back to face him.
figures.mistake: Losing the turn before the swivel: half a turn over the first three steps sets her up outside you.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Fallaway Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Side and through, keep rotating right as you step side and then back into fallaway, both of you travelling backward, and close the right foot slightly back in promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Side, through, forward on the right, then two steps back alongside him in fallaway and close into promenade.
figures.mistake: Breaking the hold in fallaway: keep the promenade V narrow so both backward steps travel together.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Four Step Change
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left turning left, side on the right, close the left foot, then a tiny step back on the right to change feet, all on quicks.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close, then a very small step forward on the left.
figures.mistake: Making the last step a full stride: it is tiny, just enough to change feet so the next figure can start on the left.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Brush Tap
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left curving left, side on the right, then brush the left foot in to the right and tap it out to the side, without weight both times.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, then brush the right foot in and tap it to the side, keeping your weight on the left.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the tap: both the brush and the tap are weightless, so the left foot stays free for the next figure.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Fallaway Four Step
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left, then open her into fallaway on the side step so you both go back on the third quick, and close the right foot in promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, side and back into fallaway, back again on the right beside him, then close the left foot in promenade.
figures.mistake: Opening the fallaway too late: the V must form on the second quick so the third step can travel back together.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Oversway
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left and rotate strongly left on the side step, then go back and to the side on the left, flex the left knee and stretch up and over it while the right leg stays extended.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, close the left heel to the right as the couple rotates, step forward and across on the right, then hold the stretched line with the head well to the left.
figures.mistake: Collapsing the frame: the line comes from the flexed supporting knee and a long, stretched body, not from dropping the arms.
footwork: H of LF, IE of B of RF
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Basic Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Quick quick slow turning left, crossing the left foot in front; then back, side, close. Three-quarters of a turn.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close; then forward, side, and close the left foot.
figures.mistake: Trying it after the left-foot walk; it follows a right-foot walk so the left is free.

figures.name: The Chase
figures.lead_cue: Side and through in promenade, then keep rotating right through a side step, a forward step outside her and a back step with her outside you, finishing with a small side step in promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Side and through, then side and back facing him, back with him outside you, forward outside him, and a side step into promenade.
figures.mistake: Letting the rotation stall on the outside steps: keep it going the whole way so the promenade at the end faces diagonal centre.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: The Chase (Chase with Fallaway Whisk Ending)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the first four steps of the Chase, step back on the left with her outside, chasse to the right while still rotating, then cross the left foot behind into fallaway, go through on the right and touch the left to the side in promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Begin as in the Chase, step forward outside him, chasse to the left, cross the right foot behind in fallaway, then go through and rest the right foot to the side in promenade.
figures.mistake: Crossing the whisk foot too far: it only tucks behind, so the step through stays easy.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: The Chase (Chase with Progressive Link Ending)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Chase as far as the chasse to the right, then finish with a Progressive Link: forward on the left and side on the right as you open her into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Begin as in the Chase, step forward outside him, chasse to the left, then back on the right and side on the left into promenade.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to square up after the chasse: the link needs closed hold for one quick before it opens.
footwork: IE of R, IE of B of L
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Fallaway Reverse and Slip Pivot
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left rotating left, then back on the right and left in fallaway as the turn continues, and slip the right foot back under you to pivot her into closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, back on the left and a small back step on the right in fallaway, then pivot on the left foot as it slips forward to face him.
figures.mistake: Making the slip a big step: the slipped foot passes close under the body so the pivot stays tight.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Five Step
figures.lead_cue: Forward, side and back on quicks with her outside you, a small step back on the right, then on the slow open her sharply into promenade with the left foot resting to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, forward outside him, a small step forward on the left, then open to promenade as the right foot touches to the side.
figures.mistake: Taking weight on the fifth step: it is a weightless placement, with the sharp head action on the slow.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Contra Check
figures.lead_cue: Check forward on the left across the body with flexed knees and the body turned left, recover onto the right, then open her into promenade as the left foot touches to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Step back on the right with flexed knees into the check, come forward onto the left, then open to promenade with the right foot to the side without weight.
figures.mistake: Throwing the check with the upper body: it is a firm action from the leg with the frame kept still.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Rock Turn
figures.lead_cue: Right forward turning right, rock back and forward, long step back, then back-side-close turning left.
figures.follow_cue: Back turning right, rock forward and back, forward, then forward-side-close.
figures.mistake: Rocking with the shoulders; the rock comes from the legs and the body stays still.

figures.name: Quarter Turn to Left (Heel Pivot)
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right turning left, bring the left heel back to it and pivot, change weight, then forward on the left.
figures.follow_cue: Forward turning left, side, close, back.
figures.mistake: Taking a big back step; the heel pivot needs a medium step so you can turn on the spot.
figures.rise_fall: Slight rise between 2 and 3

figures.name: Quarter Turn to Right
figures.lead_cue: Slow, quick, quick, slow: right foot forward starting to turn right, side, close, then side and slightly back.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left turning right, side, close, then a small step diagonally forward on the right.
figures.mistake: Making it flat; rise through the quicks and lower on the last slow.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, up 4, lower end of 4

figures.name: Progressive Chasse
figures.lead_cue: After a Quarter Turn to Right: back turning left, then a wide chasse side-close-side.
figures.follow_cue: Forward turning left, then side-close-side.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet loosely; the chasse feet touch on the close.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1 (no foot rise), up 2-3, up 4, lower end of 4
figures.notes_for_beginners: In the book the next step (right foot outside her) starts the following figure.

figures.name: Progressive Chasse (Checked Chasse)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Progressive Chasse, check forward on the right outside her, then take the left foot back to head down the new wall.
figures.follow_cue: Forward-side-close-side, step back on the left as he checks, then forward on the right outside him.
figures.mistake: Rising on the check; land on the right heel with soft knees so the change of direction stays smooth.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, up 4, lower end of 4; no rise on 5-6

figures.name: Forward Lock
figures.lead_cue: Right forward outside her, left forward, cross the right behind, left forward. Up on the toes for the lock.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back, cross the left in front, back.
figures.mistake: Crossing too loosely; the right foot locks tightly behind the left.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, up 4, lower end of 4

figures.name: Natural Turn
figures.lead_cue: Right forward turning right, side, close with a rise; then lower, step back on the left and pull the right heel beside it as you turn, and walk forward on the left.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close turning right, then forward on the right, side on the left around him and back on the right.
figures.mistake: Taking a big back step before the heel pull; keep it modest so the right foot can slide in beside the left.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; no rise on 4-6

figures.name: Natural Turn with Hesitation
figures.lead_cue: Natural turn forward-side-close, then back, heel pull the right foot beside the left and hold with the left foot free.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close turning right, then forward, side, and hold.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the last step; the left foot stays free for the Chasse Reverse Turn.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3, no rise on the heel pull

figures.name: Natural Pivot Turn
figures.lead_cue: Natural turn forward-side-close, then step back on the left and pivot right on the ball of the foot, the right foot held in front.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close turning right, then forward on the right between his feet and turn with him.
figures.mistake: Letting the right foot drift away on the pivot; keep it in front in CBMP with the knees close.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; no rise on 4
figures.notes_for_beginners: Danced here with the quarter-turn pivot used at a corner, so the man ends facing the new line of dance; along the side of the room the pivot can turn up to half a turn.

figures.name: Natural Spin Turn
figures.lead_cue: Natural turn forward-side-close, then pivot half a turn on the left foot, right forward and around, left to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close, then forward and spin with him, back on the left, and a small step diagonally forward on the right.
figures.mistake: Letting the feet split on the pivot; keep the right foot in front and the knees together.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise again end of 5, up 6, lower end of 6
figures.sway: Right on 2-3, none on the spin

figures.name: Natural Spin Turn (Underturned)
figures.lead_cue: As the Natural Spin Turn but pivot only three eighths and turn a quarter more over the last two steps, ending backing diagonal centre against the line of dance.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close, forward turning right with him, back on the left brushing the right to it, then diagonally forward on the right.
figures.mistake: Pivoting the full half turn out of habit; stop at three eighths so the figure fits the corner.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise end of 5, up 6, lower end of 6

figures.name: Chasse Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Left forward turning left, then side-close as you keep turning. Three-eighths of a turn.
figures.follow_cue: Back turning left, side, close.
figures.mistake: Under-turning; finish with your back to the line of dance.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Closed Impetus
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the left, draw the right foot back beside it and turn on the heel, then step to the side as she comes round you.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the right, swing round him to the side on the left brushing the right foot in, then diagonally forward on the right.
figures.mistake: Opening the feet during the heel turn; keep them together and parallel until the turn is done.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise end of 2, up 3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Back Lock
figures.lead_cue: With her outside you, back on the left, back on the right, lock the left over in front of the right, then right diagonally back.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the right outside him, forward on the left, cross the right behind the left, then left diagonally forward.
figures.mistake: Letting the lock open up; draw the crossing foot tight against the other on the toes.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1 (no foot rise), up 2-3, up 4, lower end of 4

figures.name: Reverse Pivot
figures.lead_cue: Take a small step back on the right and pivot left on its ball, holding the left foot in front.
figures.follow_cue: A small step forward on the left between his feet, turning left with him with the right foot held forward.
figures.mistake: Stepping too far back; a short step keeps you over the foot so the pivot is easy.
figures.rise_fall: No rise

figures.name: Progressive Chasse to Right
figures.lead_cue: Left forward turning gently left, then a chasse to your right, side-close-side, ending with her ready to step outside you.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right turning left, then side-close-side to your left, preparing to step forward outside him.
figures.mistake: Overturning the chasse; a quarter turn is enough to finish backing diagonal wall.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, up 4, lower end of 4

figures.name: Tipple Chasse to Right
figures.lead_cue: Back on the left turning right, side-close-side round the corner, then left forward, lock the right behind and left forward.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the right turning right, side-close-side, then back, cross the left in front and back.
figures.mistake: Lowering in the middle; stay up from the first quick to the last slow.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-7, lower end of 7

figures.name: Tipple Chasse to Right (Underturned)
figures.lead_cue: Back on the left, turn a quarter right into side-close, check on the right to the side, then lock forward towards diagonal centre.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the right, side-close turning right, check to the side on the left, then back, cross the left in front and back.
figures.mistake: Turning more than a quarter; the check on 4 faces the new line of dance before the lock.
figures.rise_fall: Slight rise 1-3, lower on 4 then rise, up 5-7, lower end of 7

figures.name: Running Finish
figures.lead_cue: Back on the left with her outside, turn right onto the right foot to the side, then run forward on the left, left side leading.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the right outside him, side on the left turning right, then back on the right with the right side leading.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet on the second step; they pass, so the figure keeps running down the room.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Natural Turn to Back Lock
figures.lead_cue: Natural turn forward-side-close, lower, then back on the left and dance the back lock: right back, left crossed in front, right diagonally back.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close turning right, then forward on the right, forward on the left, cross the right behind and left diagonally forward.
figures.mistake: Rushing from the close into the lock; take the full slow back on the left first.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise end of 4, up 5-7, lower end of 7

figures.name: Cross Chasse
figures.lead_cue: Left forward to diagonal wall, then side-close on the quicks, shifting her slightly so the next right step goes outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, then side-close to your left.
figures.mistake: Turning the chasse; it travels straight with no turn.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Change of Direction
figures.lead_cue: Three flat slows: left forward, right diagonally forward with the right side leading, then brush the left beside the right without weight as you turn a quarter left.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, diagonally back on the left, then draw the right to it without weight.
figures.mistake: Rising; keep the knees soft and the whole figure down.
figures.rise_fall: No rise

figures.name: Quick Open Reverse
figures.lead_cue: Left forward turning left, side on the right, then back on the left in CBMP as she steps outside you.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right turning left, side on the left, then forward on the right outside him.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet on the last quick; the left goes back past the right so she can pass outside.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Quick Open Reverse (Pivot)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Quick Open Reverse, then a small step back on the right and pivot left, the left foot held in front.
figures.follow_cue: After the Quick Open Reverse, a small step forward on the left and pivot left with him.
figures.mistake: Losing the CBMP on the pivot; keep the free foot in front of you.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; no rise on 4

figures.name: Quick Open Reverse (Progressive Chasse to Quick Open Reverse)
figures.lead_cue: Progressive Chasse ending facing diagonal centre, a slow right step outside her, then the Quick Open Reverse finished with a reverse pivot.
figures.follow_cue: Forward-side-close-side, back on the left as he steps outside, then the lady's Quick Open Reverse and pivot.
figures.mistake: Rising on the step outside partner; keep it flat so the reverse turn starts cleanly.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 4; no rise on 5; rise end of 6, up 7-8, lower end of 8; no rise on 9

figures.name: Fishtail
figures.lead_cue: Right forward outside her, cross the left behind as you turn slightly right, small step forward on the right, then left forward, lock the right behind and left forward.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left, cross the right in front, back on the left, then back, cross the left in front and back.
figures.mistake: Turning the hips square on the first cross; keep the body turned slightly right throughout.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-6, lower end of 6

figures.name: Fishtail (Technique Method 2)
figures.lead_cue: Check forward on the right outside her, rock back onto the left, turn a quarter right onto a small right step, then left forward, lock and left forward.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left as he checks, forward again on the right, back on the left, then back, cross the left in front and back.
figures.mistake: Rising on the check; the first step is flat, the rise starts on the weight change.
figures.rise_fall: No rise on 1, rise on 2, up 3-6, lower end of 6

figures.name: Four Quick Run
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right turning left, side on the left, then right forward outside her and a quick forward lock.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the left turning left, side on the right, back on the left, then back, cross the left in front and back.
figures.mistake: Lowering between the quicks; stay up from the second step to the last.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-6, lower end of 6

figures.name: V6
figures.lead_cue: Back lock from diagonal centre, then back on the left in CBMP, back on the right turning left and side on the left to face diagonal wall.
figures.follow_cue: Forward lock: forward, forward, cross the right behind, forward; then forward outside him, forward on the left and side on the right turning left.
figures.mistake: Turning during the lock; keep it straight and save the quarter turn for the last two quicks.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-4, lower end of 4; rise end of 5, up 6-7, lower end of 7

figures.name: Closed Telemark
figures.lead_cue: Left forward turning left, side on the right almost backing the line of dance, then left side and slightly forward to point diagonal wall.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, close the left to it and turn on the heel, then side and slightly back on the right.
figures.mistake: Rushing the heel turn; give her the whole second slow to close her feet and turn.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Cross Swivel
figures.lead_cue: Left forward with no rise, swivel a quarter left on it with the right foot drawn in without weight, then check forward on the right outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, draw the left in without weight as you turn left, then back on the left with him outside.
