figures.mistake: Putting weight on the closing foot; it only brushes in so you can step outside partner.
figures.rise_fall: No rise

figures.name: Six Quick Run
figures.lead_cue: Six even quicks: back on the right turning left, side, right outside her, then a forward lock.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the left turning left, side, back on the left, then back, cross the left in front and back.
figures.mistake: Letting the first quick become a slow; every step is one beat.
figures.rise_fall: Up 1-6, lower end of 6

figures.name: Rumba Cross
figures.lead_cue: A long left step forward, cross the right behind turning right, then side on the left and pivot to face the line of dance with the right foot held in front.
figures.follow_cue: A long right step back, cross the left in front, then forward on the right between his feet and turn right with him.
figures.mistake: Taking a short first step; it must be long so the cross and pivot have room.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Tipsy to Left
figures.lead_cue: Tiny side step on the left, half-close the right, then a small side step on the left with a sudden flex of the knees; the chart allows no turn, so keep square.
figures.follow_cue: Tiny side step on the right, half-close the left, then side on the right with a quick knee flex.
figures.mistake: Taking big steps; keep them small so the sharp drop on the last count is clear.
figures.rise_fall: Slight rise 1-2, lower end of 2, down on 3

figures.name: Tipsy to Right
figures.lead_cue: Take a tiny step right, draw the left halfway in, then step right again with a sudden soft knee dip; danced here with no turn.
figures.follow_cue: Tiny side step on the left, half-close the right, then side on the left with a quick knee flex.
figures.mistake: Letting the body lag behind the feet; keep the frame over the chasse.
figures.rise_fall: Slight rise 1-2, lower end of 2, down on 3

figures.name: Tipsy to Right (turning to left)
figures.lead_cue: Left forward, then the tipsy to your right: tiny side, half-close, side with a sharp knee flex.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, then tiny side on the left, half-close the right and side on the left with a knee flex.
figures.mistake: Adding a big turn; the chart gives none, or three eighths at most, so keep the body quiet.
figures.rise_fall: Slight rise end of 1, slight rise 2-3, lower end of 3, down on 4

figures.name: Hover Corte
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right turning left, rise and hover on the left foot to the side while the body keeps turning, then change weight back onto the right.
figures.follow_cue: Forward on the left, side on the right as you turn left and brush the left to it, then diagonally forward on the left.
figures.mistake: Dropping before the weight change; stay up through the hover and lower only at the end of 3.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Closed Changes (Natural to Reverse)
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the right, step the left forward as you curve a little to the right, then close the right. This ends facing line of dance with the left foot free for a Reverse Turn.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot back, right foot back curving a little to the right, then close the left. Keep travelling with him; the turn is only an eighth over the three steps.
figures.mistake: Braking on the close. Keep the body travelling so the Reverse Turn that follows starts with drive.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Closed Changes (Reverse to Natural)
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the left, step the right forward as you curve a little to the left, then close the left. This ends facing diagonal centre with the right foot free for a Natural Turn.
figures.follow_cue: Right foot back, left foot back curving a little to the left, then close the right. Stay in his frame and keep travelling; the turn is only an eighth over the three steps.
figures.mistake: Stopping the travel; keep moving down the room through the change.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Natural Turn
figures.lead_cue: Fast rotating turn to the right: forward-side-close, back-side-close, a full turn every six steps.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close, forward-side-close, staying close in the hold.
figures.mistake: Leaning back from your partner; stay connected through the body to rotate.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise end of 4 (no foot rise), body up 5-6, lower end of 6

figures.name: Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Fast turn to the left: forward, side, cross the left foot in front; then back, side, close. A full turn every six steps.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close; then forward, side, and cross the left foot in front.
figures.mistake: Not crossing on 3; the cross keeps the turn compact.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise end of 4 (no foot rise), body up 5-6, lower end of 6

figures.name: Closed Changes Backward (Natural to Reverse)
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the left, back on the right as you curve a little to the right, then close the left. It carries you from the first half of a Natural Turn toward the second half of a Reverse Turn.
figures.follow_cue: Right foot forward, left foot forward curving a little to the right, then close the right. You are the one moving forward, so travel through his space.
figures.mistake: A short first step back, so she walks into you. Take a real back step and keep the frame still.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1 (no foot rise), up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Closed Changes Backward (Reverse to Natural)
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the right, back on the left as you curve a little to the left, then close the right. It carries you from the first half of a Reverse Turn toward the second half of a Natural Turn.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot forward, right foot forward curving a little to the left, then close the left. You are the one moving forward, so travel through his space.
figures.mistake: Turning too much on the back steps; the change only curves an eighth, so keep it nearly straight.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1 (no foot rise), up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Contra Check
figures.lead_cue: Lower and check forward on a small left step in CBMP, rock back onto the right as you start to turn right, then a small left step back with the toe turned in and pivot to the right.
figures.follow_cue: Small step back on the right, rock forward onto the left, then the right foot forward between his feet as you pivot with him to the right.
figures.mistake: Making the check a big lunge. Keep the step small and stretch the left side upward instead.
figures.rise_fall: No rise

figures.name: Box Step
figures.lead_cue: Forward-side-close, back-side-close. Draw a square on the floor.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close, forward-side-close. Wait for the lead before the side step.
figures.mistake: Stepping side on 1 instead of forward; forgetting to close the feet on 3.

figures.name: Left Foot Closed Change
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left, side, close. Use it to switch to a right-foot figure.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, side, close.
figures.mistake: Dancing it with a turn. It travels straight down the line of dance.

figures.name: Right Foot Closed Change
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the right, side, close. The bridge from a Natural Turn into a Reverse Turn.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left, side, close.
figures.mistake: Skipping it and trying to start a Reverse Turn on the wrong foot.

figures.name: Natural Turn
figures.lead_cue: Right foot forward and start turning right. About 3/4 of a turn over six steps.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot back, side, close as you turn right with him, then forward-side-close on the outside of the turn.
figures.mistake: Starting it with the left foot. A natural (right) turn always starts on the right foot for the leader.

figures.name: Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Left foot forward and turn left. About 3/4 of a turn over six steps.
figures.follow_cue: Right foot back, side, close as you turn left with him, then forward-side-close around him.
figures.mistake: Following a Natural Turn directly. You need a Right Foot Closed Change in between.

figures.name: Whisk
figures.lead_cue: Forward, side, cross the left foot behind and open the follower into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Back, diagonally back, then cross the right foot behind as you turn your head right.
figures.mistake: Closing back to closed position after a Whisk. You end in promenade, so a Chasse from Promenade comes next.

figures.name: Left Box (Reverse) Turn
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the left and begin turning left, side, close; then back on the right, side, close, turning left through both halves. Rise through each half and lower on the close.
figures.follow_cue: Right foot back, side, close, then forward on the left, side, close, turning left with him the whole way.
figures.mistake: Turning only on the first step of each half. Spread the turn over all three counts so the close stays smooth.

figures.name: Right Box (Natural) Turn
figures.lead_cue: Mirror of the left box: forward on the right, side, close, then back on the left, side, close, turning right with a little turn on every count. Keep the frame steady so she turns with you.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot back, side, close, then forward on the right, side, close, turning right with him.
figures.mistake: Leaning into the turn. Stay upright and let the body rotate over the supporting foot.

figures.name: Closed Forward Changes
figures.lead_cue: Step forward, side, close on the left, then forward, side, close on the right, travelling along the line of dance with no turn. Lower on the first step of each change and rise on 2 and 3.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close on the right, then back, side, close on the left, staying in front of him.
figures.mistake: Taking big, rushed steps on count 1. Keep the first step modest so the side and close have room.

figures.name: Closed Backward Changes
figures.lead_cue: Dance two changes backing down the line of dance: back, side, close on the left, then back, side, close on the right. Open your side steps just slightly backward.
figures.follow_cue: The same changes going forward: step forward, side, close on the right, then forward, side, close on the left.
figures.mistake: Leaning back as you reverse. Keep your weight over the standing leg and reach the step behind you.

figures.name: Six-Count Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance a backward change, then raise your left hand as you step forward beside her and let her walk a right-hand turn under it. Lower the hand to return to closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward in a right-hand turn under his raised arm for the first three steps, then step beside him and finish in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Pulling her around with the arm. Raise the hand early and keep it still while she walks the turn.

figures.name: Hesitations (Forward & Back)
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the left, draw the right foot up without weight and pause through the bar; then step back on the right, draw the left up and pause. Rise gently on the pause.
figures.follow_cue: Step back on the right, draw the left foot to it and pause; then step forward on the left, bring the right up and pause.
figures.mistake: Rushing through the pause. Stay on the rise for the full second and third counts and keep the free foot light.

figures.name: Hesitations (Side)
figures.lead_cue: Step to the left, bring the right foot in without weight and hold; then step right, close the left and hold. Keep the steps small and the frame still.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: step right, draw the left in and pause; then step left, draw the right in and pause.
figures.mistake: Swaying the upper body instead of the feet. Keep the shoulders level and let the step carry the weight.

figures.name: Side Whisks
figures.lead_cue: Step to the side, cross the free foot behind with a little weight and replace it, then do the same to the other side. Rise on the second count and keep your body upright.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror his steps: step right, cross the left foot behind and replace; then step left, cross right behind and replace.
figures.mistake: Crossing too far behind and losing balance. Let the foot slide just behind the standing foot and return smoothly.

figures.name: Side Whisks to PP & CPP
figures.lead_cue: Side, cross behind and replace in promenade; the same steps in counter promenade; and then back into promenade, adjusting the angle of your body a little each time. Keep the head position strong throughout.
figures.follow_cue: Step with the opposite feet, side, cross behind and replace, with your head and shoulders opening into promenade, counter promenade and promenade again.
figures.mistake: Letting the angle change the footwork. Keep the same small side-cross-replace pattern and only change the angle of your shoulders.

figures.name: Open Break & Underarm Turn to Right
figures.lead_cue: Step aside and break away from her with a small back rock and replace, then step side and back as you raise your left hand and lead her to turn right underneath it. Close the hold again at the end.
figures.follow_cue: Step side, rock back and replace, then walk forward and turn right underneath his raised left hand, finishing facing him in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Raising the hand too late. Lift it on the fourth step so she has room to travel under it.

figures.name: Forward Changes O.P.
figures.lead_cue: Dance four forward changes, stepping forward outside her on alternate sides. Alternate sides each change and lead the small turns with your body rather than your feet.
figures.follow_cue: Step back on the opposite feet through four changes, keeping your body in contact with his as the line of travel weaves a little left and right.
figures.mistake: Pulling her around the corners. Keep contact in the frame and let the figure weave gently.

figures.name: Backward Changes O.P.
figures.lead_cue: Start with the first half of a left box turn, then dance three backward changes, stepping back outside her on alternate sides. Let your body turn between the changes.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the first half of a left box turn, then step forward through three changes beside him on alternating sides.
figures.mistake: Over-turning on the box and arriving in the wrong line. Turn only about a quarter before the first change.

figures.name: Cross-Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the right, then side and close while you turn left, leading her to walk across in front of you. Stay level so she can pass.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on the left, step through to promenade with the right, and cross forward in front of him with the left, then swivel left to finish facing him.
figures.mistake: Pulling her across with the arm. Move your body out of the way and let her walk the line.

figures.name: Open Cross-Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right, then side and close on the left foot turned out as you turn left, and lead her across in front of you to finish facing her without contact.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on the left, step on the right slightly across and cross forward on the left, then swivel left to end facing him without contact.
figures.mistake: Dragging her through. Draw your own feet out of her path and let her walk past.

figures.name: Twinkle
figures.lead_cue: Step forward, side and close into promenade, then step through across her in promenade and finish side and close in closed hold. Open your shoulders to the promenade on the first half and square up on the second.
figures.follow_cue: Step back, diagonally back and close as you open into promenade, then step forward through and finish side and close, turning back to face him.
figures.mistake: Closing the promenade too soon. Keep the head and shoulders open through the crossing step and square off on the side step.

figures.name: Back Twinkle
figures.lead_cue: Step back, diagonally back and close into promenade, then cross through and finish with a side-close. Keep her on your right as you open the line.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward outside him, side and close into promenade, then cross forward, side and close back into closed hold.
figures.mistake: Dropping the shoulder when reversing. Keep the frame level and travel back along the diagonal.

figures.name: Promenade Chasse
figures.lead_cue: Step through in promenade, then dance a quick side-close-side and bring her back to face you. Keep the steps even and the frame lifted.
figures.follow_cue: Step through on the left, then side-close-side on the right, left, right, turning to face him as you finish.
figures.mistake: Dancing the chasse at the wrong time. Make the second and third counts quick, with a half beat each.

figures.name: Twinkles to PP and CPP
figures.lead_cue: Dance four twinkle steps, crossing through promenade, counter promenade and promenade again before closing the hold. Swing the shoulders to each side so the line changes direction.
figures.follow_cue: Step back, diagonally back and close, then forward across, side and close in promenade, counter promenade, promenade and back to closed hold.
figures.mistake: Pushing the changes of direction with the arms. Move your body line from the hips and keep the hold calm.

figures.name: Twinkles to PP and CPP (Progressive)
figures.lead_cue: Turn slightly left over the first bar, then dance the remaining twinkles progressively down the line, crossing through promenade and counter promenade. Keep the line straight after the first bar.
figures.follow_cue: Step back, diagonally back and close, then dance the crossing steps with him in promenade and counter promenade, finishing in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Turning on the later twinkles. After the first bar, keep travelling straight and only change the angle of the shoulders.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance side, cross behind alternately while rotating to the right on a small spot, about a turn and a quarter over the six steps. Keep your frame stable so she walks between your feet.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward between his feet on right, left, right, left, right, left, turning right with him and keeping your steps close to the spot.
figures.mistake: Stepping out of the spot. Keep the crossing foot close behind and rotate evenly around a central point.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn (from Open Break)
figures.lead_cue: Break open with a side step, a small back rock and a replace, then close in and dance two spot-turn steps to the right. Bring her back to your frame as she steps between your feet.
figures.follow_cue: Step side, rock back and replace, then walk forward between his feet on the right and left as you turn right to rejoin him in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Starting the spot turn before the rock is finished. Replace completely, then step side and turn.

figures.name: Underarm Turn to Left (from Closed)
figures.lead_cue: Step back, side and close while you raise your left hand and lead the lady to spiral to her left underneath it. Lower the hand and rejoin her in closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward, then spiral left on the second count under his raised hand and finish with a forward step and a left pivot, ending facing him in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Raising the arm too late. Lift the hand on count 1 so she has the space to spiral through.

figures.name: Underarm Turn to Left (from Promenade)
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, step through, then side and close while you raise your left hand and lead her into a left underarm turn with a spiral. Lower the hand as she finishes in front of you.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward on the left, spiral left under his raised hand on the second count, then step forward and pivot left to finish facing him in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Overturning the shoulders on the crossing step. Stay open to the line of dance until she starts to turn.

figures.name: Cross-Body Lead to Underarm Turn to Left
figures.lead_cue: Dance a cross-body lead so she passes in front of you, then step forward, side and close as you raise your left hand and lead her into a left underarm turn. Lower the hand once she has finished.
figures.follow_cue: Walk across in front of him, then spin left under his raised hand for the second three steps, finishing facing him in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Turning her too early. Complete the cross-body lead first, then raise the hand for the underarm turn.

figures.name: Side-by-Side Changes
figures.lead_cue: Open into counter promenade and walk forward beside her, closing the feet; then walk forward on the other foot and close back to face her. Both partners turn in opposite directions through each half.
figures.follow_cue: Step side into counter promenade, forward beside him and close, turning left; then forward, side and close, turning right back to face him.
figures.mistake: Pulling away from each other in the open shapes. Keep eye contact and equal step sizes.

figures.name: Side-by-Side Changes Backward
figures.lead_cue: Open into fallaway and step back beside her, turning left, then step back on the other foot and turn right to face her again. Keep a light contact while you travel backward.
figures.follow_cue: Step side into fallaway, back beside him and close while turning right, then back, side and close turning left to face him.
figures.mistake: Stepping back too far and losing the connection. Take small backward steps and keep your hands level.

figures.name: Continuity Runs (Feather Step)
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward on the right, left and right, passing the feet without closing, and place the last step outside her on your right side. Let your body rise gently through the bar.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back on the left, right and left, staying with him and keeping your frame lifted.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet on the second step. Silver continuity steps pass the feet and keep the movement flowing.

figures.name: Continuity Runs (Three Step)
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward on left, right and left in a straight line, keeping the steps even and the frame steady.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back on right, left and right, matching the length of his steps.
figures.mistake: Making the third step shorter. All three steps should be the same length so the bar flows.

figures.name: Open Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance a left turn in two halves: forward, side and back outside her on the left foot, then back, side and forward outside her on the right foot. The steps pass rather than close.
figures.follow_cue: Step back, side and forward outside him, then forward, side and back, turning left with him all the way.
figures.mistake: Closing on the third and sixth steps. Pass the feet to keep the open, travelling feel.

figures.name: Open Natural Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance a right turn in two halves: forward outside her, side and back, then back, side and forward on the left foot. Pass the feet and let the turn flow.
figures.follow_cue: Step back, side and forward, then forward outside him, side and back, turning right with him.
figures.mistake: Turning from the feet. Rotate the body first and let the feet follow it.

figures.name: Open Natural Turn (from PP)
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, step forward and begin turning right, then side and back, rejoining her in closed hold. Close the hold as you start to turn.
figures.follow_cue: Step through on the left, then forward on the right and the left, turning right with him into closed hold.
figures.mistake: Starting the turn too early. Keep the promenade line until the first step is complete.

figures.name: Brush Twinkle
figures.lead_cue: Dance a twinkle in which the left foot brushes toward the right on the second step and then passes into promenade, then cross through and finish outside her. Keep it light and travelling.
figures.follow_cue: Step back, diagonally back with a brush of the right foot, then side into promenade, cross forward, side and back outside him.
figures.mistake: Stopping on the brush. It is a continuing action that passes straight into the next step.

figures.name: Back Twinkle (Silver)
figures.lead_cue: Step back outside her, diagonally back with a brush, then pass into promenade and cross through to finish outside her. Keep the line open towards the promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward outside him, side with a brush, then side into promenade, cross forward, side and back.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet on the second step. Brush and pass so the step carries on.

figures.name: Back Twinkle (Natural)
figures.lead_cue: Step back outside her and turn right on the close of the heel turn, then pass into promenade, cross through and finish outside her. Keep your frame steady during the turn.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward outside him, side with a brush as you turn right, then side into promenade, cross forward, side and back.
figures.mistake: Turning too early. Keep the heel turn on the second step.

figures.name: Back Twinkle (Reverse)
figures.lead_cue: Step back outside her, back again, and turn left on the side step into promenade, then cross through and finish outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward outside him, forward again, and side into promenade, then cross forward, side and back.
figures.mistake: Rushing the quarter turn. Complete it on the side step before crossing.

figures.name: Hover Corte (from PP)
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, step through, then side and replace while you turn right and take her into a lifted finish. Rise on the second step and let the body turn do the work.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward through, then side with a brush, and finish forward on the left, turning left as you rise and then step outside him.
figures.mistake: Rushing the turn on the side step. Let the rise lead and turn on the replace.

figures.name: Passing Changes Forward
figures.lead_cue: Dance a chain of passing changes: forward, side-forward and side-forward steps, brushing the free foot and swapping which side you lead outside her. The last bar is a feather step with no turn.
figures.follow_cue: Step back, diagonally back and diagonally back in passing changes, keeping your head lifted and staying with him as the body angle changes.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet at the end of each change. In passing changes the feet cross past each other without stopping.

figures.name: Passing Changes Forward (Narrow Passing Change)
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward on the left, right and left with a slight turn right on the second step, and prepare to step outside her. It is the compact three-step version of the passing change.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back on the right, left and right, keeping your steps narrow and your frame lifted.
figures.mistake: Splaying the feet. Keep the steps narrow and tracking forward in a line.

figures.name: Passing Changes Back
figures.lead_cue: Open with a forward, side and back step, then dance backing passing changes with brushes, changing sides each bar, and finish with a side and forward step outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror his steps: back, side and forward outside him, then forward passing changes, finishing with a back step.
figures.mistake: Letting the backward steps get too long. Keep them modest so she can stay in contact.

figures.name: Syncopated Underarm Turn to Right (from O.P.)
figures.lead_cue: Step back outside her, then side-close-side in quick time as you raise your left hand and circle it over her head, leading her to turn right underneath it. Lower the hand as she finishes and take hold again.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward outside him, then turn right under his raised left hand in a quick side-forward-side pattern, finishing facing him.
figures.mistake: Pulling her round with the arm. Raise the hand early and let her own steps carry her under it.

figures.name: Syncopated Underarm Turn to Right (from Open CPP)
figures.lead_cue: From open counter promenade, step through, then side-close-side in quick time as you circle your left hand over her head, leading her to turn right under it. Lower the hand as she completes the turn.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward in counter promenade, then turn right under his raised left hand with quick side-forward-side steps, finishing facing him.
figures.mistake: Lifting the hand after she has begun to turn. Raise it on the first step so she can travel freely.

figures.name: Twinkles to PP and CPP (Silver)
figures.lead_cue: Dance a chain of four silver twinkles through promenade, counter promenade and promenade, brushing the feet instead of closing, then lead her back to closed hold on the last three steps.
figures.follow_cue: Step back, diagonally back with a brush, then forward across and side in each twinkle, finishing with a side and a step back outside him.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet at the end of each twinkle. Brush and pass so the movement keeps flowing.

figures.name: Promenade & Counter Promenade Runs (Natural)
figures.lead_cue: Dance a feather-like start into promenade, then turn right through closed position into counter promenade, pass her across, and return to promenade to finish outside her. Lead each change with your body, not the arms.
figures.follow_cue: Step back with a brush into promenade, step through, then pass in front of him and turn right to counter promenade, returning to promenade and closed hold at the end.
figures.mistake: Over-rotating through the right turn. Turn about three-quarters in total and keep the steps compact.

figures.name: Promenade & Counter Promenade Runs (Reverse)
figures.lead_cue: Dance progressive twinkles through promenade and counter promenade, then turn left through closed position, step back to promenade, and finish outside her. Keep the turn smooth and the steps even.
figures.follow_cue: Step back, diagonally back and close, then dance the crossing steps and turn left with him before returning to promenade and closed hold.
figures.mistake: Rushing the left turn through the middle of the figure. Turn gradually over three steps.

figures.name: PP & CPP Runs with Lady's Turn
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, step forward and pass back with a diagonal step while you lead her to turn left, finishing with a side-back step in counter promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Cross forward through promenade, take a very small back step on the right and turn left on it, then step side and forward to finish in counter promenade.
figures.mistake: Letting her turn without room. Increase the tone in your right arm and open your hand so she has space.

figures.name: Promenade Release (Lady Around Man)
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, step through and replace as you lead her to circle left in front of you, then step side and release into open counter promenade. Extend your arm forward and left to guide her.
figures.follow_cue: Step through on the left, step diagonally back and circle left around him, then step side and forward to finish in counter promenade.
figures.mistake: Dragging her around. Extend the arms and let her walk the arc.

figures.name: Promenade Release (Man Around Lady)
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, step forward and circle right around her with a diagonal back step, then step side and release into open counter promenade. Keep your eyes on her as you pass.
figures.follow_cue: Step through on the left, replace weight on the right, then step side and forward to finish in counter promenade as he circles round you.
figures.mistake: Rushing round her. Take a clear, steady arc and keep the frame in front of you.

figures.name: Closing Twinkle (Lady Closing to Man)
figures.lead_cue: From open counter promenade, step through and draw her across in front of you into closed hold, then pass through promenade and finish outside her. Use your left arm to guide her closing.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward, side with a brush while you pass around him, then step side into promenade, cross through and finish with a back step outside him.
figures.mistake: Pulling her in. Contract your left arm gently and let her walk across to you.

figures.name: Closing Twinkle (Man Closing to Lady)
figures.lead_cue: From open counter promenade, step forward and circle left around her through closed position, then cross through promenade and finish outside her. Keep her within your frame as you pass.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward, forward again with a small step between his feet, then step diagonally forward into promenade, cross through, side and back outside him.
figures.mistake: Swinging around her too fast. Keep the circle steady and the frame lifted.

figures.name: Outside Check & Develope (in LSP)
figures.lead_cue: Step forward outside her on the left and check, holding your weight on that foot through the next two beats while you sway to the left and lift her free leg. Then step back, side and forward to finish outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Step back and draw the left foot to the right, lift the left knee and extend the leg in a develope, then lower it. Finish with a forward, side and back step turning left with him.
figures.mistake: Collapsing in the middle of the figure. Keep your standing leg flexed and your frame lifted through the check.

figures.name: Wing
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, step through and begin to draw the left foot to the right without weight, turning your body left to lead her forward into left side position. Finish closing the foot on the last beat.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward through promenade, then walk forward on the right and the left, turning left and passing outside him to finish in left side position.
figures.mistake: Stepping on the closing foot. Stay on the right foot until the end of the bar.

figures.name: Weave
figures.lead_cue: Dance a continuous left turn in two bars: forward outside her, forward and side-back, then back outside her, back and side-forward. Pass the feet and keep your body turning smoothly.
figures.follow_cue: Step back outside him, back and side-forward, then forward outside him, forward and side-back, turning left with him.
figures.mistake: Turning from the feet. Rotate from the body and let the passing steps follow it.

figures.name: Natural Pivots
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, step through and pivot to the right on the left foot, step forward and pivot again, finishing forward into promenade. Rotate from the body and keep both partners close to the turn's centre.
figures.follow_cue: Step through on the left, forward on the right and pivot back on the left, then forward, back with a brush, and step side back into promenade.
figures.mistake: Pivoting by swinging the free leg. Keep the foot under the body and turn on the ball of the foot.

figures.name: Slip Pivot
figures.lead_cue: Slip back on the right and left in fallaway, then step back again on the right and pivot left, leading her to close and pivot with you. Keep your frame level as you turn.
figures.follow_cue: Step back on the left in fallaway, slip back on the right with a half pivot to face him, then step forward and pivot to finish in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Pivoting too early. Complete the two back steps before the pivot starts.

figures.name: Promenade Check & Slip Pivot
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, step through and check, then back in fallaway and back again with a pivot to the left, leading her to close and pivot with you. Keep your knees flexed on the check.
figures.follow_cue: Step through on the left and check, slip back on the right with a half pivot to face him, then forward on the left and finish pivoting into closed hold.
figures.mistake: Rushing the check. Sit into the checked foot before you move on the second step.

figures.name: Criss Cross Changes
figures.lead_cue: From open facing, step across her and lead her under your raised left hand from your left to your right, then back again, then across a third time. Raise the hand early and keep your steps tidy behind her.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward past his side and turn left under his raised hand, then turn the other way to face him, then once more to the left under the hand.
figures.mistake: Walking into her space. Raise the arm early and keep your own steps small so she can cross.

figures.name: Waltz Variation 1
figures.lead_cue: Dance a left box half, a slip pivot and a left-turning rock into promenade, then release her to your left for a side-by-side chasse and check. Lead her left underarm turn, pass through counter promenade, and finish with a promenade chasse and close.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the box half and slip pivot with him, turn left in a spiral as he releases you into side by side, dance the chasse and check, then turn left under his raised hand again and finish through promenade chasse and close.
figures.mistake: Losing the thread in the long middle section. Count the bars: box and pivot, rock into promenade, side-by-side chasse, check, release, promenade chasse and close.

figures.name: Waltz Variation 5
figures.lead_cue: Dance a feather-like start into promenade, pass in front of her under your raised hand, dance side cross-replace whisks while she walks behind you, then take eight circling runs outside her. Finish with a whisk and a left underarm closing, in closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right and walk through the promenade, step behind him on the whisks as you travel round his back, run eight small steps round him in a turn to the right, then finish with the whisk and close into hold.
figures.mistake: Rushing the circling runs. Keep each run small and the frame steady so you travel round together in the middle of the room.

figures.name: Tango Walks
figures.lead_cue: Two slow walks, curving slightly left, feet placed with purpose.
figures.follow_cue: Two slow walks back, staying connected in the frame.
figures.mistake: Rising on the toes. Tango stays level.

figures.name: Progressive Link
figures.lead_cue: Quick-quick: left forward across your body, then a short right step out to the side, a little back, as you turn her into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Right back across your body, then a short left step out to the side, a little back, as your head snaps right.
figures.mistake: Dancing a Closed Promenade without the Link first.

figures.name: Left Rock Turn
figures.lead_cue: Forward turning left, rock back and forward, back, then side-close. About half a turn left.
figures.follow_cue: Back, rock forward and back, forward, side, close.
figures.mistake: Making the rock big; it is a small weight change, almost in place.

figures.name: Basic (Walks + Tango Close)
figures.lead_cue: Two slow walks, then forward, side and a close without weight on quick, quick, slow. Curve gently left and keep the knees flexed.
figures.follow_cue: Two slow walks back, then back, side and a close without weight on the last slow count.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the drawn foot. The same foot stays free for the next figure.

figures.name: 6-Count Basic (6-Count Basic)
figures.lead_cue: Walk, walk, then forward and side on quick, quick, turning gently left. There is no closing step, so the right foot is the one that takes weight last.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back twice, then back and side on the quicks, turning gently left with him.
figures.mistake: Waiting for a close at the end. Here the figure stops on the side step, so go straight on to the next figure.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: 6-Count Basic (16-Count Basic)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the walks, walks, quick, quick pattern twice, curving left, and finish with a forward Tango Close. The whole phrase lasts sixteen beats.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back, back, back, side twice with him, and finish with back, side and a close without weight.
figures.mistake: Turning too early. Spread the curve over both halves so you travel around the room instead of spinning on the spot.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Progressive Rocks
figures.lead_cue: Step forward, rock your weight back onto the other foot without it travelling far, then walk forward on a slow. Repeat the rock on the other foot.
figures.follow_cue: Step back, rock your weight forward, then walk back on the slow. Keep your frame as he moves, and do the same on the other side.
figures.mistake: Letting the rock become a big sway. Keep it small and fast, only a quick change of weight.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Corte
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the left with a check and a soft knee, recover forward onto the right on a second slow, then finish with the walk-side-close of the basic.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward on the right into the check, recover back onto the left, and then dance back, side and a close without weight.
figures.mistake: Bending forward at the waist in the dip; bend the standing knee and keep the frame upright.

figures.name: Promenade with Left Swivel
figures.lead_cue: Side step along the line of dance in promenade, then step through and square the body to the feet to close the hold, finishing with the forward Tango Close.
figures.follow_cue: Side step in promenade, step forward across, and swivel left on that foot as he squares up, then back, side and close.
figures.mistake: Staying open after the through step. Turn the body back to the feet at the end of the second slow to close up.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Promenade with Right Turn
figures.lead_cue: Side step in promenade, close up to her on the through step and turn right, stepping back and then side while you rotate three-quarters of a turn.
figures.follow_cue: Side step, then step across and forward between his feet, and swing around him to end backing diagonal centre.
figures.mistake: Turning from step 1. Keep the first slow in promenade and start turning only on the through step.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Closed Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Slow side step along the line of dance in promenade, quick step across, quick side step turning to face her, slow close back to closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Side step in promenade, quick step across, then a quick side step turning to face him and a slow close.
figures.mistake: Starting it from closed position. It needs promenade (use a Progressive Link).

figures.name: Open Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Side step and step across in promenade, then turn slightly right on the side step and walk the right foot forward outside her right side.
figures.follow_cue: Side step and step across, then side step turning a little left, and finish with a back step while he walks outside you on your right.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet on the last step. Walk the right foot outside her so that the next figure can start on the left.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Open Left Turn (Open Left Turn)
figures.lead_cue: Start forward and turn left, stepping back with her outside your right side, then back, side and close to finish the turn left.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, then walk forward outside his right side on the slow, followed by forward, side and close as the turn finishes.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet on step 3. Step back past the standing foot so she has room to walk outside you.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Open Left Turn (Open Finish)
figures.lead_cue: Turn left over the first five steps and finish by walking the right foot forward outside her right side on the slow.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the same turn and finish with a back step as he walks outside you on your right.
figures.mistake: Turning too much on the side step. Stop just short so the last step travels outside her.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Outside Swivels (Slow Outside Swivels)
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the left with her outside you, then step across in promenade while squaring up, as she swivels right then left on her forward steps.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward outside him and swivel right while pointing the free foot, then walk forward in promenade and swivel left.
figures.mistake: Turning the whole body with her swivel. Only your upper body gives a slight turn so her swivel is her own.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Outside Swivels (Slow and Quick Swivels)
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the left with a check on the slow, hold through two quick body cues, step across in promenade with a check on the second slow, then cue two more quicks with the body.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward outside him and swivel on the slow, take two very small quick steps with a swivel each, then walk forward in promenade with another slow swivel and two more small quick steps.
figures.mistake: Rushing the quicks. Keep the cues light and tiny so her swivels stay crisp.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Open Left Turn to Outside Swivel
figures.lead_cue: Dance the first three steps of the Open Left Turn, then step across in promenade while she swivels; repeat the pattern once more and end with a forward Tango Close.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, forward outside him with a swivel, then forward in promenade with a swivel; repeat, and finish with back, side and a close.
figures.mistake: Turning too quickly on the first steps. Spread the three-eighths turn over the rock-and-back pattern so the swivels stay clear.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Left-Turning Rock
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the left, turning slightly left, then rock back onto the right with the body still turning left.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back on the right, then forward on the left, turning slightly left with him.
figures.mistake: Making it big. It is a small, quick rock, almost on the spot.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Rock to Corte
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward and back, check back into a corte on a slow, and replace on the second slow; dance it twice and finish with a forward Tango Close.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back and forward, check forward on a slow and replace; repeat, then back, side and close.
figures.mistake: Dipping from the waist at the check. Bend the standing knee and keep the frame upright.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Promenade Pivot (Overturned Ending)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the pivot on steps 1 to 4, then keep turning round her in closed hold and step side and slightly back on the last slow.
figures.follow_cue: Side step, step across and pivot round him turning right; on the last slow step diagonally forward as he turns you on in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Opening to promenade on the last step. Here you stay closed and turn farther round her.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Underarm Turn to Right from Side-by-Side (Tango Close Ending)
figures.lead_cue: From side-by-side, step across in front of her toward her left side and curve left, ending in closed hold with a forward Tango Close.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward toward his left side, then swing round into closed hold and finish with a close without weight.
figures.mistake: Letting go of the hand early. Keep the joined hands steady until you are facing each other again.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Walks in Open Left Side Position
figures.lead_cue: From a left-hand to right-hand open hold, walk forward outside her left side on the first walk and the third step, then side and close without weight.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back with him on the opposite feet, keeping the joined hands steady, and close the free foot without weight at the end.
figures.mistake: Dragging her along by the hands. Keep a firm frame in the arms and let the walks travel together.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Left Cross Turn (Left Cross Turn)
figures.lead_cue: Step forward, side, then cross the left foot in front of the right while turning left; continue with back, side and a close.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back, side and close with him, then forward, side and a crossing step in front as he turns you.
figures.mistake: Crossing too far. The crossing step should land close to the standing foot so the turn stays compact.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Natural Turn from Promenade (Natural Turn from Promenade)
figures.lead_cue: Side step and step across in promenade, then turn right on a side-and-back step and walk back on the right foot with her stepping outside you.
figures.follow_cue: Side step, step across, then walk forward round him as he turns right, and finish with a forward step on the left.
figures.mistake: Turning too early. Take the first two steps along the line of dance and begin the turn on step 3.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Natural Turn from Promenade (Natural Turn to Quick Tango Close)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the first three steps of the natural turn from promenade, then back, back, side and a quick close without weight.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the same turning start, then forward, forward, side and a quick close without weight.
figures.mistake: Slowing down the second half. All four closing steps are quicks, so keep them small and tidy.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Cobra Fans
figures.lead_cue: Step back and to the left while the right foot reaches back, then step forward into promenade; repeat both steps with the second forward step crossing in promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward in a fan with the left foot reaching, then step forward across in promenade; repeat the pair.
figures.mistake: Reaching with the supporting leg bent. Keep the standing knee flexed and fan the free leg smoothly.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Change of Places (Change of Places)
figures.lead_cue: In left side-by-side hold, step left and close, step left again, then step right, close and step right, so you and she swap sides.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward and across to his other side on the quicks, then side on the slow, and return in the same pattern.
figures.mistake: Dragging her across. Take small, quick steps and let the joined hands guide her path.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Change of Places (Change of Places to Left Side Pos.)
figures.lead_cue: From right side-by-side hold, step across with the right foot toward her side, close and take a side step with the right foot to finish in left side-by-side.
figures.follow_cue: Move to the other side of him in three steps, ending in left side-by-side position.
figures.mistake: Crossing the legs too far. Keep the first step small so the close and side step stay in rhythm.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Right Side Release
figures.lead_cue: Side step and step across in promenade, then back and close while you ease away from her, and finish with a side step into right side-by-side hold.
figures.follow_cue: Side step and step across in promenade, then walk forward and side as you move to his right side, finishing in right side-by-side hold.
figures.mistake: Letting go too soon. Keep the connection through the close and release only on the final side step.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Syncopated Underarm Turn to R. (Underarm Turn from O.P.)
figures.lead_cue: Step back with her outside you, then side, close and side again while raising the left hand to send her under it to the right.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward outside him, then pass under his raised hand, turning right, and finish with a small side step to face him again.
figures.mistake: Lifting the arm too early or too high. Raise the hand on the close and keep it steady while she turns.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Syncopated Underarm Turn to R. (Underarm Turn from Side-by-Side)
figures.lead_cue: From left side-by-side hold, step forward, side, close and side again while lifting the joined hands to send her under them to the right.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward beside him, then turn right under the joined hands, and finish with a small side step to face him again.
figures.mistake: Pulling her round with the arm. Raise the hand early and let her own steps take her under it.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Step-Points (Step-Points - Man Forward)
figures.lead_cue: Step forward outside her left side and point the right foot out to the side, then step forward on the right outside her right side and point the left foot out.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back and point the left foot, then step back on the left and point the right foot, matching his pattern.
figures.mistake: Pointing with weight. The pointing foot just touches the floor and weight stays on the other foot.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Step-Points (Step-Points - Lady Forward)
figures.lead_cue: Step back and point the right foot to the side, then step back on the right and point the left foot, while she walks forward outside you.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward outside him and tap the other toe out wide, then repeat the pair on the opposite foot.
figures.mistake: Collapsing the frame as she travels forward. Stay tall and let her walk through your arms.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Cross-Body Lead to Underarm Turn L.
figures.lead_cue: Step back and then side as you lead her past you in a cross-body shape, hold while she turns left under your raised hand, then close and point the left foot to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward past him, then dance a tight turn to the left under his raised hand in short, small steps, finishing with a side step facing him.
figures.mistake: Stepping while she turns. Keep your feet still during the hold, so that she can make her turn around you.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Cross Body Lead to X-Line & Swivel
figures.lead_cue: Dance a left-turning Open Left Turn, step into promenade and hold while she swivels through the X-line, close, and finish with a forward Tango Close.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the turn backwards, step forward into promenade, then swivel left, right and left in three slow steps before closing, and end with back, side and a close.
figures.mistake: Moving during the swivels. Hold your own position and use only the body to cue her swivels.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Promenade Kick-Ball Change
figures.lead_cue: Side step and step across in promenade, flick the left foot forward and change weight onto it, then dance the final three steps of the Closed Promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Side step and step across in promenade, flick the free foot forward and change weight, then dance the last three steps of the Closed Promenade.
figures.mistake: Kicking high. A low, crisp flick reads cleaner and keeps the hold steady.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Promenade Fan Swivel
figures.lead_cue: Side step and step across in promenade, close the left foot without weight, change weight onto it, then dance the last three steps of the Closed Promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the same promenade steps, closing the right foot without weight and changing weight before the Closed Promenade ending.
figures.mistake: Taking weight on the close. The foot closes lightly and only then takes weight on the and count.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Promenade Lock
figures.lead_cue: Side step and step across in promenade, then walk diagonally forward with a quick lock of the right foot behind, and finish with two forward steps and a left foot placed to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the matching promenade steps with the left foot locking behind the right, ending with the right foot placed to the side.
figures.mistake: Locking with the knees straight. Keep the legs soft so the lock stays small and quick.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Corte Roll-In / Roll-Out
figures.lead_cue: Dip back with a check and replace, close; then check forward and replace, close; finish with a Basic Corte.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror the dips, with a pivot and a spiral turning left between them, and finish with the lady's side of the Basic Corte.
figures.mistake: Rushing the dips. Take each check slowly, sinking into the knee before replacing.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Oversway
figures.lead_cue: Step to the side and sway toward the supporting leg, holding the sway for the second slow; then close and point the left foot to the side, opening into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Step to the side with him, settle into the sway, then close and point the free foot to the side as you open into promenade.
figures.mistake: Collapsing sideways. Keep the ribs lifted and stretch the sway up and over the supporting leg.
figures.rise_fall: None
figures.sway: Oversway toward the supporting leg on steps 1-2

figures.name: Twinkle to Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Slow forward, then side-close as you open her into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Slow back, then side-close as you turn to promenade.
figures.mistake: Staying closed; the quicks open the couple into promenade.

figures.name: Closing Twinkle
figures.lead_cue: From promenade: slow through on the right, then side-close as you square up to closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Slow through on the left, then turn to face him on side-close.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to bring her square; she should face you by the close.
figures.notes_for_beginners: Taught in the team's Smooth Foxtrot notes.

figures.name: Forward Basic
figures.lead_cue: Walk two slow steps forward, then chasse to the side and close in two quicks. You may curve a little to the right over the last three steps.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back two slows, then side and close in two quicks, staying in his frame.
figures.mistake: Rushing the slows. Each slow takes two full beats, so let the legs glide.

figures.name: Back Basic
figures.lead_cue: Walk two slow steps backward, toe first, then side-close in two quicks. Keep your frame lifted toward her.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward two slows, then side and close, following his body weight.
figures.mistake: Sitting back onto the heels. Reach the toe back and let your chest keep moving.

figures.name: Hesitation Left Turn
figures.lead_cue: Step forward, hold, then rock back on the right while you start turning left, and side-close to finish a three-eighths turn. The rock is a slow, not a rush.
figures.follow_cue: Step back on the first slow, then rock forward as the turn starts, and side-close with him.
figures.mistake: Turning on the first step. Wait for the rock back and spread the turn over steps 2 to 4.

figures.name: Hesitation Right Turn
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the left and hold, then step forward on the right as you begin turning right, finishing with side-close. About three-eighths of a turn fits over steps 2 to 4.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward on the first slow, then step back as the turn begins, and side-close with him.
figures.mistake: Starting to turn too early. Keep step 1 straight and let the turn come on the second slow.

figures.name: Left Box (Reverse) Turn
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the left and turn left through side and close, then step back on the right and turn left through side and close. About three-eighths of a turn on each half.
figures.follow_cue: Step back on the right, side, close, then forward on the left, side, close, turning left with him.
figures.mistake: Turning only on the slows. Spread the turn through the quicks so the chasse stays smooth.

figures.name: Side Sway
figures.lead_cue: Step to the side on each slow, brushing the free foot in, then side and close in two quicks. Let the body sway gently with each step.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror his steps: side on each slow, then side and close, swaying with him.
figures.mistake: Stepping too far. Keep the steps small so the sway stays soft.

figures.name: Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Open to promenade on the first slow, walk across on the second, then side-close as she turns back to face you. Keep the promenade line clear.
figures.follow_cue: Open to promenade, walk across with your left foot, then turn to face him on the side-close.
figures.mistake: Forgetting the close. Square up to her on the quicks so you finish in closed hold.

figures.name: Progressive Quarter Turns
figures.lead_cue: Start facing a diagonal. Walk two slows and chasse while turning a quarter right, then walk back two slows and chasse while turning a quarter left. The pattern zig-zags down the room.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back, side, close turning right with him, then forward, forward, side, close turning left.
figures.mistake: Turning too early on the walks. Keep the slows straight and put each turn into the chasse.

figures.name: Progressive Quarter Turns (O.P.)
figures.lead_cue: The same zig-zag, but the first forward step goes slightly left so your right foot passes outside her. Do the same on the back walk: aim left, then pass outside her on the second slow.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back, side, close turning right, then forward, forward, side, close turning left. On step 2 and step 6 you are on his left side.
figures.mistake: Stepping straight at her. Angle the first step a little to the left to keep her out of the way of the passing foot.

figures.name: Progressive Quarter Turns to Right
figures.lead_cue: Starting on the right foot toward diagonal centre, walk two slows and chasse turning left, then walk back two slows and chasse turning right. It zig-zags the other way from the usual quarter turns.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left, then back, side, close turning left with him, and forward, forward, side, close turning right.
figures.mistake: Starting on the wrong foot. This one begins with the right, so take a closing step beforehand if needed.

figures.name: Forward Changes O.P.
figures.lead_cue: Dance a chain of forward changes, each a slow step then side-close, passing outside her on the third and fourth change by stepping across her line. The turn goes left, right, left over the four changes.
figures.follow_cue: Dance backward changes: back, side, close, four times, turning with him and staying centred under his frame.
figures.mistake: Rushing the first step of each change. Each forward step is a full slow, then make the side-close small.

figures.name: Backward Changes O.P.
figures.lead_cue: Begin with a left box half, then dance backward changes: back, side, close, turning left, right and left again. You pass outside her on the second and third.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the box half backward, then forward changes with him, turning with him through the whole pattern.
figures.mistake: Going back with a stiff frame. Reach the toe back and keep your chest moving toward her.

figures.name: Right Box (Natural) Turn
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward on the left and the right, then chasse to the side while turning three-eighths right, step back on the left and chasse again to complete a three-quarter right turn.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back, side, close turning right, then forward, side, close and back as you turn with him.
figures.mistake: Turning too soon on the second slow. Start the turn on the second slow and let it grow through the chasse.

figures.name: Promenade w/ Underarm Turn to Right
figures.lead_cue: Open to promenade and walk across while raising your left hand, then side-close as she turns under it. Lower the hand once she faces you.
figures.follow_cue: Open to promenade and walk across, then turn right under his arm during the chasse and finish facing him.
figures.mistake: Lifting the hand too late. Raise it on the walk across so she has room for the turn.

figures.name: Promenade w/ Underarm Turn to Left
figures.lead_cue: Open to promenade and walk across while lifting your left hand, then side-close as she turns left under it, leading her the opposite way from the other underarm turn.
figures.follow_cue: Open to promenade and walk across, then turn left under his arm during the chasse, finishing facing him.
figures.mistake: Sending her the wrong way. Keep the lift on the walk across and guide her turn to her right side.

figures.name: Right Pivot Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance a right-turning chasse, then pivot on the left foot as you step back, almost three-eighths of a turn, and finish with a forward walk and a plain chasse. Keep the right foot ahead, held in contact for the pivot.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back, side, close turning with him, then step forward between his feet for the pivot and finish back, side, close.
figures.mistake: Pivoting with the whole body leaning. Keep your frame upright and pivot only on the supporting foot.

figures.name: Twinkle
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward on a slow, then side-close in promenade, walk across in promenade and finish with side-close, squaring up to closed hold. The lady is turned to promenade on the first chasse.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the slow, then step diagonally back and close as you open to promenade, walk across on your left and finish side-close facing him.
figures.mistake: Staying closed through the first chasse. Open the body to promenade on the quicks, then square up on the second chasse.

figures.name: Back Twinkle
figures.lead_cue: Start going back with the left foot, step diagonally back and close as you open to promenade, walk across and finish side-close. The figure travels against the line of dance first and then turns round to face it.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on the first slow, step to the side and close in promenade, walk across on the left and finish side-close facing him.
figures.mistake: Pulling her round on the quicks. Keep the back step small and let the promenade open smoothly.

figures.name: Twinkles to PP & CPP
figures.lead_cue: Chain twinkles: open to promenade, then cross to counter promenade and back to promenade, finishing with a plain closing chasse. Each cross is a slow and each chasse two quicks.
figures.follow_cue: Back, diagonally back and close into promenade, then turn with him through counter promenade and promenade, and finish side-close facing him.
figures.mistake: Rushing the crosses. Let each cross-through be a full slow so the changes of direction look clear.

figures.name: Progressive Twinkles to PP & CPP
figures.lead_cue: The same chain of twinkles, but begin with a slight left turn and then keep the couple travelling straight. The crosses alternate between promenade and counter promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Back and diagonally back with a small turn, close into promenade, then turn through counter promenade and promenade, ending side-close facing him.
figures.mistake: Over-turning on the first chasse. Take a small turn and then keep the line of travel going.

figures.name: Promenade Check
figures.lead_cue: Open to promenade, walk across and check by flexing the knee, then replace the weight back and close the right foot slightly back as you square up toward her.
figures.follow_cue: Open to promenade, cross over and check, turn a little to face him, replace back on the right and close the left.
figures.mistake: Falling forward at the check. Stay tall and flex the knee, then push back toward your left foot.

figures.name: Promenade Check to Back Basic
figures.lead_cue: Open to promenade, walk across and check, replace back and step aside, then walk back two slows into a Back Basic. Turn left through the last chasse.
figures.follow_cue: Open to promenade, cross and check, replace, then step forward and turn with him through a forward basic to finish.
figures.mistake: Starting the back steps too soon. Wait for the replace and side step before you go back.

figures.name: Promenade Check & Slip Pivot
figures.lead_cue: Open to promenade, walk across and check, replace back and pivot to the left as you step back on the right. The pivot squares you up so you can walk forward with the left next.
figures.follow_cue: Open to promenade, cross and check, replace back and turn to face him as you step forward with the left.
figures.mistake: Pivoting too late. Begin turning as soon as the weight comes back to the left foot.

figures.name: Promenade Twist Turn
figures.lead_cue: Open to promenade and cross the right foot in front, then unwind to the left on your toes and heels, ending with weight on the right foot, a half turn in all. Then walk on with the left.
figures.follow_cue: Open to promenade, walk across and swivel round to face him, stepping forward on the last step and ending in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Spinning from the arms. Keep the feet twisted and let the body untwist from the hips.

figures.name: Promenade Pivot
figures.lead_cue: Open to promenade, walk forward on the right and pivot on the left foot to the right, then step forward again as the turn finishes. The lady circles round you to close.
figures.follow_cue: Open to promenade, cross and then walk forward between his feet as you spin round him, stepping back on the left to finish.
figures.mistake: Dropping the shoulder during the pivot. Keep the frame level and pivot on the ball of the foot.

figures.name: Grapevines
figures.lead_cue: Dance forward, side, close, then a zig-zag of forward, side, back, side with a little turn each way, and finish with a forward step and a side-close.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close, then back, side, forward, side, following his turn, and finish back, side, close.
figures.mistake: Over-turning the side steps. Keep the angles to about a quarter each way.

figures.name: Open Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward on the left and turn left through a side step to a back step outside her, then continue back and side and finish moving forward outside partner. The turn is about three-quarters of a circle.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the slow, side, then forward outside him, forward, then side-back and back, turning left with him throughout.
figures.mistake: Turning all on the first step. Let the body lead gradually through the quicks.

figures.name: Open Natural Turn
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward on the right and turn right through a side step to a back step, then continue back and side and finish forward on the left, preparing to pass outside partner on the right.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left, side, then forward outside him, forward, side-back and back, turning right with him.
figures.mistake: Starting on the wrong foot. This figure begins with the right, so it needs a left-foot ending before it.

figures.name: Brush Twinkle
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the slow, step to the side and brush the feet together, move into promenade, walk across and square off, then step forward outside her. It is the Silver version of the Twinkle, without the closing chasse.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the slow, diagonally back with a brush, side in promenade, cross over, side and back outside him.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet on the brush. Keep the feet passing past each other with the light brush only.

figures.name: Back Twinkle
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the slow, step diagonally back with a brush, side in promenade, walk across, then side and close. The brush keeps the feet moving.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on the slow, side with a brush, side in promenade, cross over, side and back outside him.
figures.mistake: Closing too early on step 3. Let the brush pass the feet and step to the side only on the third step.

figures.name: Natural Twinkle
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the left and make a heel turn to the right, closing the right foot, then move into promenade, walk across and step forward outside her. The turn is three-eighths, squaring you to the line of dance.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on the right, turn right on the ball of the left, step to the side in promenade, cross over and step back outside him.
figures.mistake: Turning from the arms. Rotate your body over the closing foot as you turn.

figures.name: Reverse Twinkle
figures.lead_cue: Step back twice and turn a quarter to the left into promenade on the third step, then cross, side and forward outside her. The turn happens on the third step.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on the slow and quick, step to the side in promenade as you turn left with him, cross over, side and back outside him.
figures.mistake: Starting the turn too early. Wait until the third step and turn from the body.

figures.name: Hover Corte from Promenade
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, cross on the right and turn right through a side step, then hover and replace the weight back onto the right foot, ending backing diagonal centre against the line of dance.
figures.follow_cue: From promenade, cross on the left, turn left with a brush on the second step and finish stepping forward with the left foot, ready to pass outside him.
figures.mistake: Missing the turn on step 2. Turn the body to square up as the left foot steps to the side.

figures.name: Passing Changes Forward
figures.lead_cue: Dance forward changes of slow-quick-quick, brushing on the second step of each group and turning a quarter left, then right, then left. The right foot passes outside her on the first step of the second, third and fourth change.
figures.follow_cue: Dance backward changes with him, with a brush on the second step of each, turning with him.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet on the quicks. Brush past instead, so the feet keep passing.

figures.name: Narrow Passing Change
figures.lead_cue: Three forward steps in slow, quick, quick, the right side leading on the quick and the left side leading on the last, ready to pass outside her on the right. It is a compact change that can start or end a chain of passing steps.
figures.follow_cue: Three backward steps in slow, quick, quick, with your right side leading on the last.
figures.mistake: Over-stepping on the quicks. The step sizes should shrink after the slow.

figures.name: Passing Changes Back
figures.lead_cue: Turn left through a forward step, side and back step outside her, then dance backward changes with a brush, turning left, right and left again and finishing forward outside partner.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the slow, turn left with him through the first three steps, then forward changes with brushes, and finish stepping back outside him.
figures.mistake: Reaching too far on the back steps. Keep each back step small so the turn stays smooth.

figures.name: Twinkles to PP & CPP
figures.lead_cue: Chain the twinkles with brushes instead of closes: let go of her right hand into promenade, cross to counter promenade, then cross back to promenade, and finish by closing her in with a final side and forward step outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Back, diagonally back with a brush, side in promenade, cross over, then turn right around him through counter promenade and promenade, and close back into hold as you turn with him.
figures.mistake: Dropping the hold early. Keep the left hands joined until the hold changes and close in fully on the last three steps.

figures.name: Promenade & CPP Runs (Natural)
figures.lead_cue: Twinkle into promenade, then walk forward and turn three-quarters to the right to pass her through counter promenade. Send her round in front of you, step into promenade again and close her in with a side step and a forward step.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back with a brush, side in promenade, cross, then walk forward past him and turn through counter promenade, step back round him, and close in on the last steps.
figures.mistake: Turning on the first walk. Walk the promenade step straight and turn on the following two quicks.

figures.name: Promenade & CP Runs (Reverse)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the progressive twinkles into counter promenade, then turn left through closed position and pass her round you into promenade, and finish with the closing side and forward step.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the twinkles with him, then step forward past him through the middle of the turn, step into promenade and turn to close in at the end.
figures.mistake: Letting go too soon in the middle of the turn. Keep the frame until she has passed in front of you.

figures.name: PP & CPP Runs w/ Lady's Turn
figures.lead_cue: From open promenade, walk forward and lead the lady round to her left in a turn while you step back and aside, ending in counter promenade. You hold your own place while she circles.
figures.follow_cue: From promenade, cross, then turn left on a very small step in a long spin on the pivot, and finish stepping forward into counter promenade.
figures.mistake: Dragging her round by the arm. Raise your right arm gently and let her pivot herself.

figures.name: Syncopated Underarm Turn to R. from O.P.
figures.lead_cue: Step back outside her and turn right, then lift your left hand and circle it over her head as you close and step aside, leading her round to her right. Lower the hand when she faces you.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward outside him, then turn right under his raised hand in two steps, finishing on a side step facing him.
figures.mistake: Circling the hand too late. Start lifting it on step 2 so she has time to turn.

figures.name: Syncopated Underarm Turn to R. from Open CPP
figures.lead_cue: From open counter promenade, cross on the left, then lift your left hand and circle it over her head as you side-close-side, leading her round to her right.
figures.follow_cue: From counter promenade, step forward then turn right under his raised hand in two steps, finishing facing him.
figures.mistake: Lifting the arm too high. Keep it just above her head and let her turn freely.

figures.name: Promenade Release (Lady Around Man)
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, cross on the right and replace on the left while you extend your arms to the left, leading her round in front of you, then step to the side in open counter promenade holding left to right hands.
figures.follow_cue: From promenade, walk across, step back and round on the right and finish forward on the left in open counter promenade, turning left in front of him.
figures.mistake: Pulling her across. Extend the arms and let her walk round you.

figures.name: Promenade Release (Man Around Lady)
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, walk forward and step diagonally back, turning right to pass in front of her, then step aside in open counter promenade holding left to right hands.
figures.follow_cue: From promenade, cross on the left, replace on the right and step forward on the left as he travels around you.
figures.mistake: Rushing round her. Move in a curve in front of her and keep the left hands joined.

figures.name: Underarm Release (Lady Underarm)
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, cross on the right and replace on the left while you raise your left hand, then lower it as she passes beneath and step aside in open counter promenade.
figures.follow_cue: From promenade, walk across, then turn right under his raised hand on two steps to face the wall in open counter promenade.
figures.mistake: Dropping the hand while she is still under it. Lower it only after she has passed.

figures.name: Underarm Release (Man Underarm)
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, walk forward and then pass in front of her and beneath your own raised left hand, ending in open counter promenade holding left to right hands.
figures.follow_cue: From promenade, cross and replace, then as he walks beneath the raised arm, swing around to face the new direction.
figures.mistake: Ducking too low. Keep your head up and pass smoothly under the arm.

figures.name: Closing Twinkle (Lady Closing to Man)
figures.lead_cue: From open counter promenade, step forward and lead her round in front of you to close, then take promenade, cross, and finish side and forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: From counter promenade, step forward then turn right round him to close, take promenade, cross, side and back outside him.
figures.mistake: Closing her in too quickly. Wait for the second step before you place the hand on her back.

figures.name: Closing Twinkle (Man Closing to Lady)
figures.lead_cue: From open counter promenade, step forward and turn left round her to close, then take promenade, cross, side and forward outside her.
