figures.follow_cue: From counter promenade, step forward, then forward on the small step and step into promenade as he circles round you, and close back in.
figures.mistake: Rushing the turn. Pass round her in a curve and keep your left hand up until you are close.

figures.name: Grapevines to Right
figures.lead_cue: Dance forward, side, back and side in four quick steps with a little turn left then right, and repeat it. This is the mirror of the zig-zag to the left.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, forward and side with him, turning left and then right, and repeat.
figures.mistake: Letting the steps get bigger. Keep them even and low so the zig-zag stays light.

figures.name: Promenade Grapevines
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, take a side step, close into a brief closed position, step back across in a fallaway shape and open to promenade again, four quick steps in all. The couple keeps moving down the line of dance.
figures.follow_cue: From promenade, cross, side, back across and side again, closing to face him and opening to promenade once more.
figures.mistake: Losing the promenade line. Keep both heads turned along the line of dance when you return to the V shape.

figures.name: Open Counter-Promenade Grapevines
figures.lead_cue: From open counter promenade, step forward, turn left to face her, step back across in a fallaway shape and then turn right to open to counter promenade, four quick steps. The hands stay joined.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward, turn right to face him, step back across and turn left to return to counter promenade, mirroring his turns.
figures.mistake: Letting the arms collapse. Keep a gentle tension in the joined hands so the partner can see the changes.

figures.name: Step-Points (Man Forward)
figures.lead_cue: Step forward outside her on the left and point the right foot to the side, then step forward outside her on the right and point the left foot, with a quarter turn to each side. Four quick steps.
figures.follow_cue: Step back and point the left foot to the side, then step back and point the right foot, turning with him.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the point. Touch the toe lightly and keep your weight over the standing foot.

figures.name: Step-Points (Lady Forward)
figures.lead_cue: Step back on the left and point the right foot to the side, then step back on the right and point the left foot, turning with her. Four quick steps with her moving forward.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward on the right and point the left foot, then step forward on the left and point the right foot, turning with him.
figures.mistake: Pointing without turning. Let the body turn a quarter on each step and point the free foot to the side.

figures.name: Natural Pivots
figures.lead_cue: From promenade, step forward and pivot on the left foot, stepping forward on the right between her feet, then pivot again, travelling along the line of dance. Return to promenade on the final step.
figures.follow_cue: From promenade, cross, walk forward past him and pivot on the left, stepping forward on the right and back again, turning round him back to promenade.
figures.mistake: Stopping the rotation between pivots. Keep the toe turned in and let the body keep winding.

figures.name: Forward Change (left foot)
figures.lead_cue: Forward, side, close on the left foot to switch to right-foot turns.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close.
figures.mistake: Stopping your travel; keep moving around the room.

figures.name: Forward Change (right foot)
figures.lead_cue: Forward, side, close on the right foot to switch to left turns.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close.
figures.mistake: Skipping it between a right turn and a left turn.

figures.name: Hesitation (Balance Step)
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the left and hold for two beats, the right foot closing without weight.
figures.follow_cue: Step back on the right and hold.
figures.mistake: Changing weight on the hold; the right foot stays free.

figures.name: Left (Reverse) Turn
figures.lead_cue: Turn left: forward, side, cross the left foot in front; back, side, close. About 3/8 of a turn per half.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close; then forward, side, and cross the left foot in front, turning left with him.
figures.mistake: Making big steps; Viennese is fast, so keep them compact.

figures.name: Right (Natural) Turn
figures.lead_cue: Turn right: forward-side-close, back-side-close.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close, forward-side-close, turning right.
figures.mistake: Starting it on the left foot.

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Forward change while raising your left hand, then back change as she turns right under it.
figures.follow_cue: Back change, then turn right under his arm and return to hold.
figures.mistake: Letting go completely; keep the hand connection through the turn.

figures.name: Basic (forward half)
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward, replace, chasse to the left.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, replace, chasse to the right.
figures.mistake: Starting the rock on 1. In cha cha the break step is on 2.

figures.name: Basic (back half)
figures.lead_cue: Rock back, replace, chasse to the right.
figures.follow_cue: Rock forward, replace, chasse to the left.
figures.mistake: Taking the chasse too big. Keep the side steps small.

figures.name: New Yorker
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter and check forward through side-by-side, replace, chasse back to face. Then the other side.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: check forward with the left, replace, chasse.
figures.mistake: Checking with the wrong foot. The leader's first check is with the right foot.

figures.name: Hand to Hand
figures.lead_cue: Like a New Yorker, but you check BACK side by side, holding one hand.
figures.follow_cue: Turn to face the same way as him and check back on the left, replace, chasse back to face; then the same on the right.
figures.mistake: Breaking forward instead of back.

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance a back half while raising your left hand so she turns right under it.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, turn right under his arm on 3, chasse to face him.
figures.mistake: Leading the turn on the wrong foot: the leader needs the right foot free.

figures.name: Fan
figures.lead_cue: Dance a back half while you lead her back and out to your left side into fan position.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, then back on the right as you start turning left, and chasse back away from him to end at a right angle on his left.
figures.mistake: Pushing her away; lead the fan with your body turn, not by throwing the arm.
figures.notes_for_beginners: Team video: 'Cha cha curl into fan'.

figures.name: Basic (full)
figures.lead_cue: Forward half then back half. Ends with the left foot free.
figures.follow_cue: Back half then forward half.
figures.mistake: Going straight from a full Basic into a New Yorker. The New Yorker needs the right foot free.

figures.name: Open Basic Movement
figures.lead_cue: Break forward on the left, replace, and chasse back; then break back on the right, replace, and chasse forward, so you travel there and back along one line.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: break back on the right, replace and chasse forward, then break forward and chasse back.
figures.mistake: Rushing the chasse so it lands early; give the break its full two beats so the chasse fits the last count and a half.

figures.name: Alternative Basic Movement
figures.lead_cue: Close the left foot to the right and take weight on the right, then chasse left; in the next bar close the right foot, replace, and chasse right.
figures.follow_cue: Do the same with opposite feet: close right to left, replace on the left, chasse right, then the other side.
figures.mistake: Stepping apart on the closes; keep both feet together and under you.

figures.name: Basic Movement In Place
figures.lead_cue: Shift weight left and right on the spot with your feet together, keeping the cha cha rhythm of two slows and a chasse timing in each bar.
figures.follow_cue: Shift weight right then left in the same rhythm, mirroring his feet while staying in place.
figures.mistake: Skipping the quick steps; say the count aloud so the fast ones really happen.

figures.name: New York
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter right and break forward on the left side by side with her, then turn back left to chasse facing her; the second bar repeats it on the other foot.
figures.follow_cue: Turn a quarter left and break forward on the right beside him, then turn right to chasse facing him; the second bar goes the other way.
figures.mistake: Staying square to her; the quarter turn on the first step is what creates the side-by-side shape.

figures.name: Spot Turns
figures.lead_cue: Turn a full circle to the right in the first bar, two forward steps and a chasse, then a full circle to the left in the second, each time finishing facing her.
figures.follow_cue: Turn left on the spot over the first bar, then right over the second, always ending facing him.
figures.mistake: Travelling away while you turn; stay on one spot and keep the steps small.

figures.name: Underarm Turns to R & L
figures.lead_cue: Break forward and replace with your left hand raised so she turns left beneath it, chasse left, then break back, step forward on the left as you circle the hand the other way for her right turn, and chasse right.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward turning left under his raised hand through the first bar and chasse to face him, then turn right under his hand in the second bar.
figures.mistake: Dragging her round with your arm; keep the elbow up and let her walk the turn herself.

figures.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
figures.lead_cue: Angle your body slightly right so she sits offset, break forward on the left with her on your left side, chasse left, then break forward on the right with her on your right.
figures.follow_cue: Break back on the right while he steps offset beside you, break back on the left in the second bar, and turn slightly with him through the chasses.
figures.mistake: Walking straight at her; angle your body so you pass beside her shoulder.

figures.name: Hand to Hand
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter left and break back on the left, side by side with her, then turn right to chasse facing her; the second bar breaks back on the right.
figures.follow_cue: Turn a quarter right and break back on the right beside him, then turn left to chasse facing him; repeat to the other side.
figures.mistake: Breaking forward as in a New York; in this figure both of you check backward.

figures.name: Three Cha Chas (forward)
figures.lead_cue: Travel forward through three locks in a row, starting on the right foot and crossing the trailing foot behind on each and.
figures.follow_cue: Travel backward through three locks starting on the left, keeping your steps small to stay with him.
figures.mistake: Making the middle lock bigger than the others; keep all three the same size so the 2&3 stays tidy.

figures.name: Three Cha Chas (back)
figures.lead_cue: Travel backward through three locks starting on the left foot, crossing the free foot in front on each and.
figures.follow_cue: Travel forward through three locks starting on the right, crossing the trailing foot behind each time.
figures.mistake: Leaning back as you travel; keep your weight forward over the balls of the feet.

figures.name: Three Cha Chas (in right side position)
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter right so you stand side by side with her on your left, dance three forward locks together, and turn back to face her at the end.
figures.follow_cue: Turn a quarter left into side-by-side, dance three forward locks level with him, and turn right to face him at the end.
figures.mistake: Drifting apart as you travel; keep your shoulders level and match the length of each step.

figures.name: Three Cha Chas (in left side position)
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter left so she stands on your right, dance three forward locks side by side, and turn back to face her.
figures.follow_cue: Turn a quarter right to stand on his right side, dance three forward locks beside him, then turn left to face him.
figures.mistake: Rushing ahead of her; travel level so the pair stays shoulder to shoulder.

figures.name: Side Steps to Left
figures.lead_cue: Move left in a stream of small side steps, always closing the right foot to the left, mixing single steps on the slow counts with a chasse and quick closes.
figures.follow_cue: Travel right with the mirror feet, closing the left foot to the right each time.
figures.mistake: Letting the feet drift apart on the closes; finish every step with the feet together.

figures.name: There and Back
figures.lead_cue: Close and replace, then take three small steps back as you ease your right hand away and keep left-arm tone; break back on the right, replace, and run three steps forward into closed hold again.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: close, replace, three small steps back, break back on the left, replace, and three steps forward to rejoin his hold.
figures.mistake: Losing left-arm tone so she drifts away; stay connected as you separate and come back.

figures.name: Time Steps
figures.lead_cue: Cross the left foot behind the right on 2, replace on 3, and chasse left; then cross the right behind, replace and chasse right.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: cross right behind left, replace, chasse right; then cross left behind, replace and chasse left.
figures.mistake: Crossing too far and losing balance; make the cross a small, low step.

figures.name: Fan (method 1)
figures.lead_cue: Dance a closed basic with a slight left turn, then in the second bar release your right hand and send her away to your left with a small chasse, finishing in fan.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the basic back half, then step forward, go back and slightly aside, and back-lock away from him, turning left to finish at right angles on his left.
figures.mistake: Throwing her away with your arm; send her with a gradual body turn and left-arm tone.

figures.name: Fan (method 2)
figures.lead_cue: Curve left through the first bar into promenade, then release your right hand and lead her out to your left side into fan with a compact chasse.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back and replace, lock diagonally forward as he curves, cross in front of him, then turn left to back-lock away into fan.
figures.mistake: Sending her out before the second bar; wait until after the first bar to begin the lead.

figures.name: Alemana
figures.lead_cue: From fan: forward, replace, chasse in place as you raise your left hand; then back, replace, and a small chasse to the right as she turns right under your arm back into closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Close, forward, then a forward lock-step; forward, forward turning right under his arm, and chasse to face him in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Leading the turn before she has walked up to your right side; let her travel first, then turn her on the second half.

figures.name: Hockey Stick
figures.lead_cue: From fan, break forward, replace and chasse in place with your left hand raised; then cross the right foot behind, step forward on the left and lock forward as she turns beneath your arm.
figures.follow_cue: Close, walk forward and lock forward, then turn left under his raised hand on 3 and back-lock into open facing.
figures.mistake: Crossing the right foot in front on the Cuban cross; it goes behind the left.

figures.name: Natural Top
figures.lead_cue: Alternate a side step on the left with a cross behind on the right, turning steadily to the right with her around a point between you.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward on the right between his feet and aside on the left, alternately, turning with him around the shared centre.
figures.mistake: Turning too fast on the first step; spread the rotation evenly across every beat.

figures.name: Natural Opening Out Movement
figures.lead_cue: Turn slightly right so she steps back offset to your right, break side or forward on the left, then turn left and chasse to return her to closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Turn half right as you step back, replace, then turn left across and close to finish facing him in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Pushing her away with your arms; the opening comes from rotating your upper body.

figures.name: Closed Hip Twist
figures.lead_cue: Lead an opening out, then in the second bar release your right hand and extend your left arm to send her away into fan.
figures.follow_cue: Turn half right as you step back, then half left forward in a lock, cross in front of him in the next bar, and finish in fan with a back lock.
figures.mistake: Releasing her too early; keep your right hand on her back until the replace in the second bar.

figures.name: Open Hip Twist
figures.lead_cue: From open facing, break forward, replace and chasse back, then take a small break back and chasse aside, drawing your left hand to your hip so she twists into fan.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and replace, lock forward, step forward turning a quarter right, then turn left across and back-lock into fan.
figures.mistake: Over-using the arm; draw the left hand toward your hip and let her twist from her own turn.

figures.name: Reverse Top
figures.lead_cue: Step aside on the right, then swivel left and cross the left foot in front, repeating steadily so you spin left with her around the middle of the pair.
figures.follow_cue: Cross the left behind, step back and aside on the right, and keep repeating in time with him as you turn left together.
figures.mistake: Travelling instead of spinning on the spot; keep each step tiny and under the body.

figures.name: Spiral
figures.lead_cue: Break forward and replace with a slight right turn, chasse in place raising your left hand over her head, then break back and chasse right into fan.
figures.follow_cue: Turn half right as you step back, replace, then spiral left under his raised hand with a forward chasse, and finish with a back lock into fan.
figures.mistake: Lifting your hand too early; raise it over her head only during the chasse.

figures.name: Curl
figures.lead_cue: From open, break forward, replace, chasse in place and circle your left hand over her head, then finish with the Spiral's second bar into fan.
figures.follow_cue: Step back, replace, then lock forward into a spiral turn to the left beneath his hand, and finish with the Spiral's second bar into fan.
figures.mistake: Starting the hand circle early; wait until the chasse to raise your hand.

figures.name: Rope Spinning
figures.lead_cue: Turn your body slightly right as she turns off your raised hand, then chasse in place circling your hand over your head while she walks around you.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward in a wide circle to the right, first round his back and then round his front, using forward locks, and finish facing him.
figures.mistake: Stepping on the spot instead of travelling; she needs room, so lengthen her forward steps with a clear lead.

figures.name: Cross Basic
figures.lead_cue: Cross the left foot in front on 2, step back on the right, chasse left; then cross the right behind, step forward on the left and chasse right, turning gently left throughout.
figures.follow_cue: Cross the right foot behind, step forward on the left, chasse right; then cross left in front, step back and chasse left, turning gently with him.
figures.mistake: Crossing with stiff knees; keep a soft, low cross and turn the toe outward.

figures.name: Cuban Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Take tiny quick steps: cross the left foot forward and replace, then step aside and replace, twice in a row, angling your body slightly each time.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: cross the right foot forward and replace, then step aside and replace, turning slightly left then right to open away from him.
figures.mistake: Making the breaks big; keep them small and quick so they fit the half beats.

figures.name: Basic (forward half)
figures.lead_cue: Forward, replace, side and hold through 1.
figures.follow_cue: Back, replace, side and hold.
figures.mistake: Not holding the side step. 4-1 is two beats.

figures.name: Basic (back half)
figures.lead_cue: Back, replace, side and hold.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, replace, side and hold.
figures.mistake: Bouncing. Rumba stays grounded with hip action.

figures.name: New Yorker
figures.lead_cue: Quarter turn, check forward, replace, side. Then the other way.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him with your left foot first.
figures.mistake: Starting with the left foot. The leader needs the right foot free.

figures.name: Spot Turn
figures.lead_cue: Step across on the right and turn a full turn to the left on the spot, then side.
figures.follow_cue: Cross the left foot in front and turn right on the spot, step forward on the right as you finish the turn, then side.
figures.mistake: Travelling during the turn; stay on the spot.

figures.name: Fan
figures.lead_cue: Back half of the basic while you lead her out to your left into fan position.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, back, back as you turn away to his left side.
figures.mistake: Starting the Fan with the left foot or throwing her out with the arm; it needs the right foot free and a body lead.

figures.name: Basic Movements (Closed Basic Movement)
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the left, rock back onto the right, then step left and hold through 1; then go back on the right, rock onto the left and step right with a hold. Each side step drifts a little left.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: back on the right, rock onto the left, step right and hold; then forward on the left, rock onto the right and step side with a hold.
figures.mistake: Rushing the side step. Count 4-1 as two full beats and let the hips finish the move before the next walk.

figures.name: Basic Movements (Alternative Basic Movement)
figures.lead_cue: Bring the left foot to the right, change weight in place, then step left and hold; mirror it with the right foot. It is a compact, in-place basic.
figures.follow_cue: Do the mirror image: close the right foot, change weight in place, step right and hold; then close the left and step left.
figures.mistake: Stepping too far out on the side steps. Keep them small so the pattern stays on the spot.

figures.name: Cucarachas
figures.lead_cue: Press the left foot out to the side with only some weight, bring all your weight back to the right, then close the left; repeat to the other side with the right foot.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: press the right foot to the side, recover onto the left and close the right, then press the left side and close.
figures.mistake: Putting full weight on the side step, which kills the cockroach squash. Reach out with a toe press and recover quickly.

figures.name: New York
figures.lead_cue: Side by side, check forward on the left with a small turn right, recover onto the right and step left in promenade; then check forward on the right with a small turn left and step right in promenade.
figures.follow_cue: You check forward on the opposite foot to him, turning to face the same direction: right foot first turning left, recover, side step; then left foot forward, recover, side step.
figures.mistake: Letting the check forward slide into a full walk. Keep the forward steps short and the weight recovering immediately.

figures.name: Spot Turns
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the left on a quarter turn right, spin a half turn right over the right foot and step left; then reverse the same pattern to the left. Finish facing her and release the hand hold.
figures.follow_cue: You turn the opposite way: step forward on the right turning left, spin a half left over the left foot and step right; then repeat to the right, ending facing him.
figures.mistake: Wandering off the spot while spinning. Keep the weight over the supporting foot and turn with the body, not the arms.

figures.name: Underarm Turns to R & L
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward, rock back and step side while raising the joined left hand so she can turn left beneath it; then go back, rock forward and step side as she turns right under the same hand.
figures.follow_cue: Turn left on the first bar, stepping forward on the right, rocking onto the left and finishing facing him; then turn right on the second bar, stepping forward on the left, rocking and finishing facing him.
figures.mistake: Pulling her round with the arm. Keep a steady lifted hand and let your own body move her.

figures.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the left toward her left shoulder, rock back and step left while turning slightly left; then step forward on the right toward her right shoulder, rock and step right while turning slightly right.
figures.follow_cue: Step back on the right, rock forward and step right; then back on the left, rock and step left; stay close so the two of you pass shoulder to shoulder.
figures.mistake: Turning the whole body early. Let the forward check angle past her shoulder first and turn only on the rock and side step.

figures.name: Hand to Hand
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter left and step back on the left in side-by-side, rock onto the right and turn back to face her with the left step; then turn right to step back on the right, rock and face her again.
figures.follow_cue: Turn the opposite way to him: step back on the right as you turn right, rock onto the left and face him with the right step; then turn left, back on the left, rock and face him.
figures.mistake: Looking at your own feet instead of at each other on the side-by-side bars. Keep the head up and hands connected.

figures.name: Progressive Walks (Forward)
figures.lead_cue: Walk six steps forward starting on the left, with the third and sixth held; stay in a light hold and travel in a gentle line.
figures.follow_cue: Walk backward on the opposite foot, keeping your own balance and letting him set the path.
figures.mistake: Letting the steps shrink on the held beats. Take each walk through the full count with a long leg and a grounded foot.

figures.name: Progressive Walks (Back)
figures.lead_cue: Walk six steps backward starting on the right, holding the third and sixth steps; keep the chest lifted.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward starting on the left, following his body rather than reaching with your feet.
figures.mistake: Letting the steps shrink on the held beats. Take each walk through the full count with a long leg and a grounded foot.

figures.name: Progressive Walks (Left Side Position)
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward together side by side, starting on the left foot, with a held third and sixth step.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward beside him on the opposite foot, keeping the arm connection steady.
figures.mistake: Drifting apart. Keep your shoulders level with hers and walk the same length of step.

figures.name: Progressive Walks (Right Side Position)
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward together side by side, starting on the right foot, with a held third and sixth step.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward beside him on the opposite foot, keeping the arm connection steady.
figures.mistake: Drifting apart. Keep your shoulders level with hers and walk the same length of step.

figures.name: Side Steps (to L)
figures.lead_cue: Close the right foot, step left, close, step left again, close and step left, travelling along the line to the left.
figures.follow_cue: Close the left foot, step right, and keep going to the right in the same rhythm.
figures.mistake: Closing with a bounce. Keep the knees soft and let the hips roll into each side step.

figures.name: Side Steps (to R)
figures.lead_cue: Close the left foot, step right, close, step right again, close and step right, travelling along the line to the right.
figures.follow_cue: Close the right foot, step left, and keep going to the left in the same rhythm.
figures.mistake: Travelling in a curve. Aim the side steps along one straight line.

figures.name: Cuban Rocks (on Left Foot)
figures.lead_cue: Step to the side on the left, rock back onto the right and return to the left with a two-beat hold.
figures.follow_cue: Step side on the right, rock onto the left and back to the right, keeping the hip action going.
figures.mistake: Rocking too far. Keep the movements small and the weight returning over the foot.

figures.name: Cuban Rocks (on Right Foot)
figures.lead_cue: Step to the side on the right, rock onto the left and return to the right with a two-beat hold.
figures.follow_cue: Step side on the left, rock onto the right and back to the left, keeping the hip action going.
figures.mistake: Rocking too far. Keep the movements small and the weight returning over the foot.

figures.name: Fan
figures.lead_cue: Dance a closed basic, then on the back half lower your left arm, let go with the right hand and push the left arm gently out so she travels away from you into fan position.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the first bar as the basic, then on the second bar step forward on the left, then back on the right and back on the left while you turn a little left on counts 3 and 4-1, ending beside him in fan position.
figures.mistake: Throwing her out with the arm. Release the right hand and extend the left arm softly so the body, not a shove, sends her away.

figures.name: Hockey Stick
figures.lead_cue: From fan, step forward, rock and close; raise the left hand, cross the right foot behind with a small turn right, then walk forward twice while she turns left under your hand.
figures.follow_cue: Close the right foot, walk forward left and right, then step forward and turn left under his arm, finishing with a step back in open facing position.
figures.mistake: Leaving the hand high too long. Lower it to waist level as soon as she completes her turn.

figures.name: Natural Top
figures.lead_cue: Cross the right foot behind, step left, and keep alternating while you spin to the right on the spot, finishing by closing the right foot. This version turns one full circle over the nine steps.
figures.follow_cue: Step side on the left and forward on the right between his feet, alternating while you turn right with him, and finish with a side step on the left.
figures.mistake: Travelling across the floor. Stay in one place by keeping the steps tiny and the weight over the supporting foot.

figures.name: Opening Out to R & L
figures.lead_cue: Step left with part weight and open the right arm so she turns away on a quarter turn; bring her back as you recover and close. Then repeat the idea to the other side with the left arm.
figures.follow_cue: Step back at right angles to him, first on the right turning a quarter right, then rock and step forward on the right turning back to face him; repeat on the left foot the other way.
figures.mistake: Opening the arm without the body. Rotate your frame slightly and let the arm follow.

figures.name: Natural Opening Out
figures.lead_cue: Turn your body slightly right, step left and recover, then turn slightly left and close the left foot as you bring her back to face you.
figures.follow_cue: Step back on the right while turning a half right, rock onto the left and unwind a half left on the final side step to face him.
figures.mistake: Pushing her around with the hands. Move your body slightly right and left so the turn comes from your frame.

figures.name: Closed Hip Twist
figures.lead_cue: Turn slightly right, step left and recover, then close the left foot as you turn her left to your right side; on the back half draw her around in front of you and open into fan position.
figures.follow_cue: Step back on the right turning half right, rock onto the left, step forward right unwinding left, cross in front of him with a left step, then spin left on the right and finish in fan facing away.
figures.mistake: Letting her pass behind you. Keep her in front of your body and your left arm firm, so she travels across the front.

figures.name: Open Hip Twist
figures.lead_cue: From open position, walk forward, rock and step back on the left, bringing the left hand to your hip; then step back on the right and lead her to turn left past your left side into fan.
figures.follow_cue: Step back, rock forward and step forward; then pass in front of him on the left with a small turn right, turn a half left on the right foot, and finish with a step back in fan position.
figures.mistake: Making the back step too big. Keep the small step on 4 so she has room to pass in front of you.

figures.name: Alemana
figures.lead_cue: From fan: forward, replace, close, then lead her to turn right under your arm back to closed.
figures.follow_cue: Close, forward, forward; then forward and forward again turning right under his arm, and close facing him.
figures.mistake: Trying it from open position after a Hockey Stick.

figures.name: Fallaway Rock
figures.lead_cue: Open into a fallaway as you rock back, then bring her back into closed hold while you chasse left, and chasse right.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back into the fallaway turning right a little, replace, then turn left to close up to face him on the first chasse and finish with the other chasse.
figures.mistake: Throwing the body backwards on the rock. Keep your chest lifted and let only the step go back.

figures.name: Fallaway Throwaway
figures.lead_cue: Rock back in fallaway, chasse diagonally forward as you turn her left, then chasse forward while the right hand lets go and you end in open facing hold.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back and turn right a little, then turn left through the first chasse to the side and chasse backwards away from him into open facing hold.
figures.mistake: Pulling her away with the arm. Turn your own body and extend the left arm gently to send her.

figures.name: Link
figures.lead_cue: Rock back away from her, replace, then chasse forward to draw her in and close the hold before a side chasse.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back away from him, replace, then chasse forward into closed hold and finish with a side chasse.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to close the hold on the forward chasse. Bring her in on the first chasse, not the second.

figures.name: Change of Places R to L
figures.lead_cue: Rock back in fallaway, chasse diagonally forward while turning her left, then raise the left hand so she turns right beneath it through the second chasse.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back and turn right a little, turn left on the first chasse, then turn right under his raised hand through the second chasse into open facing hold.
figures.mistake: Raising the arm too late. Lift it before the second chasse starts so she has the whole chasse to turn.

figures.name: Change of Places L to R
figures.lead_cue: Rock back, then make a small chasse while turning right and lifting the joined left hand so she can travel under it, then chasse forward.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, then turn left under his raised hand through the first chasse and finish with a backward chasse back into open facing hold.
figures.mistake: Dragging her across with the arm. Keep the arm lifted and still, and let your own turn guide her.

figures.name: Change of Hands Behind Back
figures.lead_cue: Rock back, chasse forward past her while passing her right hand to your own right hand, then turn right and pass the hand across behind your back.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, chasse forward past his right side, then chasse around to face him again as the hands change over.
figures.mistake: Reaching for her hand behind you too early. Finish the turn first so the hand lands where your arm is.

figures.name: Hip Bump
figures.lead_cue: Rock back, chasse forward turning to stand side by side, bump hips lightly on the in-between beat, then chasse back round to face her.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, chasse forward turning left to stand beside him, bump hips lightly, then turn right through the last chasse to face him.
figures.mistake: Bumping hard with the whole body. It is a small hip flick on the quarter beat, with the feet still.

figures.name: American Spin
figures.lead_cue: Rock back, make a small chasse and give her right hand a light push to send her spinning, then chasse in place and catch her hand.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, chasse forward, then spin a full turn to the right, half of it on the last step of the chasse and half through the next chasse.
figures.mistake: Holding on while she spins. Open the hand, let her turn freely, and take the hand again at the end.

figures.name: Walks (Single Count)
figures.lead_cue: Rock back in fallaway, then walk forward in promenade with a long step on the left and a crossing step on the right.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, then walk with him in promenade, stepping side with the right foot and forward with the left.
figures.mistake: Walking in a straight line. Angle the first walk slightly outwards and cross the second in front.

figures.name: Walks (Triple Count)
figures.lead_cue: Rock back in fallaway, then travel forward in promenade with a diagonal chasse followed by a crossing chasse.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, chasse to the side with him in promenade, then chasse forward on the next group.
figures.mistake: Letting the chasses become small steps in place. Travel through each one and keep the knees soft.

figures.name: Stop and Go
figures.lead_cue: Rock back, chasse forward as she turns left under the joined hand, rock forward and replace in side-by-side, then chasse back sending her to turn right.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, turn left under the joined hand through the first chasse, step back and replace, then turn right under the hand through the last chasse.
figures.mistake: Rushing the stop. Pause on the forward step and replace cleanly before sending her the other way.

figures.name: Mooch
figures.lead_cue: Turn to stand arm to arm, rock back, flick and close each foot in turn, rock again, chasse round to closed hold, then repeat the sequence the other way.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right to stand arm to arm, rock back, flick and close each foot in turn, then turn left through the chasse; the second half mirrors the first.
figures.mistake: Making the flicks big and kicking out. Flick low from the knee and close the foot under you.

figures.name: Whip
figures.lead_cue: Rock back in fallaway, chasse round to closed hold, step back behind on the right foot, step left, and finish with a small chasse turning her into fallaway.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back and turn right a little, chasse forward into closed hold, step forward and in between his feet, then chasse round to the side turning right.
figures.mistake: Crossing behind with a big step. Keep the Cuban cross compact so she can step through between your feet.

figures.name: Whip (from open position)
figures.lead_cue: Rock back apart, chasse forward to close the hold, then cross behind, step left and chasse turning right.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back apart, chasse forward into closed hold, step forward and in between his feet, then chasse to the side.
figures.mistake: Closing the hold late. Be in closed hold by the end of the forward chasse, before the cross.

figures.name: Whip Throwaway
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Whip, then let go with the right hand and chasse in place turning right while the left arm extends to send her away into open facing hold.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the Whip, then turn with him through the last chasse and travel backwards away from him into open facing hold.
figures.mistake: Sending her out before the whip is finished. Complete the cross and side step first, then extend the arm.

figures.name: Whip Throwaway (from open position)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Whip from open position, then chasse in place turning right, letting go and extending the left arm to send her away.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the Whip from open position, then chasse away from him backwards into open facing hold.
figures.mistake: Skipping the closed hold in the middle. Close the hold on the forward chasse before the cross.

figures.name: Whisks into Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Two whisks, opening her into promenade on the second one.
figures.follow_cue: Two whisks, turning to promenade on the second one.
figures.mistake: Not opening the hold; turn your body to make room for promenade.

figures.name: Samba Walks in Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Forward, a small part-weight step back, then slip the front foot back a little toward it. Travel side by side.
figures.follow_cue: The same walks as him on the other foot, side by side: forward, small part-weight step back, slip back.
figures.mistake: Taking big strides; samba walks are compact with a pelvic tilt.

figures.name: Botafogos to Closed
figures.lead_cue: Cross forward, side on the ball, replace; again on the other foot as you bring her back to closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Cross forward, side, replace, ending facing him.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to rotate the body to the side on each cross.

figures.name: Natural Basic Movement
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the right, close the left with a touch of weight, then settle on the right; step back on the left, close, settle. Keep the knees springing on every count 1.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: back on the left, close with a touch of weight, settle on the left; forward on the right, close, settle.
figures.mistake: Dancing the bounce flat. Let the knees give on each 1 and rise through the a, instead of stepping with stiff legs.

figures.name: Reverse Basic Movement
figures.lead_cue: The same pattern as the natural basic, begun on the left foot: forward, close, settle; back, close, settle. A slight lean of the body to the left makes the figure drift left.
figures.follow_cue: Right foot back, close, settle; left foot forward, close, settle, following the small turn he gives.
figures.mistake: Rushing the close on the a. Give it only a quick touch of weight, then take full weight on the 2.

figures.name: Basic Movement to Side
figures.lead_cue: Step to the side, close with a touch of weight, settle; then do the same to the other side. Keep your frame level while the hips and knees do the bouncing.
figures.follow_cue: Side on the right, close, settle, then side on the left, close, settle, always moving the same way as him.
figures.mistake: Taking big sideways steps. Keep them small so the close on the a is easy to reach.

figures.name: Progressive Basic Movement
figures.lead_cue: One bar of natural basic followed by one bar of side basic. Face the diagonal to the wall and repeat it to travel along the line of dance.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left, close, settle; then side on the right, close, settle, staying in his closed hold.
figures.mistake: Shuffling backwards and sideways with no direction. Point your body at the diagonal so the pair keeps progressing.

figures.name: Whisks
figures.lead_cue: Step to the side, cross the free foot behind on the ball, take weight back on the first foot; then repeat to the other side. It is a side basic with the cross behind on each a.
figures.follow_cue: Right foot to the side, cross the left behind, replace; then left to the side, cross the right behind, replace.
figures.mistake: Putting the heel down on the cross behind. Stay on the ball of the foot and keep the toe turned out slightly.

figures.name: Whisk w/ Lady's UAT R&L
figures.lead_cue: Dance four whisks. On the first, free your right hand and raise the left so she turns right under the arm; on the third, free the left hand again and she turns the other way. Put your right hand back on her after each turn.
figures.follow_cue: Take a full turn to the right on the first whisk, forward, small side and cross in front, passing under his raised arm; settle into the whisk, then turn left on the fourth bar the same way.
figures.mistake: Lifting the arm late so she has to wait. Raise the left hand on the count before the turn starts.

figures.name: Samba Walks in PP
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward, tuck the free foot back with a touch of weight, then draw the front foot back a few centimetres and take weight. Keep the knees soft and tip the pelvis as you go.
figures.follow_cue: The same walks on the opposite feet, side by side with him: forward, a small step back, draw back and settle.
figures.mistake: Taking long strides on the 1. The forward step is modest and the foot behind it only slips back a short way.

figures.name: Side Samba Walk
figures.lead_cue: A samba walk with the small step on the a going to the side and a little back. Turn slightly to the right as you close, so you finish facing the diagonal to the wall.
figures.follow_cue: Left forward, right foot to the side and a little back, then draw the left back and settle; the couple turns a little to the left.
figures.mistake: Skipping the draw-back on count 2 so the walk goes nowhere. Slide the front foot back before you take weight.

figures.name: Stationary Samba Walks
figures.lead_cue: Facing each other, close the foot slightly forward, step back with a touch of weight, then draw the front foot back and settle. Draw your arms in a little on the 1 and stretch them back out on the a and 2.
figures.follow_cue: You step with him, not away from him: close forward, small step back on the a, draw back, then the other foot.
figures.mistake: Letting the arms go slack. Keep gentle tone so the hold breathes in and out with the steps.

figures.name: Traveling Volta to Left
figures.lead_cue: Cross the right foot in front, then repeat side and cross, keeping the side steps tiny and on the ball. Travel to the left along a straight line or a gentle curve.
figures.follow_cue: The mirror of him: cross the left in front, then tiny side steps and crosses, traveling with him to the left.
figures.mistake: Making the side steps large, which stops the volta flowing. They should be quick, small and a touch back.

figures.name: Traveling Volta to Right
figures.lead_cue: Cross the left foot in front, then repeat side and cross on the ball of the foot, moving to the right. Keep your body quiet over the quick steps.
figures.follow_cue: Cross the right in front, then tiny side steps and crosses, traveling to the right with him.
figures.mistake: Lifting the heel too high between the crosses. Keep the feet low and close to the floor.

figures.name: Traveling Bota Fogos Forward
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward outside her on the 1, then a side step with weight on the a and replace on 2. Alternate right and left, turning a quarter each way so the pair zig-zags along the diagonal.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back on the 1 with him outside you, then side on the a and replace on 2, turning a quarter with him each way.
figures.mistake: Walking straight ahead instead of sidestepping. The forward step is the long one, then the side step brings you back under yourself.

figures.name: Criss Cross Bota Fogos
figures.lead_cue: In promenade with joined hands, pass behind her on the forward step, carrying the left hand over her head. Side with weight on the a, replace on 2, and swap places across both bars.
figures.follow_cue: Pass in front of him on the forward step, turning right then left as you cross, and keep your joined hands raised.
figures.mistake: Walking into each other instead of passing. Curve away from your partner on the forward step so there is room to cross.

figures.name: Traveling Bota Fogos Backward
figures.lead_cue: Step backward on each 1 with her outside you, side on the a, replace on 2, turning a quarter to each side in turn. Open into promenade on the last replace.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on each 1, outside him, then side and replace, turning with him; on the last step open into promenade.
figures.mistake: Leaning back on the backward step. Keep the weight over the front of the foot and let her walk into you.

figures.name: Bota Fogos to PP and CPP
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward on the left, side with weight, replace in promenade; cross forward into counter promenade, then back to promenade. Turn each time on the a and 2 so the hold swings open and shut.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, side on the a, replace in promenade; then cross forward into counter promenade and back, turning the opposite way to him each time.
figures.mistake: Letting the hold swing too wide on the crossing steps. Keep your frame and make the turn small and quick.

figures.name: Criss Cross Voltas
figures.lead_cue: In promenade with joined hands, dance a volta to the right, curving left behind her back, then a volta to the left curving right. Keep the joined hands high so she can cross in front of you.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the voltas across in front of him, turning gradually right on the first bar and left on the second, and keep the joined hands raised.
figures.mistake: Letting the hands drop so she has to duck. Hold them at head height and move your body, not your arms.

figures.name: Solo Spot Voltas (single turns)
figures.lead_cue: Release the hold and turn on the spot to the left, a full turn over the first bar, taking her right hand again. Then turn right for the second bar, finishing with both hands joined.
figures.follow_cue: You turn the opposite way to him on the spot: a full turn right over the first bar and a full turn left over the second.
figures.mistake: Travelling away from your partner while turning. Keep the turns on a small spot, with the feet crossing in front.

figures.name: Solo Spot Voltas (double turns)
figures.lead_cue: Turn on the spot to the left, two full turns over the first seven steps, then two to the right. Take the hands again on the last step of each half.
figures.follow_cue: You turn the opposite way to him: two full turns right over the first seven steps, then two full turns left.
figures.mistake: Letting the turns drift into a circle. Keep the feet crossing in front and stay on the same patch of floor.

figures.name: Solo Circular Voltas
figures.lead_cue: Let go of the hold and walk a small circle with side-and-cross voltas, turning left for the first half and right for the second, so you face her at the end of each half.
figures.follow_cue: Step forward and travel the circle the other way to him, turning right for the first half and left for the second, ending facing him each time.
figures.mistake: Making the circle too wide so the hands cannot reconnect. Keep it tight and aim to face her at the end.

figures.name: Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Turn left almost all the way round: forward on the left, side, cross the left in front and take weight; then back on the right, close, replace. Let the body finish the turn after the feet.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, close, replace, then forward on the left, side and cross in front, turning with him.
figures.mistake: Turning the body too early on the first bar. Let the feet lead, and keep the shoulders level through the cross.

figures.name: Corta Jaca
figures.lead_cue: A strong step forward, then a rocking pattern: a small step forward and slightly aside on the heel, slide the right foot across to replace, then back, replace, forward, replace. Rock with the body, keep the hold steady.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left, then rock with him in the opposite direction: back and aside, slide across and replace, forward, replace, back, replace.
figures.mistake: Doing the rocking steps flat-footed. Slide the right foot across smoothly each time to bring the weight back.

figures.name: Closed Rocks
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the right, rock forward onto a small left step and recover on the right with the toe turned out; then repeat from the left foot. Count 1, 2 and the quick &.
figures.follow_cue: Step back on the left, rock back on a small right step and recover on the left, then repeat the other way, staying with him.
figures.mistake: Making the rock a big lunge. It is a small step and a quick recovery, over before the next count 1.

figures.name: Open Rocks
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward as in the closed rocks, but let go of her in an open shape: send her out turning right on the first rock, bring her back to closed on the next 1, then send her out the other way on the second rock.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right a little on the first rock as the hold opens, then turn left back into closed hold on the next 1; open again on the second rock and turn right to close on the next step.
figures.mistake: Releasing the hold without a clear lead. Use a firm push through the joined hand so she knows when to turn.

figures.name: Back Rocks
figures.lead_cue: Rock backward in closed hold, turning a little left on the first rock and a little right on the second. Recover with the weight back on the other foot each time.
figures.follow_cue: Rock forward on the opposite feet, turning a little left on the first rock and a little right on the second, moving with him.
figures.mistake: Leaning back on the rocks. Keep the body upright and let the legs do the rocking.

figures.name: Argentine Crosses
figures.lead_cue: Turn right, nearly a full circle: forward on the left with a slight lean, cross the right behind, side on the left; then a small step forward on the right, side, forward again. Both partners step forward and the hold stays close.
figures.follow_cue: Also forward on the first step, on the right, turning with him: side and slightly back on the left, forward on the right, then forward on the left, cross behind and side.
figures.mistake: Pulling apart as you both step forward round the turn. Keep the frame close and let the steps follow the circle.

figures.name: Maypole, Man Counter-Clockwise
figures.lead_cue: Walk three quarters of a circle to the left around her with circular voltas, raising the joined hands so she can turn right under them. Return to closed hold or to the open facing hold.
figures.follow_cue: Spin to the right on the spot under his raised arm, a full turn plus a quarter, with double spot voltas while he circles around you.
figures.mistake: Walking the circle too wide and pulling her off her spot. Stay close and keep your arm steady above her.

figures.name: Maypole, Man Clockwise
figures.lead_cue: Circle her clockwise with circular voltas, three quarters of a turn, raising the joined hands so she turns left under them. Finish facing her or resume closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Spin to the left on the spot under his raised arm, a full turn plus a quarter, with double spot voltas while he walks the circle.
figures.mistake: Dragging her round with your arm. Keep the hand still and let your feet carry you around her.

figures.name: Sur Place
figures.lead_cue: March on the spot, one step to every beat, pressing the balls of the feet into the floor with a tall, proud chest.
figures.follow_cue: March in place alongside him, matching his beat and keeping your head lifted and left.
figures.mistake: Sagging in the chest and bobbing. Keep the ribs lifted and the knees soft so the march stays level.

figures.name: Basic Movement Forward
figures.lead_cue: Walk four small marching steps forward, one per beat, leading with the heel and driving her back with your chest.
figures.follow_cue: Walk four small steps backward on the balls of the feet, keeping your frame firm in his arm.
figures.mistake: Taking big strides, which breaks the compact march. Keep each step small so you stay with the beat.

figures.name: Basic Movement Backward
figures.lead_cue: Walk four small steps back, toe first, and let her march into the space you leave.
figures.follow_cue: Walk four small steps forward, heel leading, and stay lifted so you do not lean on him.
figures.mistake: Collapsing the posture as you travel back. Keep the chest proud and step from under the body.

figures.name: Chasses to Right
figures.lead_cue: Step right, close the feet, step right and close again, travelling sideways in a firm closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Step left, close, step left and close, moving sideways with him and keeping the same height.
figures.mistake: Letting the heels drop on each close. Stay on the balls so the chasses look crisp.

figures.name: Chasses to Left
figures.lead_cue: Stamp the right foot as an appel, then step left, close and step left again to travel sideways.
figures.follow_cue: Appel on the left foot, then side, close and side to your right, travelling together with him.
figures.mistake: Stamping too hard on the appel. Make it a short, flat-footed press with the knee soft.

figures.name: Deplacement / Attack (No Turn)
figures.lead_cue: Start with the right foot, either a step forward or a stamp as the attack, march forward left and right, then close the feet.
figures.follow_cue: Start with the left foot, a step back or a stamp for the attack, march back right and left and close the feet, travelling with his chest.
figures.mistake: Slamming the foot on the stamp. Keep it a short, controlled press and travel on the next step.

figures.name: Deplacement / Attack (Quarter Turn)
figures.lead_cue: Attack on the right foot, walk forward on the left, then turn a quarter to the left over the next step and close to finish facing the centre.
figures.follow_cue: Attack on the left, walk back on the right, and turn left with him over counts 2 and 3 before closing.
figures.mistake: Turning too early. Keep the turn for the step to the side so the walk before it stays straight.

figures.name: Slip Attack
figures.lead_cue: Slip the right foot into the appel while starting to turn left, walk forward on the left, step right to the side and close, turning left by up to three-quarters of a circle in all.
figures.follow_cue: Slip the left foot into the appel and turn left with him, stepping back on the right, then side on the left and close.
figures.mistake: Slipping and turning with the arms only. Turn from the body so she is carried round with you.

figures.name: Promenade Link
figures.lead_cue: Appel, step left into promenade position, cross the right foot through, then close the feet as you bring her back into closed hold facing the centre.
figures.follow_cue: Appel on the left, step right into promenade, walk through on the left, then swing round to the left on counts 3 and 4 to face him.
figures.mistake: Staying square instead of showing promenade. Open the chest to the diagonal on count 2, then close the hold on count 4.

figures.name: Ecart
figures.lead_cue: Appel, step forward, then step right and back into a fallaway shape, turning a little left and drifting against the line of dance.
figures.follow_cue: Appel on the left, step back, then side left and back on the right, turning a little right as the hold opens into a fallaway.
figures.mistake: Stepping the last back step too long. Keep it small so you can go straight into the next figure.

figures.name: Ecart (Slip Ecart)
figures.lead_cue: Slip into the appel while turning left, step forward in CBMP, then step right and back into the fallaway ending.
figures.follow_cue: Slip the left foot in the appel and turn left with him, step back, then side left and back on the right into the fallaway.
figures.mistake: Rushing the turn on the slip. Spread it over counts 1 and 2 so the fallaway finishes in control.

figures.name: Separation
figures.lead_cue: Appel, step forward and close while lowering the joined hands to send her away, then mark time as she walks back to you and take hold again on 8.
figures.follow_cue: Appel, step back twice, close, then take four small steps forward back into his hold, arriving on count 8.
figures.mistake: Letting the arm go slack as she separates. Keep gentle tone in the joined hands so she can feel the distance.

figures.name: Separation with Lady's Caping Walks
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Separation, then stand tall on the spot and circle the joined hands over your head so she walks round behind you, closing the hold on the last two steps.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the Separation, then walk six steps round behind him turning right, step to the side with a quarter turn right and close.
figures.mistake: Lifting the hands before she arrives at your right side. Wait until she is level with you, then circle over your head.

figures.name: Separation with Fallaway Ending
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Separation, retake the hold, then pass outside her turning right, step back into a fallaway, and finish with side, close, side, close in closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the Separation, then step forward passing outside him turning right, step back into the fallaway, ease slightly left on count 13 and finish side, close, side, close.
figures.mistake: Dropping the hold before the fallaway. Take her into your right arm as the walks begin so the shape is shared.

figures.name: Huit
figures.lead_cue: Step across in promenade, close with an eighth turn right, then march on the spot while she winds a figure of eight round you, closing the hold at the end.
figures.follow_cue: Step across in promenade, then trace an eight round him with side, replace, across, side, replace, turning left, right, then left again, finishing in front of him.
figures.mistake: Moving your feet around the floor. Stay marching on the spot and let her do the travelling.

figures.name: Sixteen
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Promenade pattern with a shaped finish, then march on the spot for eight counts while she weaves two figures of eight around you.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the Promenade pattern turning right, then walk two figures of eight round him in promenade shape, turning left and right in turn, and close into hold on count 16.
figures.mistake: Letting the shape fade during the long march. Keep the chest lifted and the frame firm for all sixteen counts.

figures.name: Promenade and Counter Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Dance the first half of the Promenade, then open into counter promenade, cross through and finish stepping side in promenade facing the diagonal.
figures.follow_cue: Appel, side, through, step forward, then step left to counter promenade, cross through, turn right on count 7 and finish side right in promenade.
figures.mistake: Treating the second half as a repeat of the first. Change the shape clearly at count 5 so the two sides look different.

figures.name: Grand Circle
figures.lead_cue: Cross the right foot in promenade and hold, twist to the left on the spot over counts 4 to 6, then cross and close to finish in closed hold facing the line of dance.
figures.follow_cue: Walk round him in promenade on counts 2 to 6, turning left by half a circle, then step forward on 7 and close with a big left turn on count 8.
figures.mistake: Hopping out of the twist. Let the feet swivel and uncross smoothly, keeping the weight low and even.

figures.name: Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Appel, side into promenade, walk through, then turn right into closed hold and back away along the line of dance, finishing with a quarter turn right, side and close.
figures.follow_cue: Appel on the left, side right, step through left, then walk forward right-left-right, turning right by a quarter on counts 7 to face him.
figures.mistake: Dropping the promenade shape too soon. Keep the head and chest lifted on counts 2 and 3 before turning.
figures.notes_for_beginners: Team video: 'Paso doble promenade into Spanish line' (the Spanish line is a Silver add-on).

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Basic, raising your left hand on the second half so she turns right under it.
figures.follow_cue: Back break, replace, chasse; then step forward on your left and turn right under his arm on 2-3, chasse to face him.
figures.mistake: Leading the turn on the forward half; it happens on the back half.

figures.name: Spot Turn
figures.lead_cue: Cross through and turn a full turn to the right on the spot, chasse; then turn back to the left.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him, turning left first.
figures.mistake: Travelling while turning; keep the turn on the spot.

figures.name: Cha Cha Basic Movement
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward on the left on 2, replace on 3, chasse left on 4&1; then rock back on the right on 2, replace on 3, chasse right on 4&1.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: rock back on the right on 2, replace on 3, chasse right; then rock forward on the left, replace, chasse left.
figures.mistake: Starting the rock on count 1. The first step of each rock lands on 2, so let count 1 be the last step of the chasse.

figures.name: Progressive Basic
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward on the left, replace, then chasse backward; rock back on the right, replace, then chasse forward so you travel up and down the line.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: rock back on the right, replace, chasse forward; then rock forward on the left, replace, chasse backward.
figures.mistake: Letting the chasses drift sideways. Aim each one straight back or straight forward along your own line.

figures.name: Open Break & Underarm Turn to Right
figures.lead_cue: Rock back on the left to open out, replace, chasse left; then rock back on the right while your left hand lifts and sends her under it.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back away from him, replace and chasse; then walk forward on the left and turn right under his raised hand across counts 2, 3 and 4, finishing facing him for the chasse.
figures.mistake: Dragging her round with the arm. Raise the hand and lead from your body; she supplies the turn.

figures.name: Underarm Turn to Left
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward on the left while raising your left hand so she can turn left under it, replace, chasse; then finish with the back half of the basic.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on the right and turn left under his raised hand across counts 2, 3 and 4, all the way round to face him; then rock forward on the left, replace and chasse.
figures.mistake: Raising the hand late. Lift it as you shift onto the forward foot so she has room to travel.

figures.name: Crossover Breaks Forward
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter right and rock forward on the left beside her, then turn back to face and chasse left; repeat to the other side starting with the right foot.
figures.follow_cue: Turn a quarter left and rock forward on the right beside him, then turn back and chasse right; then mirror it on the other side.
figures.mistake: Bending the supporting knee on the cross; keep the legs straight and the rock crisp.

figures.name: Crossover with Double Rock
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter right and rock forward-back-forward-back on the left side, chasse left on 2&3, then rock the same four times on the right side and chasse right on 4&1.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: turn a quarter left, rock forward and back twice with the right foot first, then the same to the other side.
figures.mistake: Losing the timing after the first side. The odd 2&3 chasse shifts the count, so always dance it in a pair.

figures.name: Crossover Back Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter left and rock back on the left beside her, replace, turn to face and chasse left; then the same to the other side with the right foot.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: turn a quarter right, rock back on the right beside him, replace, turn to face and chasse right; then to the other side.
figures.mistake: Leaning back from the waist. Break back from the hips and keep your chest lifted.

figures.name: Crossover Turns
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter right to rock forward on the left, then turn a half right over the right foot and a quarter more to face; chasse left. Repeat to the left.
figures.follow_cue: Turn the opposite way: a quarter left to rock forward on the right, a half left and a quarter more to face him, chasse right; then to the right.
figures.mistake: Travelling off the spot. Turn on the balls of the feet and keep each rock step small.

figures.name: Offset Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward on the left outside her, replace, chasse left while turning back to face; then rock forward on the right outside her on the other side.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back on the right while he passes beside you, replace and chasse; then rock back on the left on the other side.
figures.mistake: Stepping straight at her. Angle the forward step past her shoulder so you pass outside partner.

figures.name: Cross-Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward, then turn a quarter left out of her way so she walks across in front of you; rock back and forward again and chasse to face.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back and replace, then chasse forward across in front of him while he turns away; on the next rock walk forward across his path, turn left on the back step and the chasse, and finish facing him in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Standing in her way; step to the side to open the path.

figures.name: Progressive Cross Triples
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward, replace, then run three locking chasses backward on 4&1, 2&3, 4&1; rock back, replace, then three locking chasses forward.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: rock back, replace, then three locking chasses forward, crossing the trailing foot behind; then rock forward and lock backward.
figures.mistake: Crossing too far. The lock is a small cross so the weight can keep moving along the line.

figures.name: Inverted Crossovers
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter left and rock back on the left, replace and turn a quarter right into the chasse; then a quarter right to rock back on the right, replace and turn a quarter left into the chasse.
figures.follow_cue: Turn a quarter left and rock forward on the right while he breaks back, replace, and turn a quarter right to face for the chasse; then rock forward on the left and turn left into the second chasse.
figures.mistake: Releasing hands too early. Keep the connection until the push on the chasse sends her round.

figures.name: Stop and Go
figures.lead_cue: Rock back on the left away from her with a light left hand so she stops, replace and chasse left; then rock forward on the right while she goes back, replace and chasse right.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back on the right as he sends you away, replace and chasse right; then step back on the left as he comes forward, replace and chasse left.
figures.mistake: Letting the first rock drift apart. Keep a springy left hand so she returns on count 3 and the figure stays in time.

figures.name: Underarm Pass
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward, replace, then move back, cross and step left as you turn a half right, lifting your left hand over her head so she can turn left; chasse forward.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, replace, chasse forward, then walk forward on the left and turn left on 2-3 under his raised hand, ending facing him as you chasse back.
figures.mistake: Dragging the hand across her face. Pass it up and over, high enough that she can turn comfortably.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn
figures.lead_cue: In closed hold, turn right continuously, crossing the right foot behind the left and stepping the left to the side on every count; the figure here makes one full turn.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right with him, stepping forward between his feet on the right and out to the side on the left on every count.
figures.mistake: Travelling around the floor. Stay on one spot and turn from the middle of the body.

figures.name: Crossover Side Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter right and rock forward on the left, turn back to face and rock sideways left and back; repeat, then chasse left, and mirror it to the right side.
figures.follow_cue: Turn a quarter left and rock forward on the right beside him, turn back to face with a side rock; repeat, chasse right, and mirror it to the other side.
figures.mistake: Running out of room on the side rocks. Keep them small and in time with the forward rocks.

figures.name: 5th Position Side Break
figures.lead_cue: Turn a little left and break back on the left in fallaway, replace, turn back to closed hold and rock sideways left; repeat the break and finish with a chasse left.
figures.follow_cue: Turn a little right as you break back on the right, replace and turn back left to face him for the side rock; repeat, then chasse right.
figures.mistake: Overturning the fallaway. A small eighth of a turn is plenty; keep the hold intact.

figures.name: Cross-Body Lead w/ Underarm Turn L.
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Cross-Body Lead, then on the last chasse raise your left hand and turn her left under it before you finish facing.
figures.follow_cue: Walk across his path as in the Cross-Body Lead, then turn left under his raised hand on the last chasse (4&1), one full turn more than he makes, finishing facing him in open position.
figures.mistake: Raising the hand too soon. Lift it only after she has crossed, so her turn starts on the last chasse.

figures.name: Checked Underarm Turn to Right
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Open Break action with the first chasse, then cross the right foot in front as a checked Cuban cross, replace, and lift your left hand so she turns right under it on the last chasse.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, replace and chasse; then step forward on the left as he checks, replace, and turn right on 4&1 under his raised hand, finishing facing him.
figures.mistake: Pushing her away on the check. Keep the left hand soft and lift it only after the replace so she can turn right.

figures.name: Cha Cha Variation 3
figures.lead_cue: Dance the closed Cha Cha Basic, then shift your weight in place from foot to foot for five counts, transfer to the right and hold on 3; step forward on the left and move with her outside partner, forward and back, finishing with a chasse right.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the basic, then walk forward and across in front of him on every count while turning left around him; continue turning left through the forward-and-back steps outside partner and finish with a side step.
figures.mistake: Travelling while you shift weight. Stay on the spot and let her do the walking.

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Box step; raise your left hand on the back half so she turns right under it.
figures.follow_cue: Back half, then turn right under his arm and close.
figures.mistake: Pulling her around; just raise the hand and give her room.

figures.name: Crossover Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Side, then turn and cross through on the right, replace; side, cross through on the left, replace.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him, crossing with the left first.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to come back to face on the side step.

figures.name: Open Break
figures.lead_cue: Side, rock back away from her to open out, replace; side, rock back, replace.
figures.follow_cue: Side, rock back away from him, replace.
figures.mistake: Letting go; keep one hand connected with some tone.

figures.name: Cross Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Slow forward, then turn a quarter left out of her path and lead her across; finish in closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close; then walk forward across his path, turning left on the next quick to face him, and close.
figures.mistake: Blocking her path; step aside before she crosses.

figures.name: Rumba Box
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward slow, step to the side and close quick-quick, then walk back slow and side-close quick-quick. Keep the knees soft and let the hips settle on every step.
figures.follow_cue: The mirror: slow back, side and close, then slow forward, side and close, with the same hip action.
figures.mistake: Stepping with straight legs at the wrong time; bend the moving knee and straighten as weight arrives (Cuban motion).

figures.name: Alternative Basic
figures.lead_cue: Step left and hold the slow, rock back and replace in two quick steps, then step right and rock forward and replace. It is a basic with a side step opening each half.
figures.follow_cue: Step right, rock forward and replace; then step left, rock back and replace, matching his timing.
figures.mistake: Taking big side steps. Keep them small so the rocks have room and the hold stays close.

figures.name: Side Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Start with weight settled on the left, press the right foot to the side, replace and close; then do the same to the left side. Take the side steps small and recover quickly.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: press the left foot to the side, replace and close, then the right foot to the other side, replace and close.
figures.mistake: Putting the full weight on the side step so the recovery is slow. Reach out lightly and push back quickly.

figures.name: Cuban Walks (Forward)
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward slow, quick, quick twice, rolling through the ball and letting the hips move with each step. A small turn either way is allowed over the six steps.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back toe first with the same slow, quick, quick rhythm, keeping your frame against his.
figures.mistake: Walking on the heels. Rumba walks go ball first and then lower the heel as the weight arrives.

figures.name: Cuban Walks (Promenade)
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward side by side in promenade, three steps in slow, quick, quick time, twice. Keep your shoulder toward her so the pair stays together.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on the opposite feet beside him, also slow, quick, quick twice, with your head turned slightly toward him.
figures.mistake: Drifting apart on the walks. Keep the joined hands steady and match her step length.

figures.name: Cuban Walks (Counter-Promenade)
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward side by side in counter promenade, starting on the right foot, in slow, quick, quick time twice. Face the same direction as her throughout.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on the opposite feet, beginning on the left, slow, quick, quick twice, level with him.
figures.mistake: Letting one partner walk ahead. Keep shoulders level and walk at the same pace.

figures.name: Open Break & Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Step right, rock away from her and replace, then step left and rock back as you raise your left hand to send her under it. Lower the hand once she has turned.
figures.follow_cue: Step left, rock back and replace; then step right and walk forward in two quicks, turning right under his raised hand to face him again.
figures.mistake: Pulling her round by the arm. Raise the hand early and let her own steps take her under it.

figures.name: 8-Count Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance half a box, then take a slower second half in which you step back diagonally, close, and step forward beside her as you raise your left hand. Finish with the other half of the box.
figures.follow_cue: Half a box with him, then turn right in a wide, easy arc under his raised hand, walking forward beside him, side by side with him, then close the last three steps back in front of him.
figures.mistake: Hurrying her round. Give her a long, easy arc and keep your raised hand steady.

figures.name: Crossover Breaks Forward
figures.lead_cue: Step right and turn to the side-by-side shape, walk forward and rock back, then turn the other way for a second crossover on the left and finish facing her. Keep both hands lightly joined.
figures.follow_cue: You swing the opposite way to him: left foot to the side, forward beside him and replace, then the other way for the second crossover, finishing facing him.
figures.mistake: Letting the side-by-side bars drift apart. Keep the same spacing and finish each break facing your partner.

figures.name: Crossover Back Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Step right, then turn to the side-by-side shape and rock back on the left, replace, and turn to face her on the next side step. Repeat to the other side with the right foot rocking back.
figures.follow_cue: You swing the opposite way to him: left foot to the side, right foot rocks back beside him, replace, then the other way for the second break, always finishing facing him.
figures.mistake: Rocking back with a heavy step. Keep the back rock small and rise from it straight into the side step.

figures.name: Crossover Turns
figures.lead_cue: Step to the side and walk away from each other in a full circle to the right, finishing facing her, then circle back the other way to complete a second full circle. Keep the joined hand light.
