figures.follow_cue: Turn the opposite way: left foot to the side, then walk forward in a full circle to the left, finishing facing him, then circle back the other way to complete the second circle.
figures.mistake: Pulling on the joined hand as you circle. Let go of the tension and walk your own curve.

figures.name: Fifth Position Breaks (Continuous)
figures.lead_cue: Step right, then rock back on the left in a small fifth position as the pair opens into a fallaway, replace and face her. Repeat to the other side with the right foot rocking back.
figures.follow_cue: Step left, rock back on the right as the pair opens, replace and turn back to face him, then repeat to the other side with the left foot behind.
figures.mistake: Rocking back with a large step. The fifth position is a short, crossed-behind rock with the toe turned out.

figures.name: Fifth Position Breaks (to Box)
figures.lead_cue: After a side step, rock back on the left in fifth position, replace, then walk forward on the left, turning a little, and close with side and close to finish like a Box.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back on the right in fifth position, replace, then step back as you turn with him, and finish with side and close.
figures.mistake: Turning too early on the rock. Let the turn arrive only on the walk forward.

figures.name: Cross-Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Dance half a box, then back and side with a quarter turn left as you lead her forward across your body, and finish with a forward and side-close step turning left. Keep your left hand steady to guide her path.
figures.follow_cue: Half a box, then walk forward past him on a diagonal across his front, turn left as you pass, and step back, side and close to finish.
figures.mistake: Blocking her path by turning too soon. Step away and open the way before you turn.

figures.name: Alternative Cross-Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: From the Alternative Basic, rock forward and replace, then step left with a quarter turn and lead her across your front as you step back, forward and side on a left turn.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back and replace, then walk forward across his front, passing in front of him, and turn left to finish with back and side.
figures.mistake: Pushing her across with your arm. Turn your body away from her and let her walk into the space.

figures.name: Cuban Rocks (Forward)
figures.lead_cue: Press forward on the right, rock back to the left, and settle on the right again; then do the same on the left. Keep the steps tiny and let the hips do the travelling.
figures.follow_cue: Press back with your left, rock forward and settle back; then the other foot, matching him step for step.
figures.mistake: Travelling too far. Cuban Rocks stay almost on the spot with the weight changes small.

figures.name: Cuban Rocks (Backward)
figures.lead_cue: Press back on the left, rock forward to the right, and settle back on the left; then repeat on the right foot. Keep them small and use the knees to make the rocking action.
figures.follow_cue: Press forward on your right, rock back and settle forward, then the other foot, staying close to him.
figures.mistake: Leaning backwards with the body. Stay over your feet and let the legs move.

figures.name: Offset Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward on the left on her left side, replace, then step left and rock forward on the right on her other side, replace and step right. The rock alternates from side to side.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror his rocks: right foot back as he steps past your left side, replace, side step, then left foot back on the other side.
figures.mistake: Walking straight at her. Angle the forward rock so you pass beside her, not into her.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn
figures.lead_cue: Step left, then cross the right behind, side, and keep turning right on the spot with six steps in all. Steer her with your frame so she circles around you.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward in front of him on a tight curve, the toe turned out, stepping between his feet, and turn with him through the whole six steps.
figures.mistake: Travelling off the spot. Keep your steps small and cross right behind the left each time.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn (Ending #1)
figures.lead_cue: Three turning steps of the Back Spot Turn, then close the right foot to the left to finish facing a half turn round. A short ending that lets you leave into the next figure.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward between his feet for three steps turning with him, then step forward to side to finish facing him.
figures.mistake: Closing the last step too early. Finish the turn first, then close.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn (Ending #2)
figures.lead_cue: Three turning steps, then lower the left hand and take your right hand from her back as you step side and slightly back. She steps away to finish in open facing position.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward between his feet for three steps, then step side and slightly back as he releases you, finishing in open facing position.
figures.mistake: Letting go of her back too soon. Keep your right hand on her until the last turning step.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn (with Underarm Turn to L)
figures.lead_cue: Dance three turning steps, then keep turning on the spot as you raise your joined left hand and let her circle the other way underneath it. Put your right hand back on her and finish with three more turning steps.
figures.follow_cue: Spin with him through the first three steps, then circle the other way beneath his raised hand while he turns, and resume the spot turn with him.
figures.mistake: Lifting the hand too late. Raise it on the step before so she has room to pass.

figures.name: Forward Spot Turn
figures.lead_cue: Step forward across, the toe turned out, between her feet, then forward again, and keep turning left on the spot. Her steps are the back-spot-turn footwork.
figures.follow_cue: Step side, cross behind, side, and turn left with him on the spot around his feet.
figures.mistake: Turning from the arms rather than the legs. Step across between her feet and let the body follow.

figures.name: Spot Turn in Two Directions
figures.lead_cue: Dance the first half of a Forward Spot Turn, then lead a step offset to her side as you stop the turn, and send her sideways with a slight left lead. Turn back the other way with the first half of a Back Spot Turn.
figures.follow_cue: Follow the spot turn with him, step behind and to the side as he checks, then continue with the opposite turning steps.
figures.mistake: Pulling her round when you reverse. Stop the first turn clearly before you start the second.

figures.name: Cross Body Lead to Underarm Turn Left
figures.lead_cue: Dance a Cross-Body Lead, then step forward and lead her across, and raise your left hand so she can turn left beneath it as you step side and close. Lower the hand and take her back into closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the cross body with him, then turn left as you pass in front of him and continue to turn left beneath his raised hand, finishing back in front of him.
figures.mistake: Turning her under before she has crossed. Finish the cross body and wait for her before raising the hand.

figures.name: Circling Cuban Walks
figures.lead_cue: Dance a Cross-Body Lead, send her away to your left side, then walk backwards side by side in a curve to the right for up to nine steps. Draw her back in and finish with half a Rumba Box.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the cross body, turn left as you pass in front of him, then walk forward beside him curving to the right. A strong right-turning swivel brings you back in front of him, and you finish with half a box.
figures.mistake: Letting the walks drift apart. Keep a steady, curving path and an equal step length.

figures.name: Circling Walks with Underarm Turn L.
figures.lead_cue: From side by side, draw her in front of you with your left hand, then raise it so she turns left beneath it as you step across and turn right. Resume the curving walks backward.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right on your first step as you move in front of him, then turn left under his raised hand, and finish side by side curving to the right.
figures.mistake: Raising the hand while she is still moving. Wait for her to arrive in front of you.

figures.name: Underarm Turn to L. from Circling Walks (closing)
figures.lead_cue: From side by side, draw her in front of you, then raise the left hand and step across and side as she turns left beneath it. Take her into closed hold as she finishes.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right on your first step as you move in front of him, then turn left beneath his raised hand to face him and close up.
figures.mistake: Letting the hold go slack. Keep the left hand at eye level until she has finished.

figures.name: Cuban Wrap (Box Entry & Exit)
figures.lead_cue: Dance half of an 8-Count Underarm Turn, then step forward as she turns right and walk forward in the wrapped position, right shoulders together, turning right. Lift the left hand so she turns left, then finish with a Rumba Box.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward with him to the right, turn right under his raised hand to the wrapped position, walk forward turning right, then turn left under his hand and finish with the second half of a box.
figures.mistake: Letting go of her back during the wrap. Keep the right hand on her back through all the walks.

figures.name: Cuban Wrap (Alternative Entry & Exit)
figures.lead_cue: Dance an Alternative Basic and an Open Break so she turns right beneath your left hand, then walk forward in the wrapped position turning right, lift your hand to turn her left, and finish with an Alternative Basic.
figures.follow_cue: Follow the basic and break with him, turn right under his hand into the wrapped position, walk forward turning right, turn left beneath his raised hand, and finish with the basic.
figures.mistake: Rushing the wrapped walks. Keep the steps even and the left hand steady at her eye level.

figures.name: Cuban Wrap (w/ Man Underarm to Circling Walks)
figures.lead_cue: From the wrapped position, walk forward turning right, then lift the joined hand and turn under it to the left as she passes behind you to your left side. Continue with backward walks curving right.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward turning right, then keep walking and turn right behind his back from his right side to his left, and continue forward walks curving right.
figures.mistake: Dragging her round as you pass under. Lift the hand early and keep the steps even.

figures.name: Open Left Turn
figures.lead_cue: Step forward and side with a quarter turn left, rock back outside her, then step back and side with another quarter turn and rock forward outside her. Keep turning left between the rocks.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror his steps: back, side, forward outside him, then forward, side, back outside him, turning left with him.
figures.mistake: Turning the whole body early. Turn on the side step and keep the rocks straight along your line.

figures.name: Open Left Turn (Alternate Timing)
figures.lead_cue: Start with a side step on the right and hold the slow, then rock forward and side with a quarter turn left, rock back outside her, and repeat the left turn. The slow comes on the side step this time.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot to the side, then rock back and side, forward outside him, then back and side, and finish back outside him as you turn left with him.
figures.mistake: Rocking with big steps. Keep each rock small so the turn stays on the spot.

figures.name: Open Left Turn (with Swivel)
figures.lead_cue: Step right with a small turn right, rock forward outside her on the left, step side turning left, then swivel right as you rock back outside her on the other side, and repeat the left turn.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot to the side, then rock back, side, forward outside him, back and side with him through the changing turns, finishing back outside him.
figures.mistake: Making every turn the same size. The swivel to the right is smaller and quicker than the turn to the left.

figures.name: Crossover Side Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Step out to the side and walk side by side with her, rock back, step side and recover; then do the same to the other side, and finish with a side step facing her. Release one hand and take the other as you change sides.
figures.follow_cue: You swing the opposite way to him: left foot to the side, forward beside him, replace, side and replace, then the second break in the other direction, finishing facing him.
figures.mistake: Rocking too far on the side steps with partial weight. Step out lightly and recover completely on the next step.

figures.name: Fifth Position Side Break
figures.lead_cue: Step right, rock back on the left in a short fifth position, replace, step left lightly and recover; then rock back in fifth again and replace. It is a rock-and-recover pattern with a small fallaway turn.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot to the side, rock back on the right in a short fifth position and turn a little the other way from him to face him again, step right lightly and recover; then rock back in fifth again and turn back to face him.
figures.mistake: Rocking back with a big step. Keep the fifth position short with the toe turned out.

figures.name: Single-Rhythm Basic
figures.lead_cue: Side left, side right, rock back, replace. Six counts.
figures.follow_cue: Side right, side left, rock back, replace.
figures.mistake: Rocking forward; the rock step goes back.

figures.name: Triple-Rhythm Basic
figures.lead_cue: Triple step left (1-and-2), triple step right (3-and-4), rock back, replace.
figures.follow_cue: Triple right, triple left, rock back, replace.
figures.mistake: Taking big triple steps; keep them small and bouncy.

figures.name: Lady's Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Raise your left hand on the first triple so she turns right under it; you change places.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right under his arm on the first triple and face him.
figures.mistake: Raising the arm too late; lift it on count 1.

figures.name: Tuck Turn
figures.lead_cue: Draw her in on the first triple, then push gently so she spins right under your arm.
figures.follow_cue: Come in on the first triple, then spin right on the second.
figures.mistake: Spinning her before the tuck; the compression comes first.

figures.name: Return to Closed
figures.lead_cue: From open, draw her in on the triples and take closed hold before the rock.
figures.follow_cue: Triple forward into his arms, triple to your left in closed hold, then rock back, replace.
figures.mistake: Skipping it and doing closed figures from open position.

figures.name: Basic Step - Open Position
figures.lead_cue: Chasse left, chasse right, then rock back away from her and replace the weight forward; keep the arms elastic.
figures.follow_cue: Chasse right, chasse left, then rock back away from him and replace the weight forward.
figures.mistake: Pulling the arms tight on the rock step. Let the arms stretch a little and spring back.

figures.name: Basic Step - Closed Hold
figures.lead_cue: Chasse left, chasse right in closed hold, then turn into fallaway so you both rock back in line with each other.
figures.follow_cue: Chasse right, chasse left, then rock back in the fallaway with him and replace forward.
figures.mistake: Rocking back straight in closed hold. Open into fallaway so both rock steps travel the same way.

figures.name: Throwout
figures.lead_cue: Turn a little left on the first chasse and send her forward past your left side, release the right hand, and finish in open facing hold for the rock.
figures.follow_cue: Chasse forward past him, then chasse back and to the side into open facing hold; rock back and replace.
figures.mistake: Pushing her with the arm. Turn your body to the left and let the turn carry her out.

figures.name: Link to Closed Position
figures.lead_cue: Chasse forward drawing her toward your right side, put your right hand on her back on the second chasse, then rock back in fallaway.
figures.follow_cue: Chasse forward toward his right side, then turn right into closed hold as you chasse to the side and slightly back, and rock back in the fallaway.
figures.mistake: Taking the hold late. Close the hold on the second chasse, before the rock step.

figures.name: Underarm Turn to R.
figures.lead_cue: Release her back, raise the joined left hand and turn a quarter left over the second chasse while she travels under the arm.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right under his raised hand through both chasses, three quarters in all, and finish facing him for the rock step.
figures.mistake: Lowering the hand while she is still turning. Keep it up until she faces you again.

figures.name: Underarm Turn to L.
figures.lead_cue: Raise the joined left hand and turn a quarter right over the first chasse as you send her to turn left beneath it.
figures.follow_cue: Turn left under his raised hand through both chasses, three quarters in all, and face him for the rock step.
figures.mistake: Waiting until the second chasse to lift. Lift on the first chasse so she has six steps to turn.

figures.name: Hammerlock
figures.lead_cue: Lead the underarm turn to the right keeping both hands, so her left arm wraps behind her back; take a small rock back, then unwind her to the left.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right under his raised hand through the first six steps while your left arm wraps behind you, rock back small, then turn left to unwind.
figures.mistake: Letting go of the low hand. Keep both hands joined so the arm can wrap and unwrap smoothly.

figures.name: Cuddle Wrap
figures.lead_cue: Lead her to turn left under the joined hand and wrap her into your arms beside you, step back and rock, then unwrap her to the right.
figures.follow_cue: Turn left under his raised hand to end beside him with arms wrapped, chasse back and rock, then turn right to unwrap into open facing hold.
figures.mistake: Pulling her into the wrap. Lower the left hand slowly and let her turn bring her in.

figures.name: Back Pass (with Single Hand Change)
figures.lead_cue: Chasse forward turning left while you rest her right hand at your waist, so she passes behind your back, then take her hand with your right on the second chasse.
figures.follow_cue: Chasse forward past his right side, then chasse behind his back turning right to face him, with your right hand sliding around his waist.
figures.mistake: Trapping your own arm. Lift the right arm over the left forearm so it is free to take her hand.

figures.name: Alternating Underarm Turns
figures.lead_cue: Turn her left under the raised hand over the first six counts while you turn a half right; then turn yourself left under your raised right hand while she turns right.
figures.follow_cue: Turn left under his raised hand over the first six counts and face him; then chasse forward and turn right as he passes under his own arm.
figures.mistake: Forgetting the two-hand hold for his own turn. Keep the left hand low to guide her past while you turn.

figures.name: Single Overhead Loop
figures.lead_cue: Turn her left under the raised joined right hands, loop the hands over your head and drop them behind your neck, then take her right hand in your left on the rock step.
figures.follow_cue: Turn left under his raised hand through both chasses; let your right hand slide down his arm into his left hand at the rock.
figures.mistake: Looping the hands too high or too early. Wait until she has passed and then bring the hand over smoothly.

figures.name: Closed Tuck-In Turn Turn
figures.lead_cue: Tuck her toward you on the first chasse, brace the left arm, then push gently after count 2 and let go so she turns by herself.
figures.follow_cue: Step in place with a small chasse, then spin right through the second chasse, a little short of a whole turn, and finish facing him.
figures.mistake: Releasing before the tuck is complete. Brace the arm first, then give the push.

figures.name: American Spin Tuck-In
figures.lead_cue: Pull the joined right hands toward your hip to tuck her in, brace, then give a small push after count 2 and let go.
figures.follow_cue: Chasse forward into the tuck, then spin a full turn right in place through the second chasse and finish facing him.
figures.mistake: Pushing while still pulling her. Finish the tuck before the push so the spin starts clean.

figures.name: Shoulder Spin Tuck-In
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter right so you end behind her, then hold her shoulders and give a push and pull to spin her before releasing.
figures.follow_cue: Chasse across in front of him, then spin right in three tiny steps, one and a half turns or more, and finish facing him.
figures.mistake: Gripping her shoulders hard. Use a light push and pull, then let go early so the spin is free.

figures.name: Lindy Basic Turning to Right
figures.lead_cue: Chasse diagonally forward, rock-cross behind and step to the side as you start to turn right, chasse and finish with a rock back in fallaway.
figures.follow_cue: Chasse forward compactly turning right, walk forward toward his right side and between his feet, chasse to the side still turning, then rock back in the fallaway.
figures.mistake: Crossing behind with a big step. Keep the cross small so she can step between your feet.

figures.name: Lindy Right Turn w/ UAT to R.
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Lindy turn to the right, then chasse to the side while you send her to spin right under the raised hand before the rock back.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward past him, then turn right under his raised hand in three small steps and face him for the rock back.
figures.mistake: Starting the underarm turn too soon. Complete the cross and side step before you lift the hand.

figures.name: Lindy Right Turn w/ UAT to L.
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Lindy turn to the right, then chasse to the side while you lift the left hand and turn her left under it before the rock back.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right with him through the Lindy turn, then turn left under his raised hand over the next three steps and face him for the rock back.
figures.mistake: Lifting the hand on the wrong count. Raise it as she steps forward on 1 of the chasse, not before.

figures.name: Lindy Basic Turning to Left
figures.lead_cue: Chasse forward compactly, walk forward toward her left side and between her feet as you turn left, then chasse and rock back in fallaway.
figures.follow_cue: Chasse diagonally forward turning right, cross behind and step to the side, then turn left through the final chasse and rock back in the fallaway.
figures.mistake: Walking straight at her. Curve left around her so she can move to your right side.

figures.name: Lindy Side Passes
figures.lead_cue: Chasse out to the side and rock back and across, passing each other left and right in turn, and finish with a plain rock back in open facing hold.
figures.follow_cue: Chasse out diagonally, rock back and across as you pass him, and keep alternating sides until the final rock back facing him.
figures.mistake: Stepping across too far. Keep the rock-back-and-across small so you stay in line with her.

figures.name: Stop & Go
figures.lead_cue: Chasse diagonally forward, step across her path and replace to stop her, then chasse to the side and rock back in open facing hold.
figures.follow_cue: Chasse diagonally forward turning left under his raised hand, rock back in cross-body position, chasse forward again turning right under the hand, then rock back away from him.
figures.mistake: Hurrying the stop. Make the cross and replace crisp so she has time to react.

figures.name: Fallaway Walks
figures.lead_cue: Chasse left, chasse right, then turn into fallaway and walk back on both counts of the rock.
figures.follow_cue: Chasse right, chasse left, then step back in the fallaway and walk forward into cross-body position on the last count.
figures.mistake: Leaning back on the walk. Keep the chest lifted and let the legs move.

figures.name: EC Swing Variation 1
figures.lead_cue: Dance a basic, rock back in fallaway and fake the close, then step side and close with no weight in front of her four times as you turn right round her, and finish with a fallaway rock.
figures.follow_cue: Dance a basic, rock back and replace, then step side and close in front of him while turning left on the spot as he circles you, make a half turn right toward him and finish with a rock in the fallaway.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the closing foot of each fake. Touch it beside the other foot and keep the weight where it is.

figures.name: EC Swing Variation 3
figures.lead_cue: After a basic, chasse forward and cross behind to turn her away from you, draw her back to closed hold, step around her and send her into two turns under the raised hand, then wind her left through a hammerlock and finish with a chasse and rock.
figures.follow_cue: After a basic with a quarter turn right into the fallaway, run forward turning left a full turn away from him, turn back right to face him, step back and close, then turn right under his raised hand twice round, and finally turn left a turn and a half into open facing hold.
figures.mistake: Rushing the long turns. Count each of the two big spins out loud so the lead stays smooth and the hold stays soft.

figures.name: Open Break
figures.lead_cue: Slow side, rock back to open out, replace; slow side, rock back again, replace.
figures.follow_cue: Slow side, rock back away from him, replace.
figures.mistake: Going floppy in the arms; keep tone so you can lead the next figure.

figures.name: Cross Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Slow forward, turn left out of her way while she crosses, finish in closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Slow back, side, close; then a slow walk forward across his path, turning left on the next quick to face him, and close.
figures.mistake: Blocking her path.

figures.name: Basic Movement
figures.lead_cue: Rise on a slow side step, then sink into a quick back rock and replace; repeat to the other side with a forward rock. Stay in a relaxed closed hold and keep the quick steps small.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: slow side with a rise, then a quick forward rock and replace; slow side, then a quick back rock and replace.
figures.mistake: Rushing the slow count. Let the rise build slowly across the whole slow, then drop into the quicks.
figures.notes_for_beginners: Taught in the team's Bronze Bolero notes.

figures.name: Basic Movement (in contact position)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the basic in closed contact, chest to chest with no hip action, turning gradually to the left over the six steps for a smooth, waltz-like look.
figures.follow_cue: Stay in contact and turn left with him: slow side, forward rock, then slow side and back rock, rising and lowering with his body.
figures.mistake: Breaking contact on the quick rocks. Keep the upper bodies connected while only the legs move.

figures.name: Basic Movement (ended open)
figures.lead_cue: Take the first half of the basic, and as you replace the weight, firm your arms and ease your right hand away so she is led back into open facing.
figures.follow_cue: Slow side, quick forward, then a longer step back away from him on the last quick as your left hand leaves his shoulder.
figures.mistake: Pulling her out with the arms. Replace your weight and let the extending frame create the space.

figures.name: Progressive Basic
figures.lead_cue: In open facing with joined hands, take the basic with slow steps back and forward instead of side, keeping the rock steps in the quicks.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: slow forward, quick forward, quick back; then slow back, quick back, quick forward.
figures.mistake: Letting the hands collapse on the slow steps. Keep gentle tension so the connection travels with you.

figures.name: Progressive Basic (ended closed)
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward on the slow, rock forward and back, then draw your left hand in to bring her toward you and close the hold.
figures.follow_cue: Slow back, quick back, then a long step forward toward him as the space closes and your hand returns to his shoulder.
figures.mistake: Closing the hold too early. Wait until the final quick, then bring the arms in together.

figures.name: Hip Lifts
figures.lead_cue: Take a slow side step, then draw the free foot in with only a touch of weight and lift that hip, and replace; repeat on the other side. The rock step is replaced by a small hip lift.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: slow side step, lift the hip as your free foot draws in, then settle back onto the standing foot.
figures.mistake: Lifting the hip by bending sideways. Press into the toe and straighten the leg to lift the hip.

figures.name: Underarm Turn to Right
figures.lead_cue: Rise on the slow side step, lift your left hand, and lead her to turn right under it during your back rock; lower the hand and close the hold by step 5.
figures.follow_cue: Slow side, then turn right under his raised arm across the two quicks, finishing on a slow side step and a back rock in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Lifting the hand too late. Raise it on the slow so she can start the turn from her first quick.

figures.name: Progressive Underarm Turn to Right
figures.lead_cue: Dance the progressive basic and lift your left hand on the back rock so she turns right under it, then bring the hand down and close the hold over steps 4-5.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward, then turn right under his raised hand across steps 2-4, finishing in closed hold on the second half.
figures.mistake: Dragging her through the turn. Keep your arm a gentle frame and let her own steps carry the rotation.

figures.name: Crossover Breaks Forward
figures.lead_cue: Step side and cross through side by side, rock back, then turn to the other side and repeat on the left. Release one hand at a time to travel from promenade through counter-promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Opposite feet to him: slow side, quick forward, quick back, then turn the other way and repeat, staying beside him in the shadow of his hand.
figures.mistake: Crossing too far in front. Keep the rock small and travel on the slow side step, not the quick.
figures.notes_for_beginners: Taught in the team's Bronze Bolero notes.

figures.name: Crossover Back Breaks
figures.lead_cue: This is the crossover break danced in reverse: take the rock steps backward, side by side, first on the right foot then on the left, releasing one hand at a time as you fall away from her.
figures.follow_cue: Turn the opposite way to him: slow side, quick back, quick forward, then slow side, quick back, quick forward, staying beside him between the rocks.
figures.mistake: Stepping the quicks forward by habit. The first quick of each rock goes back, so the body leans slightly away.

figures.name: Crossover Turns
figures.lead_cue: Open out to the crossover rhythm, then turn half way on the spot on the third step, facing her again on the slow, and repeat the other way on the second half.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the crossover forward with him, turning half way right on step 3 and half way left on step 6, always ending facing him on the slow.
figures.mistake: Turning on the slow side step instead of the quick. Make the half turn happen on the quicks.

figures.name: Fifth Position Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Step side, then rock back and forward with the feet crossed in fifth position, once to each side, travelling from counter-fallaway to promenade and back to closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Take your rocks on the opposite feet, going back in fifth first on the left foot and then on the right, crossing forward on each recovery.
figures.mistake: Letting the crossed foot land wide. Keep the toes in line so the step really is crossed.

figures.name: Underarm Pass
figures.lead_cue: Draw your left hand in, lift it, and send her forward under the arm while you step side and cross behind; she turns left to face you as you finish the rock steps.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward past his right side under the raised hand, turn half way left on step 3 to face him, then rock back on the slow, quick, quick.
figures.mistake: Lowering the arm while she is still under it. Lift high and wait for her to finish the turn.

figures.name: Side Pass
figures.lead_cue: Turn left on the slow side, rock back and extend your left arm so she walks past your left side, then replace across her path and turn half way left to meet her.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward past his left side on the slow and quick, then turn half way left on step 3 and finish with a slow back and a quick-quick rock.
figures.mistake: Stepping into her way. Draw your left arm gently across so she passes cleanly.

figures.name: Man's Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward and turn right under your own raised left hand while she walks back, lower the hand, then draw her past your left side in a cross-body shape and finish facing her.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back slow-quick, forward quick, then forward across his path on the slow and quick, turning half way left on the last quick to face him.
figures.mistake: Ducking under before the hand is high. Raise the joined hands first and keep the frame lifted as you turn.

figures.name: Open Break
figures.lead_cue: Break back away from her on 2, replace, close; repeat.
figures.follow_cue: Break back away from him, replace, close.
figures.mistake: Losing the hand connection.

figures.name: Mambo Basic
figures.lead_cue: Break forward on the left on 2, rock back onto the right, then step left and hold through 1; repeat backward, breaking back on the right.
figures.follow_cue: Break back on the right on 2, rock forward, then step right and hold; then break forward on the left.
figures.mistake: Stepping on the 1. Mambo starts on 2, so let the fourth beat run into a held, quiet 1.

figures.name: Progressive Basic
figures.lead_cue: Break forward on the left, rock back and step back on the left; then break back on the right, rock forward and step forward on the right.
figures.follow_cue: Break back on the right, rock forward and step forward on the right; then break forward on the left, rock back and step back on the left.
figures.mistake: Making the second break bigger than the first. Keep both breaks the same size so the pair stays on the same spot.

figures.name: Side Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Break to the side on the left on 2, rock back onto the right and close; then break to the right, replace and close.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: break to your right first, replace and close, then break to your left.
figures.mistake: Letting the hips stop between breaks; keep the Cuban motion going even on the held count.

figures.name: Open Break & Underarm Turn to R.
figures.lead_cue: Break back away from her, rock in and step left, then break back again while you raise your left hand and lead her to turn right beneath it.
figures.follow_cue: Break back, rock forward and step right; then walk forward and turn right under his raised hand over the second half, ending facing him.
figures.mistake: Pulling her round by the arm. Lift the hand early and let her own steps carry her round.

figures.name: Fifth Position Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Turn a little away and break back on the left in a small step, rock in and step left to face her; then break back on the right with the opposite angle.
figures.follow_cue: Break back on the right with a small step while he does the same, rock in and step right to face him; then break back on the left.
figures.mistake: Taking big steps back. Keep the fifth-position steps short so you stay together when you step to the side.

figures.name: Crossover Breaks Forward
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter right and break forward on the left beside her, rock back and turn to face with a step left; then break forward on the right to the other side.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: turn a quarter left and break forward on the right beside him, rock back and face him; then the other side.
figures.mistake: Making the crossover a long step. The break is short and sharp, with the rock straight back.

figures.name: Crossover Breaks Back
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter left and break back on the left beside her, rock forward and turn to face with a step left; then break back on the right to the other side.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: turn a quarter right and break back on the right beside him, rock forward and face him; then the other side.
figures.mistake: Leaning back from the waist. Break back from the hips and keep the chest lifted.

figures.name: Crossover Turns
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter right to break forward on the left beside her, keep turning right over the next two steps to face her, then repeat the whole turn to the left.
figures.follow_cue: Turn the other way: break forward beside him turning left, keep turning left to face him, then dance the turn to the right.
figures.mistake: Travelling off the spot. Turn on the balls of the feet and keep every step small.

figures.name: Fallaway Rock & Swivel
figures.lead_cue: Break back on the left in fallaway, rock forward in promenade and step left to face; swivel left on that foot, walk forward in promenade, then step left and close.
figures.follow_cue: Break back on the right in fallaway, rock forward and step right to face him; swivel right on that foot, walk forward, then step right and close.
figures.mistake: Swivelling by stepping. Keep the weight on the foot and twist the heel, then take the next step on time.

figures.name: Cross Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Break forward, rock in and turn left as you step aside, keeping a firm left arm so she walks past you across your path; turn again to step forward and close facing her.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward; then walk forward across his path, turn left on 3 and step back and aside to face him.
figures.mistake: Blocking her path. Turn out of the way early on the first 4-1 so she has a clear line.

figures.name: Stop & Go
figures.lead_cue: Break back, rock in and lift your left hand so she spins left; then step forward and check her with your right hand before breaking back as she turns right.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward; turn left on 4 under his raised hand, step back, replace, then turn right on 4 and end facing him.
figures.mistake: Letting her turn without a stop. Check her on the forward step so the second turn starts from a clear pause.

figures.name: Underarm Pass
figures.lead_cue: Break back, rock in and turn right as you step aside; raise your left hand so she walks forward and passes beneath it, then cross behind and step to open facing.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward; then walk forward past his raised hand and turn left through the last two steps, ending facing him.
figures.mistake: Dragging the hand across her face. Lift it high and early enough for her to walk through easily.

figures.name: Back Pass
figures.lead_cue: Break back, rock in and step forward toward her right side while she places her hand on your waist; turn left through the last three steps as she passes behind your back, and close the hold.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward; step forward with your right hand on his waist, turn left a touch, then walk behind his back and turn right to take the hold again.
figures.mistake: Letting her hand fall off your waist. Keep your arm still so her hand can slide around behind you.

figures.name: Man's Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Raise your left hand and walk forward turning right under it, finishing the turn on your third step, then dance the second half of a Progressive Basic.
figures.follow_cue: Dance a Progressive Basic on the spot and keep your hand raised and still while he turns round beneath it.
figures.mistake: Letting the raised hand drop onto her head. Hold it high and steady until the turn is done.

figures.name: Traveling Underarm Turn to R.
figures.lead_cue: Break back, rock in and step left, then cross the right foot behind and step left again, circling your raised left hand over her head as you turn half right.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward; then walk forward and spin right beneath the hand through the second half, a turn and a half in all, ending facing him.
figures.mistake: Pulling her round with the arm. Circle the hand clockwise over her head and let her own steps do the turning.

figures.name: Turnstile
figures.lead_cue: Break back, rock in and step diagonally forward, then push her right arm so she spins right on her own while you walk forward and turn left to face her again.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward; then step forward and spin right on your own for a turn and a third over the last four steps, ending apart or facing him.
figures.mistake: Holding on to her arm. Give a quick push and release so she can spin freely.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn
figures.lead_cue: In closed hold, turn right on the spot, stepping left to the side and crossing the right behind on every count; a turn and a quarter over six steps at most.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right with him, stepping the right forward between his feet and the left out to the side each time.
figures.mistake: Travelling around the floor. Stay on one spot and turn from the middle of the body.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn (Ending 1)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the turn for one bar, crossing behind, stepping aside and closing the feet to finish up to half a turn right in closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right with him, stepping forward between his feet and out to the side, then forward again to finish.
figures.mistake: Closing before the turn is done. Finish the turn first, then bring the feet together on the held count.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn (Ending 2)
figures.lead_cue: Turn up to half right in closed hold, then step right and back while you let go with the right hand and press the left forward, sending her away into open facing position.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right with him, then step side and slightly back on the left as he lets go and ends in open facing position.
figures.mistake: Letting go before you give the lead. Press the left hand forward on the last step so she knows to step away.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn w/ Underarm Turn to L.
figures.lead_cue: Dance a bar of Back Spot Turn, then keep turning right with your hand raised so she turns left under it for a bar, and finish with another bar of the spot turn.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right with him for the first bar, then step forward, side and side again while you turn left beneath the raised hand for a bar, then turn right with him again.
figures.mistake: Dropping the hand before she has finished. Keep it raised until her turn is over, then place it back on her.

figures.name: Forward Spot Turn
figures.lead_cue: In closed hold, turn left on the spot, stepping forward between her feet on each count; a turn and a quarter over six steps at most.
figures.follow_cue: Turn left with him, stepping the right out to the side and the left behind it on every count.
figures.mistake: Walking forward instead of turning. Step with the toe turned out and keep the feet under you.

figures.name: Spot Turn in Two Directions
figures.lead_cue: Dance a bar of Forward Spot Turn to the left, step across her on the left side as you ease the turn, replace, and then dance a bar of Back Spot Turn to the right.
figures.follow_cue: Turn left with him for the first bar, step side and cross behind through the middle bar, then turn right with him for the last bar.
figures.mistake: Forcing the change of direction. Slow the turn in the middle bar so she can reverse with you.

figures.name: Half Circle
figures.lead_cue: Break back, rock in and step left as you turn a quarter right, wrapping her into a cuddle; cross behind and step left as you lead her round the other way, and finish in open hold.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward; step right turning left into the cuddle, then turn right beneath the raised hand over the last bar, ending facing him.
figures.mistake: Pulling the hands apart through the wrap. Keep the arms soft and at waist height so she can pass inside them.

figures.name: Half Moon
figures.lead_cue: Lead a Cross Body Lead, then circle the joined right hands to wrap her into sweetheart on your side and rock forward and back; repeat the wrap once and finish with an Open Break and Underarm Turn that sends her round a full turn.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the Cross Body Lead, turn left into sweetheart at his side and rock forward and back; repeat it once, then walk beneath the raised hand for a full turn right to finish facing him.
figures.mistake: Rushing the circle of the hands. Draw a smooth arc so she can turn without being pulled.

figures.name: Sugar Push
figures.lead_cue: Step back on 1 to invite her in, replace on 2, touch on 3 as her weight arrives in your hand (compression), then send her back to her end of the slot on 4 and anchor 5&6.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on 1-2, touch on 3 as you feel his hand stop you, step back on 4 and anchor 5&6 at your end of the slot.
figures.mistake: Soft, bending elbows that let her run into you. Keep the arm toned so the compression stops her body.

figures.name: Left Side Pass
figures.lead_cue: Step back on 1, then forward and off the slot to your right on 2 so her lane is clear; turn left as she walks past your left side, finishing the half turn on 3&4, and anchor at the other end.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward 1-2 straight down the slot past his left side, turn half left on your triple 3&4 to face him, then anchor 5&6.
figures.mistake: Leader staying in the slot. Step out of her lane on 2 so she can walk a straight line.

figures.name: Underarm Turn (Right Side Pass)
figures.lead_cue: Step back on 1; on 2 step forward and a little to your left, out of her lane, raising your left hand; turn half right as she passes your right side under the arm on 3&4, then lower the hand and anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward 1-2, turn half right under his arm on 3&4 as you pass his right side, then anchor facing him.
figures.mistake: Dropping the hand during her turn. Keep it just above her head until she has passed.

figures.name: Tuck Turn
figures.lead_cue: Walk her in on 1-2, on 3 draw your left hand toward your right hip so she compresses (the tuck), then lift it on & so she spins right on 4 and travels back to her end; anchor 5&6.
figures.follow_cue: Walk in on 1-2, compress on 3, spin a full turn to the right on &4 as you travel back up the slot, then anchor 5&6.
figures.mistake: Spinning before the compression. Wait for the tuck on 3, then turn.

figures.name: Left Side Pass with Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance the left side pass, but raise your left hand on 2 and circle it counter-clockwise over her head so she turns to her left as she passes; lower it and anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward 1-2, then turn left under his raised hand as you pass him on 3&4, ending at the new end facing him; anchor 5&6. (WCS dancers call this an inside turn.)
figures.mistake: Turning before she reaches him. Walk first, turn as she passes his body.

figures.name: Underarm Pass
figures.lead_cue: Step back on 1, replace on 2 while you raise the left hand, then turn half right through the triple so she walks beneath your raised arm; lower the hand and anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on 1 and 2, then turn half left as you pass beneath his raised hand over the triple, finish facing him and anchor.
figures.mistake: Pulling her through. Keep the raised hand steady above her head and let her own walk carry her past.

figures.name: Left Side Pass
figures.lead_cue: Step back turned out on 1, replace to the side on 2 and turn half left through the triple so she walks past your left side down the slot; anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on 1 and 2, turn half left as you pass along his left side during the triple, then anchor facing him.
figures.mistake: Staying in her lane. Slide aside on the replace step so her walk down the slot stays clear.

figures.name: Sugarpush (Sugarpush)
figures.lead_cue: Step back on 1 and close on 2 as she arrives, take a two-hand hold, then triple in place while your arms stretch and send her back on 3a4; anchor on 5a6.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on 1 and 2 into the compression, triple back to your end of the slot over 3a4 and anchor.
figures.mistake: Going slack in the arms at the compression. Keep tone so she is stopped by your frame, then extend for the send-out.

figures.name: Sugarpush (w/ Underarm Turn R.)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the Sugarpush, then raise the joined hands as she leaves the compression so she makes a full turn to the right while you anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Walk in, triple away from him and then turn right under the raised hands, a full turn, through the anchor, finishing facing him.
figures.mistake: Lifting the hands too early. Wait until she has left the compression, then raise them just above her head.

figures.name: Right Side Pass
figures.lead_cue: Step back and replace while you lift the left hand, turn a quarter right so she walks beneath it on the first triple, then change her hand into your right hand; step aside and send her past again on the second pass.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward through two slots: turn half left as you pass his side during each triple, and anchor facing him at the end of each pass.
figures.mistake: Dropping her right hand at the change. Keep the hands level so the hand swap is smooth and she keeps walking.

figures.name: Two-Hand Tuck-In Turn
figures.lead_cue: Walk her in with both hands joined, brace the left palm to stop her on 3 and 4, then turn a quarter left and let go of her left hand so she travels beneath your raised arm.
figures.follow_cue: Walk in on 1 and 2, turn a quarter left and press into his palm to stop, then wheel right beneath his hand and finish the half turn during the anchor to face him.
figures.mistake: Spinning her before the brace. Wait for the tone in the left arm to settle, then release.

figures.name: Whip
figures.lead_cue: Step back on 1, then cross forward on 2 as you close your right arm round her back and rotate clockwise through the triple; keep turning on 5 and 6 while you release and send her out, then anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward and curve round him in his right arm, rotating a full turn with him, then travel back out along the slot on 5 and 6 and anchor.
figures.mistake: Letting the rotation stall at the triple. Keep both bodies turning clockwise until the release on 6.

figures.name: Whip w/ Inside Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance the whip into closed hold, then raise the joined left and right hands as you release her back so she turns left beneath them while you rotate on to the anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right with him through the whip, then walk forward and curve half left beneath the raised hands as you step back; anchor facing him.
figures.mistake: Lifting the hands late. Raise them as you step to the side on 5 so she has room for the turn.

figures.name: Whip w/ Outside Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance the whip into closed hold, lift the joined hands on 5 and release her back so she turns right beneath them, then lower the hands as she finishes and anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Whip a full turn round him, then turn right beneath the raised hands for a further full turn over 5 and 6, unwinding half a turn left on the anchor to face him.
figures.mistake: Pulling her around by the hands. Keep the raised arm steady and let the turn come from her own steps.

figures.name: Locked Whip (Locked Whip)
figures.lead_cue: Take both hands, rotate clockwise as she passes beneath the raised hand so her arm wraps across her waist, then retract the right hand to send her back while you finish the turn and anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward past him without turning, keep facing along the slot as the arms wrap round your waist, then step back out on 5 and 6 and anchor.
figures.mistake: Twisting her arm tight. Keep the hands low and loose so the wrap rests across her waist.

figures.name: Locked Whip (w/ Underarm Turn)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the locked whip, then lift the left hand and release the wrap on 6 so she turns right beneath it while you anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Pass him in the wrap, then turn right under his raised hand once the wrap opens, a half turn, and unwind half a turn left on the anchor to face him.
figures.mistake: Lifting before the wrap has released. Open the right hand first, then raise the left.

figures.name: Lindy Circle
figures.lead_cue: Rock step, then walk forward around a small clockwise circle with her on 3&4 and 5-6, finishing with a triple in place on 7&8. The couple turns about once round.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, then walk forward around him in the same clockwise circle, right side to right side, and triple in place on 7&8.
figures.mistake: Leaning away from each other. Keep the frame compact and share one centre as you circle.

figures.name: Tuck Turn
figures.lead_cue: Rock step, then on 3 bring your left hand across toward your right hip to wind her up, lift it on & so she spins to her right on 4; triple on 5&6 as she goes out to open position.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, feel the tuck on 3, spin a full turn to the right on &4, then triple back away from him on 5&6 into open position.
figures.mistake: Pulling her down out of the spin. Lift and let go of the pressure; catch her hand again at waist height.

figures.name: Charleston Kicks
figures.lead_cue: Rock step, then step forward on the left and kick the right forward on 4, step back onto it on 5 and touch the left back on 6; close and step on 7-8. Keep a low, bouncy pulse.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, then the mirror image: step back on the right, touch the left back, step forward onto it and kick the right forward; close and step on 7-8.
figures.mistake: Kicking from the knee with a stiff body. Let the swing come from the hip and keep the standing knee soft.

figures.name: Swing Out to Closed
figures.lead_cue: Start like a swing out, but keep her in your right arm after 3&4 and circle together on 5-6, finishing in closed hold on 7&8.
figures.follow_cue: Walk in on 1-2, triple into his arm on 3&4, stay with him as you circle on 5-6, triple in closed hold on 7&8.
figures.mistake: Leader sending her out by habit. Keep the right arm closed around her to show you are staying together.

figures.name: 6-Count Basic
figures.lead_cue: Rock step back on 1-2, triple to your left on 3&4, triple to your right on 5&6. Knees pulse down on every beat.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back on 1-2, triple to your right, then to your left.
figures.mistake: Dancing tall and stiff. Lindy sits low with soft knees and a bounce on every count.

figures.name: 6-Count Basic (Kick Basic)
figures.lead_cue: Rock back on 1-2, then flick the left foot forward on 3 and close it on 4, flick the right forward on 5 and close it on 6. Keep the knees bouncing.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back on 1-2, flick the right foot forward between his feet on 3 and close it, then flick the left forward on 5 and close it.
figures.mistake: Kicking so high that the body leans back. Keep the kick low and small and stay tall over the standing foot.

figures.name: 8-Count Basic
figures.lead_cue: Rock back on 1-2, triple to the left on 3&4, then step 5 and 6 while rotating right with her and finish with a triple on 7&8, half a turn later.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back on 1-2, triple to your right on 3&4, then step left and almost close right on 5-6 as the couple rotates, and triple on 7&8.
figures.mistake: Stepping the 5-6 too big. Keep them compact and turn on the spot so the rotation stays smooth.

figures.name: Throwout
figures.lead_cue: Lean slightly right to send her back on 1, square up on 2, then turn a quarter left through 3&4 as your arms send her forward past you; let go with the right hand and anchor on 5&6.
figures.follow_cue: Step back away from him on 1-2, then run forward past his right side, rotating half a turn right on 3&4, and anchor on 5&6 facing him in open hold.
figures.mistake: Pushing her off with the arms. Turn your own body left and let that turn carry her out.

figures.name: Underarm Turn to Right
figures.lead_cue: Rock back, triple to the side while lifting your left hand, then triple back the other way as the raised hand guides her round under it.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back on 1-2, then turn right under his raised left hand through both triples, finishing facing him in open hold.
figures.mistake: Dragging the hand down while she turns. Keep it high and steady until she has finished the turn.

figures.name: Underarm Turn to Left
figures.lead_cue: Stretch the left arm on 1 and let her come back toward you on 2, then raise the hand on 3&4 while you rotate right and she travels under it to the left; anchor on 5&6.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back on 1-2, begin to rotate left as you replace, and travel under his raised hand through the triple, ending facing him for the anchor.
figures.mistake: Lifting the arm too late. Raise it as she replaces her weight so she has room to pass under.

figures.name: Closed Tuck-In
figures.lead_cue: After the rock step, hold her with a firm left hand through the first triple, then release both hands and send her into a free spin as you step away to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, close up to him, then let go and spin right on the spot through the second triple until you meet his hands facing him.
figures.mistake: Letting the left arm collapse during the tuck. Brace it so she feels the push before she spins.

figures.name: Open Tuck-In
figures.lead_cue: Rock back, bring the joined hands up in front of you and brace on the first triple, then circle the left hand clockwise over her head as she spins.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, give a little resistance on the first triple, then spin one full turn right under the raised hands on the second triple.
figures.mistake: Circling the hand before bracing. Pause the raised hands for a beat so she can feel the signal.

figures.name: Handshake Tuck-In
figures.lead_cue: Join right hands, rock back, draw her in a little on the first triple, then lift the joined hands and circle them clockwise over her head as she spins.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back with a right-hand connection, move slightly toward him on the first triple, then spin one full turn right under the raised hand.
figures.mistake: Pulling her in with the shoulder. Draw her with the right arm only and keep your body square.

figures.name: Underarm Pass
figures.lead_cue: Step back and draw her forward on 1-2, then lift the joined hands over her head on the first triple while you rotate a little right and let her pass.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on 1-2 and travel under his raised hand, rotating left, then triple on the spot to face him.
figures.mistake: Holding the hand too low. Lift it high enough that she can pass under without ducking.

figures.name: Flick / Handshake Pass
figures.lead_cue: Join right hands, rock back, then bring the right hand toward your left hip as you rotate right and release it so she can pass in front of you; anchor on 5&6.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, then turn left across the front of him as his right hand releases, and triple back through 3&4; anchor on 5&6.
figures.mistake: Releasing the hand before she is moving. Keep contact until she has begun to pass.

figures.name: Sugarpush
figures.lead_cue: Step back drawing her in, take both hands, then brace your arms on 3 to stop her and let her flow back as you step forward on 4. Anchor on 5&6.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward on 1-2, stop on 3 against his push, then step back with a long step on 4 and anchor on 5&6.
figures.mistake: Pushing her away instead of stopping her. Give a firm brace through the arms and then let her spring back.

figures.name: Sugarpush w/ Underarm Turn to Right
figures.lead_cue: Dance the sugarpush, then lift the left hand on the fourth step and guide her to turn right under it through the anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Walk in on 1-2, stop on 3, then step away and turn right under his raised hand through the anchor, finishing facing him.
figures.mistake: Lifting before the push has finished. Wait for her to step away, then raise the hand.

figures.name: Swingout (from Closed)
figures.lead_cue: Rock back in closed hold, rotate right with her through the first triple, then keep rotating on 5-6 as you release her to open hold and anchor on 7&8.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back on 1-2, triple forward into his arm on 3&4, then swing around him right on 5-6 as he lets go and anchor facing him on 7&8.
figures.mistake: Releasing her too soon. Keep the right arm around her until the 6 so the circle stays round.

figures.name: Swingout (from Open)
figures.lead_cue: Step back and stretch on 1, take her in to closed hold on 2, rotate right with her on the sideways triple and the next two steps, then release her and anchor on 7&8.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward 1-2 toward him, circle around him to your right through 3&4, swing out on 5-6 as he releases you, and anchor facing him on 7&8.
figures.mistake: Stopping in the middle. The swingout is one circle: she keeps travelling while he rotates.

figures.name: Swingout w/ Underarm Turn to L.
figures.lead_cue: Dance the swingout, but cross the right foot on 5 and lift the right hand so that she unwinds to the left under it; anchor on 7&8.
figures.follow_cue: Walk in and circle around him to your right, then on 5-6 unwind to your left under his raised right hand and anchor facing him.
figures.mistake: Lifting the hand while still rotating. Finish the rotation, then raise the hand clearly above her head.

figures.name: Swingout w/ Underarm Turn to R.
figures.lead_cue: Dance the swingout with a crossed right foot on 5, then raise the right hand and guide her to rotate right under it, one and a half times, as you anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Circle around him through the swingout, then spin right under his raised hand through 5-8, a turn and a half, to finish facing him.
figures.mistake: Letting her arm drop mid-spin. Keep the hand high and let it travel with her until she faces you.

figures.name: Lindy Circle (6-Count)
figures.lead_cue: Step back so she walks in, cross over on 2 and take closed hold as you rotate right, finishing the circle with a sideways triple.
figures.follow_cue: Walk forward 1-2, circle around him with three running steps to land between his feet, then triple sideways in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Letting the circle go flat. Keep your left arm bent and close so she travels round, not past you.

figures.name: Lindy Circle (8-Count)
figures.lead_cue: As in the six-count circle, cross over and take closed hold, then keep rotating through 5-6 and the anchor so that you finish in closed hold a full eight counts later.
figures.follow_cue: Walk in, run turning right around him to land between his feet, then keep circling with a step and a forward walk, and triple sideways in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Rushing the 5-6 so the couple stops turning. Spread the rotation evenly across all eight counts.

figures.name: Lindy Circle w/ Underarm Turn to L
figures.lead_cue: Dance the circle, then on 5 lift the left hand and let her unwind to the left under it while your right hand slides round her back; finish in closed hold on 7&8.
figures.follow_cue: Walk in and circle him to land between his feet, then on 5-6 unwind to your left under his raised hand and come back into closed hold for the triple.
figures.mistake: Letting the right hand leave her back. Slide it round with her so the closed hold is there when she finishes.

figures.name: Locked Whip
figures.lead_cue: Take both hands, cross over on 2 and rotate right as she passes under the raised hand so that your right hand wraps round her waist; pull back on 5, release on 6, and anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Walk in on 1-2, run under the raised hand with a forward-close-back triple while his arm wraps your waist, then step back out on 5-6 and anchor.
figures.mistake: Locking the wrap too tight. Keep it loose enough that she can unwrap as soon as you open the arm.

figures.name: Apache Swingout
figures.lead_cue: Dance the swingout with a crossed foot on 5, take her right hand behind her back into your right hand, and keep guiding her around until you hand it back on the anchor.
figures.follow_cue: Circle around him through the swingout, then spin right through the last four counts with your right arm folded behind your back, finishing facing him.
figures.mistake: Pulling her arm behind her too hard. Guide it gently and keep the elbow soft.

figures.name: Side Basic
figures.lead_cue: Step to the side with the left on 1, replace, close on 3; then side with the right on 5, replace, close on 7.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: side with the right first, replace, close; then side with the left.
figures.mistake: Wide side steps. Keep the feet under the hips so the knees can drive the hip motion.

figures.name: Open Break
figures.lead_cue: Basic forward on 1-2-3; on 5 release your right hand from her back and break back while your left hand stays toned, so you both stretch apart into open position.
figures.follow_cue: Back on 1-2-3 as usual; on 5 break back as well (not forward), feel the stretch through the joined hands, then replace and close.
figures.mistake: A floppy arm on 5. The stretch through the joined hands is what tells her where to go next.

figures.name: Right Turn
figures.lead_cue: Basic forward on 1-2-3; on 4 raise your left hand above her head and circle it clockwise, like a halo, so she turns right on 5-6; lower it as she closes on 7. You dance the back half of the basic.
figures.follow_cue: Back on 1-2-3; then step forward and turn right under his hand on 5-6, spotting him with your eyes, and close on 7 facing him.
figures.mistake: Raising the hand late. Lift it on 4 so she has time to prepare the turn.

figures.name: Cross Body Lead with Left Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance the cross body lead, but raise your left hand on 4 and circle it counter-clockwise over her head so she turns to her left as she passes; lower it on 7 and stay in open hold.
figures.follow_cue: Back on 1, replace on 2, walk across in front of him on 3 as in the cross body lead; then turn left under his hand on 5-6, one and a half turns, and close on 7 facing him. Salsa dancers call this her inside turn.
figures.mistake: Turning before she has crossed his line. Walk first, then turn.

figures.name: Cross-Over Shine
figures.lead_cue: Let go of the hands and dance apart: cross the left in front on 1, replace, step to the side on 3; then cross the right on 5, replace, side on 7. Take hands again to lead the next figure.
figures.follow_cue: Apart, mirror him: cross the right in front on 1, replace, side on 3; then cross the left on 5.
figures.mistake: Looking at your feet. Keep the head up and watch your partner so you can rejoin on time.

figures.name: Salsa Basic
figures.lead_cue: Break forward on the left, rock back onto the right and close; then break back on the right, rock forward and close. Keep the held beat quiet.
figures.follow_cue: Break back on the right, rock forward and close; then break forward on the left, rock back and close.
figures.mistake: Stepping on the pause beats. Let the hips settle and keep the weight where it is.

figures.name: Open Basic
figures.lead_cue: From open hold, break forward on the left and rock back, then step back with the left; break back on the right, rock forward and step forward with the right.
figures.follow_cue: Break back on the right, rock forward and step forward on the right; then break forward on the left, rock back and step back.
figures.mistake: Letting the hands drift apart. Keep a light, steady tone in the joined hands so you both stay on the same line.

figures.name: Cumbia Basic
figures.lead_cue: Cross the left behind the right, rock back onto the right and step left; then cross the right behind and step right. Stay small and level.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: cross the right behind the left, rock onto the left and step right; then cross the left behind and step left.
figures.mistake: Crossing far behind. A short, light cross keeps the feet under the body so you can rock back at once.

figures.name: Underarm Turn to R.
figures.lead_cue: Dance the open basic; on the back break lift your left hand and circle it over her head clockwise so she turns, then lower it as she finishes.
figures.follow_cue: Break back, rock forward and step forward; then walk forward and turn right under his raised hand through the second bar, ending facing him.
figures.mistake: Lifting the hand late. Raise it as you break back so she has a full bar to turn.

figures.name: Underarm Turn to L.
figures.lead_cue: Dance an open basic, then break back again and raise your right hand so she turns left beneath it as you step forward, replace and close; lower the hand as she faces you.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the basic back-and-forward; then break forward and turn left under his raised hand over the second bar of turning steps, ending facing him.
figures.mistake: Pulling her round with the arm. Lift the hand and let her own steps carry her through the turn.

figures.name: Cross Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Break forward, rock back and turn left as you step aside so she can cross in front of you; turn again and close to face her.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward; then walk forward across his path and turn half left on the last bar to face him.
figures.mistake: Blocking her path. Turn left early on the third step so she has a clear lane to walk.

figures.name: Hand Push Basic (Hand Push Basic)
figures.lead_cue: Swing your left arm in a small circle on the forward break, then on the back break press your right palm against hers and let the joined hands rise to her eye level before releasing.
figures.follow_cue: Break back, rock forward and step forward; then break forward, rock back and step back while you press your palm against his.
figures.mistake: Pushing too hard. A light, even pressure is enough for her to read the break.

figures.name: Hand Push Basic (with Cucaracha)
figures.lead_cue: Dance the first bar of the Hand Push, then step to the side with part weight, replace and close while the palm pressure tells her to close her feet and step back.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the first bar, then close the left to the right, shift your weight onto the right with the feet together and step back on the left.
figures.mistake: Taking full weight on the side step. Keep it light so the replace is quick.

figures.name: Hand Push Basic (with Crossover)
figures.lead_cue: Step forward toward her left side with a small turn, rock back and step aside to face her again; then dance the Hand Push Basic.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the open basic back and forward, then the hand push, while he moves slightly to your left side and back to face you.
figures.mistake: Over-turning on the crossover. Make it an eighth turn each way so you can face again on the third step.

figures.name: Stop & Go
figures.lead_cue: Break back, rock in and raise your left hand so she turns left; step forward and check her with your right hand, then break back as she turns right.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward; turn left under his raised hand and step back, then stop on the check and turn right to face him.
figures.mistake: Letting her turn without a stop. Check her on the forward step so the second turn starts from a clear pause.

figures.name: Back Pass
figures.lead_cue: Break back and rock in, then step forward toward her right side as she places her hand on your waist; turn left as she passes behind your back and close the hold.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward; step forward with your right hand on his waist, then walk round behind his back, turning with him, and finish by taking closed hold.
figures.mistake: Letting her hand slip off your waist. Keep your arm still so her hand can slide behind you.

figures.name: Man's Underarm Turn to Cross-Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Raise your left hand and turn right under it for the first bar, ending beside her in cross-body position, then dance a cross body lead as she crosses and turns.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the first bar of an open basic while he turns under his raised hand; then walk across in front of him and turn half left to face him.
figures.mistake: Starting the cross body before your own turn is finished. Complete the turn first, then lead her across.

figures.name: Underarm Turn with Double Head Loop
figures.lead_cue: Lead her right turn over two bars, taking her right hand in yours; then loop the joined right hands over her head, take both hands at waist height, loop the left hands over your own head and return to closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward, then turn right under his raised hand for a full turn; in the last two bars let him loop the hands over your head, then loop the left hands over his and finish in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Rushing the loops. Take a full bar for each one so the hands pass over smoothly.

figures.name: Hand Toss
figures.lead_cue: Lead her right turn over the first two bars, then in the open basics toss each of her hands down and across and catch the other hand over the top.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward, then turn right for a full turn under the raised hands; in the last two bars let each hand drop, swing it round and catch his hand again.
figures.mistake: Throwing the hands away. Drop them only a little and catch them at once so the hold never goes slack.

figures.name: Coca Cola
figures.lead_cue: Dance a cross body lead and, as she passes, raise your left hand and circle it over her head so she spins left under it; lower it as she finishes.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the cross body lead; then step forward, pivot left on the side step and keep turning under his hand, finishing facing him in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Starting her spin before she has crossed. Let her walk past first, then lift the hand.

figures.name: Underarm Turn to R, Head Loop & Coca Cola
figures.lead_cue: Dance an open basic, turn her right in two-hand hold, then loop the hands over her head as you start a cross body, finishing with a Coca Cola and a loop of the left hand over your own head.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward, then turn right under the raised hands; after the head loop, cross in front of him and spin left for one and a half turns under his left hand to end in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Rushing the head loop. Complete the turn first and take the whole bar for the loop.

figures.name: Hammerlock
figures.lead_cue: Turn her right for a full turn and wrap her arm behind her waist, step back and in, then turn her left out of the wrap; move through fallaway and promenade shapes into a cross body lead.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right under his hand for a full turn into the wrap, then break back and forward; turn left out of the wrap, step back in fallaway, forward in promenade and cross the floor in the cross body lead.
figures.mistake: Pulling on the wrapped arm. Keep the joined hands low and let her walk in and out of the wrap.

figures.name: Man's Wrap & Duck Turn
figures.lead_cue: Turn right under the joined hands, placing her hand on your shoulder, and duck your head under her arm on the open basic that follows; then take the hand back.
figures.follow_cue: Dance the open basic on the spot and keep your hand lightly on his shoulder while he turns and ducks beneath your arm.
figures.mistake: Hitting her arm as you duck. Bend from the waist and pass under the arm in one smooth curve.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn
figures.lead_cue: Break forward, rock back and step aside, then cross behind and step side and close while you turn on the spot; she steps between your feet to follow.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward, then step forward between his feet and turn right on the spot with him, finishing facing.
figures.mistake: Travelling off the spot. Turn from the middle of the body and keep every step small.

figures.name: Back Spot Turn (Open Break to Back Spot Turn)
figures.lead_cue: Break back with firm arms, rock in and close into closed hold, then turn on the spot as in the back spot turn and release to open hold on the last step.
figures.follow_cue: Break back and rock forward into closed hold; step between his feet and turn right on the spot, then step back to open hold.
figures.mistake: Dropping the frame on the break. Keep the arms firm so she feels the stretch and the return.
